  "url": "https://github.com/cxyxz/infoplus-prd/releases/download/v1.3.1/infoplus-prd-runtime-1.3.1.zip",
  "notes": "Windows runtime and Codex plugin package"
}

=== END packaging/version.json
=== README.md
# InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.3

在 Windows 上采集已授权的 InfoPlus IDE 配置，输出可追溯的迁移资料。完整需求见 [任务说明](docs/task.md)。

Skill 执行前先读 [SKILL.md](.agents/skills/infoplus-prd/SKILL.md)；实际采集或 Debug 前按 [问题索引](.agents/skills/infoplus-prd/references/issue-index.md) 查阅相关经验。 [执行决策手册](.agents/skills/infoplus-prd/references/debug-playbook.md) 给出提交失败、节点进不去、截图失败和中断恢复的顺序决策；[能力状态](.agents/skills/infoplus-prd/references/capability-matrix.md) 区分已真实验证、仅自动化、部分实现和待实现，避免把未验证能力当成通用能力。

在 Codex 的项目对话中输入 `$infoplus-prd 分析 Z1778：教职工因公临时赴台审批`。在 Claude Code、Cursor 或普通 PowerShell 中，从项目根目录直接使用同一 CLI。

~~~powershell
node src/cli.mjs run 'Z1778：教职工因公临时赴台审批'
node src/cli.mjs run Z0095 --offline
node src/cli.mjs run Z1525 --static
node src/cli.mjs collect-online output/Z0095
node src/cli.mjs analyze output/Z0095
node src/cli.mjs generate output/Z0095
node src/cli.mjs coverage Z0095
node src/cli.mjs issues
~~~

`run` 优先复用匹配的缓存。目标没有缓存时，设置下文的 `INFOPLUS_IDE_URL` 后采集静态资料，再检查 Debug 并补充可访问的动态证据。`--rescan` 可主动核对 IDE；已有正式缓存版本不一致时会停止，以免合并不同版本。`--static` 跳过动态采集，缺缓存时仍需 Chrome 下载静态资料。`--offline` 只使用已有缓存。运行报告在 `output/<编号>/reports/run-report.json`，路径覆盖报告在同目录的 `path-coverage.json`。状态为 `partial` 或退出码 2 时，请核对报告中缺失的证据。

`run` 在用户授权的 InfoPlus 旧平台内优先尝试非发布 Debug。常规测试实例、身份选择、提交、审批、退回、重新提交及普通确认包含在本次授权范围内；共享回调、测试记录及普通通知本身不构成阻断。统一策略见 `config/debug-policy.json`；结果、失败和未覆盖部分以运行报告及实例证据为准。已登记实例优先恢复；测试输入或动作无法可靠判断时保留阻断，不把未执行路径标为验证。不得绕过权限、修改或部署正式定义、删除业务记录；发现不可逆修改其他系统真实业务数据时停止该具体动作。

可运行 `node src/cli.mjs debug-session <流程目录> <实例UUID> verify` 只读核对当前实例。发送动作前会重新检查目标版本行的 IDE Debug 入口、`Instances → DEBUG` 中的业务流水号、页面的调试模式标记、办理身份和权限。普通委托中转页只能辅助导航。核验结果保存在 `raw/debug-runs.json`。

使用 `node src/cli.mjs input-set <流程目录> <输入 JSON>` 保存流程专属业务编号。编号以字符串保存，绑定流程版本、字段和适用节点。`linked-discover <前置流程目录> <匹配条件 JSON> <候选输出路径>` 按已授权且明确的条件从前置申请数据页只读提取字段值。核对候选后再保存为业务测试输入。实例表的 Id 用于定位记录。业务测试输入和需求规则分别维护。

`linked-fields <目标流程目录>` 从已解析字段列出可能关联业务的字段。结合原页面说明或脚本核实前置流程和字段 ID 后，可用 `linked-dashboard <目标流程目录> <前置流程目录> <匹配条件 JSON> --save` 调用办事中心已完成申请查询。工具逐项核对前置流程定义、流水号、申请人工号、详情状态及业务字段，以字符串保存业务编号。

`config/workflow-inputs/<目标编号>-linked.json` 供 `run` 在缺少目标输入时查找。记录 `targetVersion`、`targetDefinitionId`、`predecessorCode`、`applicantAccount`、`applicantFieldId`、`fieldId`、`targetFieldId`、`targetFieldName`、`targetApplicantFieldId` 和 `nodeIds`，可选 `serial` 指定唯一案例。多候选或条件不全时补充匹配条件。使用已缓存的编号前核对当前模拟人和表单申请人。

`debug-session <流程目录> <实例UUID> adopt <编号>@<版本>` 核实并登记用户已手动推进的在办 DEBUG 实例。实际步骤可采证，之前动作保留为人工验证。已核实的字段来源、权限和待确认事项通过 `raw/cross-flow-evidence.json` 进入唯一业务 Word。

V1.2 的 Debug 全流程深度采集由 `src/form-autofill.mjs` 与 `scripts/v12-walk-flow.mjs` 执行逐节点循环：全页面必填扫描（含滚动区外、条件隐藏、动态字段、附件）→ 自动填合规测试值 → 提交 → 校验失败自动修正 → 核对真实待办与流转 → 保存证据 → 下一节点。普通必填校验失败不会终止分析；提交暴露的新联动必填项会自动补填后再提交。

~~~powershell
node scripts/v12-walk-flow.mjs --dir output/Z1775 --instance <实例UUID> --scope Z1775@<版本> --workflow output/Z1775/workflow.mmd --evidence <证据目录> --attachment <DEBUG测试附件> --max-steps 25
~~~

弹窗统一区分说明、提交确认、必填、格式、业务条件、外部服务异常及未知。关闭校验提示仅表示已读；修复字段并重新检查后才能重新提交。请求结果未知时核验实例与待办，禁止盲目重复提交。错误证据与状态保留，不能把生成 Word 当作 Debug 完成。

正式成果在 `output/<编号>/`，包括一份业务 Word 和配套证据。Word 被占用会报告失败并保留同目录 `.pending`，关闭 Word 后重新运行生成。参见 [版本记录](CHANGELOG.md)、[已知问题](docs/known-issues.md)、[迭代待办](docs/improvement-backlog.md) 和 [V1.0 验收报告](docs/v1.0-acceptance.md)。

安装 Node.js 22 及更新版本、Chrome。使用 `npm ci` 安装依赖，`npm test` 执行结构校验测试。

在 PowerShell 启动专用 Chrome。

~~~powershell
& 'E:\infoplus\start-infoplus-chrome.ps1'
~~~

首次启动后，在新窗口登录 InfoPlus。以后运行同一个脚本可复用 `E:\infoplus\chrome-profile`，会话有效时可直接进入 InfoPlus。Chrome DevTools MCP 的配置随项目加载，使用 `--browser-url=http://127.0.0.1:9222`。在 `E:\infoplus` 开启 Codex 会话后，可用 `codex mcp get infoplus_chrome` 查看配置。

用完后，在专用 Chrome 窗口的菜单中选择「退出」，结束该实例并释放端口。保留 `chrome-profile` 以便下次复用。若要检查端口是否已释放，执行脚本并附加 `-Check`。退出码 2 表示专用 Chrome 未运行。

~~~powershell
$env:INFOPLUS_IDE_URL = 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/ide/project/ZD_YGCGJSCS'
# 有多个版本时，先核实要采集的版本。指定采集版本不会将其标为已发布。
$env:INFOPLUS_VERSION = '20260428-104555'
.\infoplus-prd.cmd scan Z0095 output
~~~

`scan` 使用专用 Chrome，按页面显示的项目和视图下载链接采集。后续可直接针对版本目录再生成文档。

~~~powershell
.\infoplus-prd.cmd import-har output\Z0095\z0095.har output\Z0095\20260428-104555
.\infoplus-prd.cmd generate output\Z0095\20260428-104555
.\infoplus-prd.cmd xsn 'C:\data\view.xsn' 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555\views\<视图ID>'
.\infoplus-prd.cmd import-templates 'C:\data\Z0095-views' 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555'
.\infoplus-prd.cmd capture 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555' 'output\Z0095\z0095.har' 'C:\data\Z0095-views'
~~~

HAR 使用 Chrome DevTools 的 sanitized 导出。导入器提取指定站点的目标响应体，筛除会话字段，原始 HAR 保持在本地。Views HTML 只保留视图表的标题、编号、时间和同源资源路径。已验证的 `guiDefinition` XML 格式自动解析。其他 JSON 格式可配置 `workflow-map.json`，其中 `file` 指向响应文件名，`nodes`、`transitions` 为节点和连线数组的 JSON Pointer，`node`、`edge` 指定各条记录的字段路径。

离线解析支持 XSN 或 InfoPlus IDE 下载的 JSON 模板。使用 `template-json` 命令导入后者，输出目录与 `xsn` 相同。`import-templates` 批量匹配同一版本目录中的视图 ID 或名称，保留首次导入的源文件。渲染使用默认模板数据，禁止脚本和外部网络访问。

输出 Markdown、DOCX、字段与脚本 CSV、标准化 JSON、流程图和完整性报告。退出码 2 表示部分输出或缺失资料。Z0095 已用真实 HAR 和 18 个 XSN 验证 `capture`，运行时回调、审批人解析与动态权限需要业务验收。

`generate`、`capture` 和 `scan` 默认交付唯一业务 Word，`流程编号：流程名称需求文档.docx`。命令在 `documents` 中返回业务 Word 路径。Markdown 等文件保留为内部资料。旧命名 `requirements_custom.docx` 已停用，确认有当前版替代且旧件无独有内容后可清理。

唯一业务 Word 共用同一次本地解析和已核对的规则。直接对版本目录执行 `generate` 会复用完整且未过期的标准化缓存及可用流程图，无需连接采集浏览器。命令通过 `analysisCache` 报告是否复用。原始资料有更新时自动重建缓存，也可用 `generate <版本目录> --refresh` 强制重新解析本地资料。

选项解析读取已有 XSN、IDE 字段配置和表单定义。已授权 Chrome 会话中的同流程申请页可在隔离标签页补采，工具记录 `suggest` 选项、实际值、阶段及条件变化。自动探测只打开现有申请或安全预览，拦截写入操作。单次接口返回标为已观测，未取得的选项单独计入覆盖摘要。没有可读取的申请页时，仍生成本地资料。

截图取证在 V1.2 中与字段分析、按钮流转同等重要。`scripts/v12-capture-screenshots.mjs` 复用当前 Debug 实例与历史只读快照，按节点采集完整页面（长页面分段）、底部业务按钮、特殊字段/条件图，写入 `debug-evidence/NN-节点名-ID/`，并生成 `screenshot-index.json` / `.md` 和 `screenshot-quality.json`；重复图、过小图、节点不匹配图会被质量门禁拒绝。没有实时按钮证据时，可用 `scripts/v12-finalize-button-screenshots.mjs` 从同一实例的实时完整截图裁剪底部按钮区并注明来源；完全缺失时明确记录原因，不用平台工具栏或 XSN 预览冒充。业务版 Word 默认在正文中按节点展示真实截图和按钮流转表，不把截图只堆在附录。`INFOPLUS_SCREENSHOT_DIR` 可指定隔离输出中的截图索引目录；`INFOPLUS_ISOLATED_OUTPUT=true` 可阻止 CLI 按流程编号回写正式目录。

`node src/cli.mjs stages <版本目录>` 独立补采欢迎页的完整截图、说明文字、链接和按钮。命令默认使用专用 Chrome 中已缓存且与版本匹配的前台预览，拦截发起和提交。若没有实时证据，文档仍保留流程定义和 XSN 中的阶段页面，并标明图片来源。业务版附录 B 将说明页放在第一张图。

`node src/cli.mjs collect-online <版本目录>` 使用专用 Chrome 先检查目标版本的非发布 Debug 入口与回调配置，再补采前台欢迎页和字段选项。`scan` 也执行该检查。入口可达、部署状态及共享回调分别记录；共享回调本身不阻断已授权的常规 Debug。前台回退和实际运行结果见 `raw/debug-probe.json` 与运行报告，业务文档和内部资料共用标准化证据。

~~~powershell
.\infoplus-prd.cmd options 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555'
.\infoplus-prd.cmd import-options 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555' 'C:\data\sanitized-options.har'
.\infoplus-prd.cmd generate 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555'
~~~

`options` 和项目 MCP 在连接前检查 9222 的监听进程是否属于专用资料目录。保留可读取的申请页或安全预览即可采集。若其他进程占用了 9222，启动脚本会提示释放该端口。

实时采集在隔离标签页放行与当前申请步骤匹配的 `POST /infoplus/interface/render`，用响应核对流程定义和视图。随后仅放行同一实例的 `POST /infoplus/interface/instance/<实例 ID>/progress` 读取历史。Select2 选项与联动变化随阶段和触发条件记录。

可用 `INFOPLUS_FORM_URL` 指定已验证的同源 render 页面。观测记录在版本目录的 `raw/field-option-observations.json`，结果写入标准化数据和字段 CSV。浏览器验证中的必填、只读及显隐状态按所观测阶段记录，现有申请值不作为默认值。

仅调整业务版时，可复用已生成的标准化资料和图像。

~~~powershell
.\infoplus-prd.cmd generate-custom 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555'
.\infoplus-prd.cmd generate-custom 'output\Z0095\20260428-104555' 'config\requirements-custom.json'
~~~

业务版模板位于 `config/requirements-custom.json`。调整 `sections` 可改标题和章节顺序，`word` 控制字号、纸张、页边距、表格配色与列宽。`formPanelPolicy` 默认每阶段选一张代表图，可设为 `all` 展示包内全部不同图片。业务说明与排版分开配置。`config/business-profiles/Z0095.json` 是经过核对的版本专用示例，只在流程编号、版本与定义 ID 匹配时使用。

业务文档正文和附录 A 使用 InfoPlus IDE 的完整原始画布，宽图增加局部放大。在线 `scan` 会尝试保存 SVG，已采集的原图则直接复用。若已有原始 Workflow SVG，可用 `workflow-original <版本目录> <IDE 画布 SVG>` 核对并生成原图，再执行 `generate-custom`。缺少经核对的原图时标明待补图；自动绘制图只作为内部技术资料。

跨项目使用时，将 `.agents/skills/infoplus-prd` 安装到个人技能目录，并将 `INFOPLUS_PRD_HOME` 指向本项目。

### V1.2 稳定性修复（2026-11-17）

版本唯一来源是 package.json；运行报告读取 src/version.mjs。lock 和 Skill 元数据由一致性测试核对，历史 CHANGELOG 保留。

默认使用 output/<编号>/。独立对比明确指定目录，证据、缓存、报告和 Word 均留在该目录：

~~~powershell
node src/cli.mjs run Z1775 --output-dir output/Z1775workbuddy --offline
node src/cli.mjs generate output/Z1775workbuddy
~~~

不需要 INFOPLUS_ISOLATED_OUTPUT；旧环境变量仍兼容。已有目录参数保持原位置；仅旧 _verification 输入继续按原有迁移核对规则处理。截图限定任务内相对路径，original 原图不插入业务版。无业务结果码不算成功，步骤完成不算实例结束。验收范围见 [稳定性报告](docs/v1.2-stability-acceptance.md)。

### V1.2.1 截图与排版质量修复（2026-11-17）

截图采集使用 `src/full-form-capture.mjs`：在宽屏视口定位唯一 `#form_holder`，展开内部滚动容器，隐藏平台导航并脱敏字段值，生成完整表单图和按业务行对齐的模块裁剪图。图片进入 Word 前由 `src/screenshot-quality.mjs` 分为 A/B/C/D/E；只有完整业务页面、业务局部和有效校验提示可进入正文，调试错误和视口分段只保留在证据中。

补采已完成节点的历史只读页面：`node scripts/v121-recapture-snapshots.mjs output/<对比目录>`；同一实例已有实时按钮源图时，用 `scripts/v121-restore-button-evidence.mjs` 恢复按钮裁剪。随后执行 `node src/cli.mjs generate output/<对比目录>` 原位重生成唯一业务 Word。业务版章节顺序由 `config/requirements-custom.json` 的 `sections` 控制，历史阻断仅在后续 Debug 未解决时作为当前问题。

业务文档附录 B 遇到超长 XSN 预览时按页面可用高度连续分段，附图标注“续 N/M”，并明确静态来源。测试使用 `npm test`，覆盖图片分段、质量门禁、按钮动作标识、版本、拓扑顺序、身份脱敏和输出隔离。

### V1.3.1 字段原子化与分组结构修复（2026-11-17）

字段清单统一为六列：分组、字段名称、字段类型、必填、出现阶段、数据来源/规则。一个真实字段占一行，字段身份以真实 field ID 为准；同一 ID 跨阶段出现时汇总阶段状态，不同 ID 即使名称、类型、规则或阶段相同也不合并。禁止按顿号、冒号等显示文本拆分字段，也禁止为了压缩表格把多个字段写入一个单元格。回归测试直接解析生成的 DOCX 表格核对字段行。

### V1.3 单文档交付（2026-11-17）

默认仅生成 `流程编号：流程名称需求文档.docx`，不再写 `requirements.docx`。技术 Markdown、CSV、JSON、XSN、路径覆盖和截图保持内部资料。`generate-custom` 是兼容命令。固定九章按模板顺序输出，节点按 Workflow 正向拓扑排序，按钮按动作标识去重。已有旧 Word 不会批量删除。对比目录仍完全独立。

=== END README.md
=== scripts/capture-debug-history.mjs
// Read existing history snapshots only. Does not create or advance a workflow.
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path';
import { attachChrome } from '../src/live-options.mjs';
import { readDebugStep } from '../src/debug-session.mjs';
const directory=resolve(process.argv[2]), instanceId=process.argv[3];
const project=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory,'project.json'),'utf8'));
const chrome=await attachChrome();
let page;
try {
  const source=chrome.context.pages().find(p=>/\/form\/\d+\/render/.test(p.url()) && !p.url().includes('snapshot'));
  if(!source) throw new Error('没有可读取的实例页面');
  await readDebugStep(source,project,instanceId);
  const links=await source.evaluate(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].flatMap(a=>{
    const u=new URL(a.href);return u.origin===location.origin&&/^\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render$/.test(u.pathname)&&u.search==='?snapshot=true' ? [u.href]:[];
  }));
  page=await chrome.context.newPage();
  await page.route('**/*',route=> /\/interface\/(doAction|start|save)(?:\?|$)/i.test(route.request().url()) ? route.abort() : route.continue());
  const evidence={version:project.version,definitionId:project.workflowDefinitionId,instanceId,source:'existing-debug-history',stages:[]};
  try {
    const previous=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory,'raw/debug-history-evidence.json'),'utf8'));
    if(previous.version===project.version && previous.definitionId===project.workflowDefinitionId && previous.instanceId===instanceId) evidence.stages=previous.stages;
  } catch(error) {if(error.code!=='ENOENT') throw error;}
  const started=Date.now();
  // Unit distribution and subsequent review pages are selected by their actual history links.
  for(const url of [...new Set(links)]) {
    if(Date.now()-started>80000) throw new Error('历史补图已到本次时间上限，已保存证据可继续复用');
    await page.goto(url,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:15000});
    await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.$$?.entity?.step,{timeout:10000});
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
    const state=await readDebugStep(page,project,instanceId);
    const fields=await page.evaluate(()=>Object.values(window.$$.entity.fields||{}).filter(f=>f.bound&&(f.type==='User'||f.fieldChanging)).map(f=>({id:f.name,type:f.type,settings:{userFilters:f.settings?.userFilters,userTraversal:f.settings?.userTraversal}})));
    const stage={state,mode:'historical-snapshot',note:'已完成步骤的历史只读页面；不证明新的条件切换或候选范围测试',fields,images:[]};
    const masks=page.locator('input,textarea,select,.select2-selection__rendered,.infoplus_labelControl,#command_holder,.commandBar_helper,[id*=entrust],[id*=history],[id*=History],[id*=user],[id*=User],.form_remark_title,.color_b2');
    const viewFolder=`views/${state.viewId}`;await mkdir(join(directory,viewFolder),{recursive:true});
    stage.screenshot=`${viewFolder}/history-${state.flowStepId}.png`;
    await page.screenshot({path:join(directory,stage.screenshot),fullPage:true,mask:[masks],maskColor:'#dce3eb',timeout:12000});
    for(const f of fields) {
      if(!/^\w+$/.test(f.id)) continue;
      const control=page.locator(`[name="${f.id}"],[name^="${f.id}_"],[name="radioList-${f.id}"]`).first();
      if(!await control.count()) continue;
      const row=control.locator('xpath=ancestor::tr[1]').filter({visible:true});
      if(!await row.count()) continue;
      const folder=`debug-evidence/${state.nodeId}`; await mkdir(join(directory,folder),{recursive:true});
      const file=`${folder}/history-${state.flowStepId}-${f.id}.png`;
      await row.screenshot({path:join(directory,file),mask:[masks],maskColor:'#dce3eb',timeout:4000});
      stage.images.push({fieldId:f.id,file,source:'historical-snapshot',capturedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    }
    const existing=evidence.stages.findIndex(item=>item.state.flowStepId===stage.state.flowStepId);
    if(existing<0) evidence.stages.push(stage); else evidence.stages[existing]=stage;
    // Persist partial progress before the next page so timeouts cannot lose evidence.
    await writeFile(join(directory,'raw/debug-history-evidence.json'),JSON.stringify(evidence,null,2));
    console.log(JSON.stringify({node:state.nodeId,name:state.name,images:stage.images.length}));
  }
} finally {await page?.close();await chrome.close();}

=== END scripts/capture-debug-history.mjs
=== scripts/check-word-pages.py
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
import pypdfium2 as pdfium
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for path in root.glob('*.qa.pdf'):
    doc=pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path)); business=path.name!='requirements.qa.pdf'
    prefix='business' if business else 'detailed'
    starts=[]
    for i,page in enumerate(doc):
        text=page.get_textpage().get_text_range()
        if business and '附录 A' in text and '完整业务流程图' in text: starts.append(i+1)
    print(json.dumps({'file':prefix,'pages':len(doc),'appendixA':starts},ensure_ascii=False))
    out=root/('qa-'+prefix);out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for start in range(0,len(doc),12):
        sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1200,4*440),'#d0d0d0');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
        for i in range(start,min(start+12,len(doc))):
            page=doc[i];img=page.render(scale=1).to_pil();img.thumbnail((390,410))
            x=((i-start)%3)*400;y=((i-start)//3)*440
            sheet.paste(img,(x,y+20));draw.text((x+8,y+3),str(i+1),fill='black')
        sheet.save(out/f'contact-{start//12}.jpg')
    if business:
        for i,page in enumerate(doc): page.render(scale=1.4).to_pil().save(out/f'page-{i+1}.png')

=== END scripts/check-word-pages.py
=== scripts/debug-applicant-identity.mjs
import {attachChrome} from '../src/live-options.mjs';
import {readDebugStep,requireDebugAuthorization} from '../src/debug-session.mjs';
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
const [dir,instance,scope,sourceStep,targetStep]=process.argv.slice(2),project=JSON.parse(await readFile(dir+'/project.json','utf8'));

   if(!button)return false;
   button.click();return true;
 },account);

  const dialog=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog')].find(d=>d.querySelectorAll('input[name=chooseEntrustee]').length===2);
  if(!dialog)throw Error('没有唯一的指定身份窗口');

  dialog.querySelectorAll('input[name=chooseEntrustee]')[1].click();

   if(!await input.isVisible())await accountToggle.click({timeout:5000});
   await input.fill(account,{timeout:5000});
 }else{
 await target.locator('.entrustUserSelect [role=combobox]').click({timeout:5000});

   const exact=options.filter(e=>{
     const data=window.jQuery(e).data('data')||window.jQuery('select.select2-hidden-accessible').select2('data').find(d=>d.element===e);
     return String(data?.id??'')===account || e.innerText.split(/[\s()（）]+/).includes(account);
   });
   if(exact.length!==1)return false;
   window.jQuery(exact[0]).trigger('mouseup');return true;
 },account);

 }

   const selected=document.querySelector('.entrust_specifiedUser')?.value;
   const widget=document.querySelector('.entrustUserSelect')?.previousElementSibling;
   const selectedOption=widget?.selectedOptions?.[0];
   const button=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog button')].find(b=>/^(继续|切换)$/.test(b.innerText.trim())&&b.getClientRects().length);
   if(selected!==account && selectedOption?.value!==account)return {matched:false,hasValue:!!(selected||selectedOption?.value)};
   if(!button)return {matched:true,clicked:false};
   button.click();return {matched:true,clicked:true};
 },account);
 if(!ready.clicked)throw Error('平台控件未确认选中指定账号或切换按钮不可用');
 }

   .some(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='继续'&&b.getClientRects().length),undefined,{timeout:15000});

   const owner=candidates.find(r=>window.jQuery(r).data('account')===account);
   if(!owner)return 'owner-not-listed';
   owner.click();
   const button=[...owner.closest('.dialog').querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='继续');
   if(!button)return 'no-continue';
   button.click();return 'continued';
 },account);

 await target.waitForFunction(()=>window.$$?.entity?.permission?.executable===true,undefined,{timeout:15000});

 else throw Error('未知操作');
 await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
 console.log({operation,step,completed:true});
}finally{await chrome.close();}

=== scripts/export-word-qa.ps1
param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Directory,[string]$Name='*.docx')
$taskRoot=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Directory).Path
$taskWord=New-Object -ComObject Word.Application
$taskWord.Visible=$false
$taskWord.DisplayAlerts=0
try {
  foreach($taskFile in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $taskRoot -Filter $Name) {
    $taskDoc=$null
    try {
      $taskDoc=$taskWord.Documents.Open($taskFile.FullName,$false,$true)
      $taskPdf=Join-Path $taskRoot ($taskFile.BaseName+'.qa.pdf')
      $taskDoc.ExportAsFixedFormat($taskPdf,17)
      Write-Output $taskFile.Name
    } finally { if($null -ne $taskDoc){$taskDoc.Close($false)} }
  }
} finally {$taskWord.Quit()}

=== scripts/inspect-docx.mjs
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { inflateRawSync } from 'node:zlib';

// Minimal ZIP reader for OOXML inspection; avoids depending on a global Python.
function centralDirectory(buffer) {
  const entries = new Map();
  for (let offset = 0; offset < buffer.length - 4; offset++) {
    if (buffer.readUInt32LE(offset) !== 0x02014b50) continue;
    const method = buffer.readUInt16LE(offset + 10);
    const compressedSize = buffer.readUInt32LE(offset + 20);
    const nameLength = buffer.readUInt16LE(offset + 28);
    const extraLength = buffer.readUInt16LE(offset + 30);
    const commentLength = buffer.readUInt16LE(offset + 32);
    const localOffset = buffer.readUInt32LE(offset + 42);
    const name = buffer.toString('utf8', offset + 46, offset + 46 + nameLength);
    entries.set(name, { method, compressedSize, localOffset });
    offset += 45 + nameLength + extraLength + commentLength;
  }
  return entries;
}

function readEntry(buffer, entry) {
  const nameLength = buffer.readUInt16LE(entry.localOffset + 26);
  const extraLength = buffer.readUInt16LE(entry.localOffset + 28);
  const start = entry.localOffset + 30 + nameLength + extraLength;
  const data = buffer.subarray(start, start + entry.compressedSize);
  return entry.method === 8 ? inflateRawSync(data) : data;
}

function elements(xml, tag, limit) {
  const out = [];
  const open = new RegExp(`<w:${tag}(?:\\s[^>]*)?>`, 'g');
  const close = `</w:${tag}>`;
  let cursor = 0;
  while (cursor < xml.length) {
    const match = open.exec(xml);
    if (!match) break;
    const start = match.index;
    let depth = 1;
    let end = match.index + match[0].length;
    const tokenPattern = new RegExp(`<\\/?w:${tag}(?:\\s[^>]*)?>`, 'g');
    tokenPattern.lastIndex = end;
    while (depth > 0) {
      const token = tokenPattern.exec(xml);
      if (!token) break;
      const value = token[0];
      if (value.startsWith('</')) depth--;
      else if (!value.endsWith('/>')) depth++;
      end = tokenPattern.lastIndex;
    }
    out.push(xml.slice(start, end));
    open.lastIndex = end;
    cursor = end;
  }
  return out;
}

function cellText(cell) {
  return [...cell.matchAll(/<w:t(?:\s[^>]*)?>([\s\S]*?)<\/w:t>/g)]
    .map(match => match[1].replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>'))
    .join('');
}

const [inputPath, outputDir] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!inputPath || !outputDir) throw new Error('用法: node scripts/inspect-docx.mjs <docx> <输出目录>');
const buffer = readFileSync(resolve(inputPath));
mkdirSync(resolve(outputDir), { recursive: true });
const entries = centralDirectory(buffer);
const documentEntry = entries.get('word/document.xml');
if (!documentEntry) throw new Error('DOCX 缺少 word/document.xml');
const xml = readEntry(buffer, documentEntry).toString('utf8');
const tables = elements(xml, 'tbl').map(table => elements(table, 'tr')
  .map(row => elements(row, 'tc').map(cellText))).filter(rows => rows.length);
const fieldTables = tables.filter(rows => rows[0].includes('字段名称') && rows[0].includes('字段类型'))
  .map(rows => ({ headers: rows[0], rows: rows.slice(1) }));
writeFileSync(join(resolve(outputDir), 'report.json'), JSON.stringify({
  tables: tables.map(rows => ({ headers: rows[0], rows: rows.slice(1) })), fieldTables,
}, null, 2));

=== END scripts/inspect-docx.mjs
=== scripts/v12-build-button-map.mjs
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 生成「节点按钮 / Workflow 连线 / 分支」完整映射
 * 输入：workflow.mmd、逐节点采集证据目录、debug-runs.json
 * 输出：button-branch-map.json / .md（含验证状态：实际验证 vs 配置已确认）
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { parseWorkflowMermaid, buildButtonMap, writeButtonMap } from '../src/node-button-map.mjs';

export function rebuildButtonMap(args) {
const workflowPath = args.workflow;
const evidenceDir = args.evidence || '';
const outputDir = args.output || path.dirname(workflowPath);
if (!workflowPath || !fs.existsSync(workflowPath)) { throw new Error('MISSING --workflow'); }

const parsed = parseWorkflowMermaid(fs.readFileSync(workflowPath, 'utf-8'));

// 递归收集节点证据（V1.2 证据目录按 run/step 分层，不能只扫顶层）
function collectNodeEvidenceFiles(dir, out = []) {
  if (!dir || !fs.existsSync(dir)) return out;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) collectNodeEvidenceFiles(full, out);
    else if (entry.name.endsWith('-node.json')) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

// 1) 实测页面按钮（按 nodeId 汇总）
const observedButtons = {};
for (const f of collectNodeEvidenceFiles(evidenceDir)) {
  try {
    const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8'));
    const id = d.step?.stepId ?? d.step?.nodeId;
    if (!id) continue;
    (observedButtons[id] ||= []).push(...(d.commandButtons || []).map(b => ({
      text: b.text, actionId: b.actionId, kill: b.kill, tip: b.tip,
    })));
  } catch (_) {}
}

// 2) 实测动作与真实目标节点（来自 Skill 的 debug-runs 事件）
const verifiedActions = [];
function progressFiles(dir, out = []) {
  if (!dir || !fs.existsSync(dir)) return out;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const file = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) progressFiles(file, out);
    else if (entry.name === 'progress.json') out.push(file);
  }
  return out;
}
for (const file of progressFiles(evidenceDir)) {
  const progress = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
  const act = progress.outcome?.act;
  const next = act?.responses?.flatMap(r => r.nextTasks || []) || [];
  if (!progress.outcome?.success || !act?.before?.instanceId || !next.length) continue;
  for (const task of next) verifiedActions.push({
    nodeId: act.before.nodeId, actionId: act.action?.id, label: act.action?.label,
    instanceId: act.before.instanceId, at: progress.updatedAt,
    actualTargetNodeId: task.nodeId, actualTargetName: task.name, evidence: file,
  });
}
const runsPath = args['debug-runs'] || path.join(path.dirname(workflowPath), 'raw', 'debug-runs.json');
if (fs.existsSync(runsPath)) {
  try {
    const runs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(runsPath, 'utf-8')).runs || [];
    for (const run of runs) {
      const events = run.events || [];
      for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
        const ev = events[i];
        if (ev.kind !== 'action' || !ev.success) continue;
        const next = events.slice(i + 1).find(x => x.kind === 'after-action');
        const tasks = ev.responses?.filter(r => r.errno === 0).flatMap(r => r.nextTasks || []) || [];
        if (verifiedActions.some(v => Number(v.nodeId) === Number(ev.before?.nodeId) && v.label === ev.action?.label)) continue;
        verifiedActions.push({
          nodeId: ev.before?.nodeId, label: ev.action?.label, actionId: ev.action?.id,
          accepted: ev.errno === 0,
          instanceId: run.instanceId, at: ev.at || null,
          actualTargetNodeId: next?.after?.nodeId ?? tasks[0]?.nodeId ?? null,
          actualTargetName: next?.after?.name ?? tasks[0]?.name ?? null,
          actualTargets: tasks.map(t => ({ nodeId: t.nodeId, name: t.name })),
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}

// V1.2 汇总证据记录了 CLI 超时但业务已成功的动作（如 24/7/42/14），
// 需要并入 verifiedActions，避免把实际成功误标为「配置已确认」。
const evidencePath = args.evidenceFile || path.join(path.dirname(workflowPath), 'raw', 'v12-debug-evidence.json');
if (fs.existsSync(evidencePath)) {
  try {
    const ev = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(evidencePath, 'utf-8'));
    for (const v of ev.verifiedNodes || []) {
      if (!v.success) continue;
      if (verifiedActions.some(x => Number(x.nodeId) === Number(v.nodeId) && x.label === v.action)) continue;
      verifiedActions.push({
        nodeId: v.nodeId, label: v.action,
        instanceId: ev.instanceId, at: ev.capturedAt || null,
        actualTargetNodeId: v.target ?? null, actualTargetName: null,
      });
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}

const map = buildButtonMap(parsed, { observedButtons, verifiedActions });
const files = writeButtonMap(map, outputDir);
const summary = {
  nodeCount: map.nodeCount, transitionCount: map.transitionCount,
  totalButtons: map.nodes.reduce((s, n) => s + n.buttons.length, 0),
  totalAutomaticBranches: map.nodes.reduce((s, n) => s + n.automaticBranches.length, 0),
  verifiedButtons: map.nodes.reduce((s, n) => s + n.buttons.filter(b => b.verification === 'actual-verified').length, 0),
  observedNodes: Object.keys(observedButtons).length,
  verifiedActions,
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outputDir, 'button-map-summary.json'), JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2), 'utf-8');
return { ...summary, files };
}
if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
 const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).flatMap((arg,i,a)=>arg.startsWith('--')?[[arg.slice(2),a[i+1]]]:[]));
 console.log(JSON.stringify(rebuildButtonMap(args),null,2));
}

=== END scripts/v12-build-button-map.mjs
=== scripts/v12-capture-screenshots.mjs
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 按节点批量采集真实 Debug 截图并建立索引
 *
 * 复用当前实例及历史只读快照，不新建实例、不触发保存/提交/开始动作。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { scanFormState } from '../src/form-autofill.mjs';
import { readDebugStep } from '../src/debug-session.mjs';
import { captureNodeScreenshots, writeScreenshotIndex, qualityCheck } from '../src/screenshot-evidence.mjs';

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, cur, i, arr) => {
  if (cur.startsWith('--')) acc.push([cur.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]);
  return acc;
}, []));
for (const k of ['dir', 'instance', 'output']) if (!args[k]) { console.error(`MISSING --${k}`); process.exit(2); }
const directory = path.resolve(args.dir);
const output = path.resolve(args.output);
const project = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(directory, 'project.json'), 'utf-8'));
const order = args.order ? String(args.order).split(',').map(Number).filter(Boolean) : null;
const buttonMap = args['button-map'] && fs.existsSync(args['button-map'])
  ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(args['button-map'], 'utf-8')) : null;
fs.mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true });

const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/', { timeout: 25000 });
const context = browser.contexts()[0];
const source = context.pages().find(p => /one\.zju\.edu\.cn\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render/.test(p.url()) &&
  p.url().indexOf('snapshot') < 0 && p.url().includes('entrust=true'));
let livePage = null;
for (const p of context.pages()) {
  if (!/one\.zju\.edu\.cn\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render/.test(p.url()) || p.url().includes('snapshot')) continue;
  const hit = await p.evaluate(id => window.$$?.entity?.step?.instanceId === id, args.instance).catch(() => false);
  if (hit) { livePage = p; break; }
}
if (!source || !livePage) { console.log('NO_SOURCE_PAGE'); await browser.close(); process.exit(3); }
await readDebugStep(livePage, project, args.instance);

const historyLinks = await livePage.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].flatMap(a => {
  const u = new URL(a.href, location.href);
  if (u.origin !== location.origin || !/^\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render$/.test(u.pathname) || u.search !== '?snapshot=true') return [];
  return [{ name: (a.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), url: u.href }];
}));
const uniqueLinks = [...new Map(historyLinks.map(x => [x.url, x])).values()];
const pages = await context.newPage();
await pages.route('**/*', route => /\/interface\/(doAction|start|save)(?:\?|$)/i.test(route.request().url())
  ? route.abort() : route.continue());

const shots = [];
let index = 0;
async function capture(page, pageType, note) {
  const state = await scanFormState(page);
  if (!state.step?.stepId) return null;
  const nodeId = state.step.stepId;
  const nodeName = String(state.step.name || note || '节点').trim();
  const transitions = buttonMap?.nodes?.find(n => Number(n.nodeId) === nodeId)?.buttons ?? [];
  const meta = {
    index: ++index, nodeId, nodeName, flowStepId: state.step.flowStepId,
    instanceId: args.instance, url: page.url(), pageType,
    identity: { account: state.identity?.actionAccount || null, name: state.identity?.name || null },
    capturedAt: state.capturedAt,
    source: pageType === 'live-debug' ? 'IDE DEBUG 实时办理页面（只读截图）' : '同一 DEBUG 实例的历史只读快照',
    verificationNote: note,
    buttonTransitions: transitions.map(b => ({ label: b.label, targetNodeId: b.targetNodeId,
      targetName: b.targetName, verification: b.verification })),
    fieldCount: state.fieldCount,
  };
  const shot = await captureNodeScreenshots(page, meta, {
    root: output,
    maxSegments: Number(args.segments || 6),
    specialLimit: Number(args['special-limit'] || 6),
  });
  shots.push(shot);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ nodeId, nodeName, pageType, images: shot.images.length, buttons: shot.buttonsDetected }));
  return shot;
}

try {
  if (args['skip-live'] !== 'true') await capture(livePage, 'live-debug', '当前实时节点；未在本轮重复提交动作');
  for (const link of uniqueLinks) {
    await pages.goto(link.url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT || 30000) });
    await pages.waitForFunction(() => !!window.$$?.entity?.step, undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 20000 });
    await pages.waitForTimeout(500);
    await readDebugStep(pages, project, args.instance);
    const state = await scanFormState(pages);
    if (order && !order.includes(Number(state.step?.stepId))) continue;
    await capture(pages, 'historical-snapshot', `${link.name || state.step?.name || ''} 历史只读页面；证明页面结构，不证明新条件切换或新动作`);
  }
} finally {
  await pages.close().catch(() => {});
  await browser.close().catch(() => {});
}

const quality = qualityCheck(shots);
const indexFile = writeScreenshotIndex(output, shots, quality, {
  code: project.code, version: project.version, definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId,
  instanceId: args.instance, source: '专用 Chrome CDP / 真实 InfoPlus Debug 页面与历史快照',
  notes: ['历史快照页面已拦截 doAction/start/save 写操作', '文档图按字段值与身份信息脱敏；原始图保存在 original/ 子目录', '未新建 Debug 实例，未重复提交已完成动作'],
});
console.log('SCREENSHOTS_DONE', JSON.stringify(indexFile.statistics));
console.log('QUALITY', JSON.stringify({ ok: quality.ok, issues: quality.issues.length }));

=== END scripts/v12-capture-screenshots.mjs
=== scripts/v12-finalize-button-screenshots.mjs
/**
 * 用同一实例实时办理页面的完整截图裁剪底部业务按钮区，
 * 替换历史快照中只能看到平台工具栏的退化截图，并重建截图索引。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { cropBottomRegion, pngInfo, qualityCheck, writeScreenshotIndex } from '../src/screenshot-evidence.mjs';

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, cur, i, arr) => {
  if (cur.startsWith('--')) acc.push([cur.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]);
  return acc;
}, []));
for (const k of ['root', 'sources']) if (!args[k]) { console.error('MISSING --root or --sources'); process.exit(2); }
const root = path.resolve(args.root);
const sources = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(args.sources), 'utf-8'));
const index = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.json'), 'utf-8'));
for (const shot of index.nodes) {
  shot.folder = path.resolve(path.dirname(root), shot.folder);
  for (const image of shot.images || []) {
    image.file = path.resolve(path.dirname(root), image.file);
    if (!image.file.startsWith(path.dirname(root) + path.sep)) throw Error('截图索引跨任务');
  }
}
const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/', { timeout: 25000 });

for (const shot of index.nodes) {
  const source = sources[String(shot.nodeId)];
  const image = shot.images.find(i => i.category === 'action-buttons');
  if (!image) continue;
  if (!source) {
    // 没有实时按钮区证据时，删除退化截图，不让平台工具栏冒充业务按钮。
    shot.images = shot.images.filter(i => i !== image);
    shot.buttonTransitions = shot.buttonTransitions || [];
    shot.buttonDetectionNote = '该节点未暴露业务按钮 DOM，历史快照只显示平台工具栏；未采集业务按钮截图，按钮依据 Workflow 配置，未冒充实际截图。';
    try { fs.unlinkSync(image.file); } catch {}
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ nodeId: shot.nodeId, action: 'removed-fallback', reason: 'no-live-business-buttons' }));
    continue;
  }
  const info = await cropBottomRegion(browser, source.file, image.file,
    { height: source.cropHeight || 420, excludeBottom: source.excludeBottom || 55 });
  if (!info) continue;
  Object.assign(image, info, { sha256: (await import('node:crypto')).createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(image.file)).digest('hex'),
    sourceVariant: 'masked', labels: source.labels || [], detection: 'live-full-page-bottom-crop',
    purpose: '文档展示：从同一实例实时办理完整截图裁剪的底部业务操作按钮区' });
  shot.buttonsDetected = source.labels || [];
  shot.buttonDetectionNote = `来源：${source.file}（同一 DEBUG 实例实时办理完整截图的底部裁剪）`;
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ nodeId: shot.nodeId, action: 'cropped', file: image.file, width: info.width, height: info.height }));
}

await browser.close().catch(() => {});
const quality = qualityCheck(index.nodes);
const stats = writeScreenshotIndex(root, index.nodes, quality, {
  code: index.code, version: index.version, definitionId: index.definitionId,
  instanceId: index.instanceId, source: index.source, notes: [...(index.notes || []), '业务按钮区优先取同一实例实时页面完整截图底部裁剪；历史快照不提供按钮时明确标记缺失'],
});
console.log('FINALIZED', JSON.stringify(stats.statistics), 'QUALITY', JSON.stringify({ ok: quality.ok, issues: quality.issues.length }));

=== END scripts/v12-finalize-button-screenshots.mjs

=== scripts/v12-goto-next-task.mjs
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 从已完成节点切到下一真实待办（通用）
 *
 * 当动作已真实提交成功、当前页面 status=2 但调度脚本误判时，
 * 不重复提交；按页面实际待办链接导航，并通过明确的 DEBUG 身份窗口切换。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { chooseDebugIdentity } from '../src/debug-runtime.mjs';
import { scanFormState, captureNodeBundle } from '../src/form-autofill.mjs';

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, cur, i, arr) => {
  if (cur.startsWith('--')) acc.push([cur.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]);
  return acc;
}, []));
for (const k of ['instance', 'evidence']) if (!args[k]) { console.error(`MISSING --${k}`); process.exit(2); }
fs.mkdirSync(args.evidence, { recursive: true });

const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/', { timeout: 25000 });
const context = browser.contexts()[0];
const pages = context.pages().filter(p => /one\.zju\.edu\.cn\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render/.test(p.url()));
let current = null;
for (const p of pages) {
  const hit = await p.evaluate(iid => window.$$?.entity?.step?.instanceId === iid, args.instance).catch(() => false);
  if (hit) { current = p; break; }
}
if (!current) { console.log('NO_CURRENT_PAGE'); await browser.close(); process.exit(3); }

const tasks = await current.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].map(a => {
  const href = a.getAttribute('href');
  const m = href && href.match(/\/infoplus\/form\/(\d+)\/render/);
  if (!m || !href.includes('entrust=true')) return null;
  return { step: Number(m[1]), name: a.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), url: new URL(href, location.href).href };
}).filter(Boolean));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(args.evidence, 'available-tasks.json'), JSON.stringify(tasks, null, 2), 'utf-8');
if (!tasks.length) { console.log('NO_PENDING_TASKS'); await browser.close(); process.exit(4); }

const target = args.step ? tasks.find(t => t.step === Number(args.step)) || tasks[0] : tasks[0];
console.log('GOTO', JSON.stringify(target));
await current.goto(target.url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT || 30000) });
await current.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('input[name=chooseEntrustee]') || !!window.$$?.entity?.step,
  undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
const identity = await chooseDebugIdentity(current, { preferCandidate: true, allowCurrentLoginInterstitial: true });
await current.waitForFunction(() => !!window.$$?.entity?.step, undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
const state = await scanFormState(current);
const slug = `node${state.step?.stepId}-${String(state.step?.name || 'unknown').replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')}`;
const bundle = await captureNodeBundle(current, args.evidence, slug);
const result = { target, identity, allTasks: tasks,
  state: { step: state.step, identity: state.identity, fieldCount: state.fieldCount,
    commandButtons: state.commandButtons.map(b => ({ text: b.text, actionId: b.actionId, kill: b.kill, tip: b.tip })),
    entityActions: state.entityActions, screenshot: bundle.summary.screenshot } };
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(args.evidence, 'goto-result.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), 'utf-8');
console.log('GOTO_RESULT', JSON.stringify({ step: state.step, identity: identity.switched, buttons: result.state.commandButtons.filter(b => b.text).map(b => b.text) }));
await browser.close();

=== END scripts/v12-goto-next-task.mjs
=== scripts/v12-output-smoke.mjs
import {mkdtemp,cp,mkdir,readFile,writeFile,readdir} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
const home=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'infoplus-v12-smoke-'));
const source='output/Z1775workbuddy';
const components=['project.json','raw','normalized','reports','views','debug-evidence','analysis-report.json','stage-field-analysis.json','scan-issues.json','workflow-original.json','workflow-original.png','workflow-original.svg'];
const results=[];let defaultBytes;
for(const mode of ['default','comparison']) {
 const directory=join(home,'output',mode==='default'?'Z1775':'Z1775comparison');
 await mkdir(directory,{recursive:true});
 for(const file of components) await cp(join(source,file),join(directory,file),{recursive:true,
  filter: src => !/(?:^|[\\/])(?:v1\.2\.1|v1\.3)(?:[\\/]|$)|\.tmp$|[\\/]~\$/i.test(src)});
 const args=['src/cli.mjs','run','Z1775','--offline',...(mode==='comparison'?['--output-dir',directory]:[])];
 const proc=spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{encoding:'utf8',timeout:110000,maxBuffer:1024*1024*8,
  env:{...process.env,INFOPLUS_PRD_HOME:home,INFOPLUS_ISOLATED_OUTPUT:'',INFOPLUS_SCREENSHOT_DIR:''}});
 await writeFile(`output/_verification/v12-stability/${mode}-cli.log`,proc.stdout+'\n'+proc.stderr);
 assert.ok([0,2].includes(proc.status),proc.stderr);
 const report=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory,'reports/run-report.json'),'utf8'));
 assert.equal(report.version,(JSON.parse(await readFile('package.json','utf8'))).version);assert.ok(['updated','partial'].includes(report.documents));
 const official=(await readdir(directory)).find(f=>f.endsWith('需求文档.docx')); assert.ok(official); const word=await readFile(join(directory,official));assert.equal(word.readUInt32LE(0),0x04034b50);
 const words=(await readdir(directory)).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.docx'));assert.equal(words.length,1);
 const currentDefault=await readFile(join(home,'output/Z1775',official));
 if(mode==='default')defaultBytes=currentDefault;else assert.deepEqual(currentDefault,defaultBytes);
 results.push({wordCount:words.length,mode,directory,exitCode:proc.status,documents:report.documents,version:report.version});
 console.log(JSON.stringify(results.at(-1)));
}
await writeFile('output/_verification/v12-stability/output-smoke.json',JSON.stringify({home,results},null,2));

=== END scripts/v12-output-smoke.mjs
=== scripts/v12-repair-and-submit.mjs
import { readDebugStep, requireDebugAuthorization } from '../src/debug-session.mjs';
import { requireDebugPage, verifyDebugInstance } from '../src/debug-verification.mjs';
import { submissionOutcome } from '../src/dialog-classification.mjs';
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 通用「修复表单校验 → 提交 → 再校验」自动循环
 *
 * 用法（任意流程/节点通用，不含 Z1775 硬编码）：
 *   node scripts/v12-repair-and-submit.mjs \
 *     --url <页面URL关键字> --dir <项目目录> --instance <实例ID> --scope <版本scope> \
 *     --action "<按钮名称>" --attachment <测试附件> --evidence <证据目录> --max-rounds 10
 *
 * V1.2 要点：
 *  - 普通必填校验失败绝不终止任务；每轮按「控件真实状态」判定，忽略 InfoPlus 不即时清除的旧红字。
 *  - 提交会暴露新的动态必填字段（联动），循环自动补填后再提交，直到真正成功。
 *  - 提交前释放 CDP 连接，避免与 Skill CLI 进程并发争用导致导航超时。
 *  - 区分「业务校验失败」与「CLI 技术失败」，后者单独重试并明确记录，绝不伪装成已验证。
 *  - 每轮保存证据与 progress.json，支持断点恢复。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { scanFormState, repairPass, dismissDialogs, captureNodeBundle, errorFingerprint } from '../src/form-autofill.mjs';

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, cur, i, arr) => {
  if (cur.startsWith('--')) acc.push([cur.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]);
  return acc;
}, []));
for (const k of ['url', 'dir', 'instance', 'scope', 'action', 'evidence']) {
  if (!args[k]) { console.error(`MISSING --${k}`); process.exit(2); }
}

const toolRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const cli = path.join(toolRoot, 'src', 'cli.mjs');
const maxRounds = Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Number(args['max-rounds']) || 10));
const project = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(args.dir,'project.json'),'utf8'));
requireDebugAuthorization(project,args.scope);
const attachment = args.attachment || '';
const evidenceDir = args.evidence;
fs.mkdirSync(evidenceDir, { recursive: true });

const log = [];
const write = (name, data) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join(evidenceDir, name), typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf-8');

const CDP = process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/';
let browser = null;
const connect = async () => {
  if (!browser) browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(CDP, { timeout: 25000 });
  return browser.contexts()[0];
};
const release = async () => {
  if (browser) { await browser.close().catch(() => {}); browser = null; }
};
/** 优先 URL 命中；流转后 URL 变化时按实例 ID 回退定位（通用） */
const findPage = async ctx => {
  const direct = ctx.pages().find(p => p.url().includes(args.url));
  if (direct && await direct.evaluate(iid=>window.$?.entity?.step?.instanceId===iid,args.instance).catch(()=>false)) return direct;
  for (const p of ctx.pages()) {
    if (!/one\.zju\.edu\.cn\/infoplus\/form\//.test(p.url())) continue;
    const ok = await p.evaluate(iid => window.$$?.entity?.step?.instanceId === iid, args.instance).catch(() => false);
    if (ok) return p;
  }
  return null;
};

let lastFingerprint = '';
let repeat = 0;
let technicalFailures = 0;
let outcome = { success: false };

for (let round = 1; round <= maxRounds; round++) {
  let ctx = await connect();
  let page = await findPage(ctx);
  if (!page) {
    outcome = { success: false, reason: 'page-not-found', round };
    write('blocked.json', outcome); break;
  }
  await page.bringToFront().catch(() => {});
  const verifiedState = await readDebugStep(page,project,args.instance);
  await verifyDebugInstance(page,project,verifiedState,{writable:true});
  requireDebugPage(await readDebugStep(page,project,args.instance),{writable:true});
  const before = await scanFormState(page);
  const unsatisfied = before.errors.filter(e => e.visible && e.msg && !e.satisfied);
  write(`round-${round}-pre-scan.json`, before);
  log.push({ round, phase: 'pre-scan', step: before.step, unsatisfied: unsatisfied.length,
    residualHints: before.errors.filter(e => e.visible && e.satisfied).length,
    commandButtons: before.commandButtons.map(b => b.text), dialogs: before.dialogs });

  write(`round-${round}-dialogs.json`, await dismissDialogs(page));

  if (unsatisfied.length) {
    const repair = await repairPass(page, before, {
      testAttachment: attachment,
      radioPreference: args['radio-preference'] || 'negative',
      valueOverrides: {
        ...(before.identity?.ownerPhone ? { fieldPhone: before.identity.ownerPhone } : {}),
        ...(before.identity?.ownerEmail ? { fieldEmail: before.identity.ownerEmail } : {}),
      },
    });
    write(`round-${round}-repair.json`, { fixed: repair.fixed, skipped: repair.skipped,
      afterUnsatisfied: repair.after.errors.filter(e => e.visible && !e.satisfied),
      afterButtons: repair.after.commandButtons });
    log.push({ round, phase: 'repair', fixed: repair.fixed, skipped: repair.skipped,
      remainingUnsatisfied: repair.after.errors.filter(e => e.visible && !e.satisfied).length });
    console.log(`[round ${round}] repaired ${repair.fixed.length}, skipped ${repair.skipped.length}`);
  }

  const checked = await scanFormState(page);
  if (checked.errors.some(e => e.visible && e.msg && !e.satisfied)) {
    const fingerprint = errorFingerprint(checked.errors);
    repeat = fingerprint === lastFingerprint ? repeat + 1 : 0; lastFingerprint = fingerprint;
    write('progress.json', {instanceId:args.instance,round,lastFingerprint,repeat});
    if (repeat < 2) continue;
    outcome = {success:false,reason:'repair-incomplete',round};
    write('blocked.json', { ...outcome, errors:checked.errors }); break;
  }
  // 提交前释放 CDP：Skill CLI 会独占导航到 IDE 核验页；并发连接会触发 12s 导航超时。
  await release();
  const proc = spawnSync(process.execPath,
    [cli, 'debug-session', args.dir, args.instance, 'act', args.action, args.scope],
    { cwd: toolRoot, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 110000, maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
      env: { ...process.env, INFOPLUS_ACTION_WAIT_TIMEOUT: process.env.INFOPLUS_ACTION_WAIT_TIMEOUT || '20000',
        INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT: process.env.INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT || '30000',
        INFOPLUS_CHROME_CHECK_TIMEOUT: process.env.INFOPLUS_CHROME_CHECK_TIMEOUT || '25000' } });
  const stdout = (proc.stdout || '').trim();
  write(`round-${round}-act.log`, stdout + '\n' + (proc.stderr || ''));
  let act = null;
  const jsonLine = stdout.split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.startsWith('{')).at(-1);
  try { act = jsonLine ? JSON.parse(jsonLine) : null; } catch (_) {}

  const resultKind = submissionOutcome(act);
  log.push({ round, phase: 'submit', resultKind, submitted: act?.submitted, http: act?.http });
  if (resultKind === 'accepted') { outcome = { success: true, round, act }; break; }
  // Never infer success from HTTP alone or repeat a request whose outcome is unknown.
  if (!['required-validation','format-validation'].includes(resultKind)) {
    ctx = await connect(); page = await findPage(ctx);
    const observed = page ? await scanFormState(page) : null;
    write('uncertain-state.json', { resultKind, before: before.step, current: observed?.step });
    await release();
    const verify = spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'debug-session',args.dir,args.instance,'verify'],
      {cwd:toolRoot,encoding:'utf8',timeout:110000});
    write('state-verification.log', (verify.stdout || '') + (verify.stderr || ''));
    outcome = {success:false, reason:resultKind, round, requiresStateReconciliation:resultKind==='unknown'};
    write('blocked.json',outcome); break;
  }

  // 提交未发出：重新连接、重新扫描，动态必填字段通常在本轮暴露
  ctx = await connect();
  page = await findPage(ctx);
  let after = { errors: [], step: null };
  if (page) { await dismissDialogs(page); after = await scanFormState(page); }
  write(`round-${round}-post-scan.json`, after);
  if (!after.errors.some(e=>e.visible && e.msg && !e.satisfied)) {
    outcome={success:false,reason:'validation-field-not-located',round};
    write('blocked.json',outcome); break;
  }
  const fp = errorFingerprint(after.errors);
  const stillUnsatisfied = after.errors.filter(e => e.visible && e.msg && !e.satisfied);
  log.push({ round, phase: 'post-scan', fingerprint: fp, unsatisfied: stillUnsatisfied.length,
    step: after.step, dialogs: after.dialogs, newFields: stillUnsatisfied.map(e => ({ key: e.key, label: e.label, kind: e.kind })) });
  if (fp && fp === lastFingerprint) repeat++; else repeat = 0;
  lastFingerprint = fp;
  write('progress.json', { round, outcome, lastFingerprint, repeat, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  if (repeat >= 2) {
    outcome = { success: false, reason: 'repeated-unresolved-errors', fingerprint: fp, round };
    write('blocked.json', { reason: outcome.reason, fingerprint: fp, errors: stillUnsatisfied, round });
    console.log('BLOCKED: repeated unresolved validation errors, evidence saved');
    break;
  }
}

if (!outcome.success && !outcome.reason) {
  outcome.reason = 'max-rounds-reached';
  write('blocked.json', { reason: outcome.reason, log });
}

// 成功后采集流转后的新节点证据（真实待办/字段/按钮/整页截图）
if (outcome.success) {
  const ctx = await connect();
  let page = await findPage(ctx);
  if (page) {
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !!window.$$?.entity?.step, undefined, { polling: 200, timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
    const newState = await scanFormState(page);
    const slug = `node${newState.step?.stepId ?? 'unknown'}-${String(newState.step?.name ?? 'unknown').replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')}`;
    const bundle = await captureNodeBundle(page, evidenceDir, slug);
    write('transition.json', { from: outcome.act?.before, to: newState.step,
      nextRender: outcome.act?.nextRender,
      nextTasks: (outcome.act?.responses || []).flatMap(r => r.nextTasks || []),
      newButtons: newState.commandButtons, entityActions: newState.entityActions,
      fields: newState.fieldCount, screenshot: bundle.summary.screenshot });
    console.log('TRANSITION', JSON.stringify({ to: newState.step, buttons: newState.commandButtons.map(b => b.text) }));
  }
}

write('run-log.json', { outcome, log, maxRounds, attachment, args });
write('progress.json', { outcome, lastRound: log.filter(x => x.phase === 'pre-scan').length,
  updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
console.log('OUTCOME', JSON.stringify(outcome.success ? { success: true, round: outcome.round, nextRender: outcome.act?.nextRender } : outcome));
await release();
process.exit(outcome.success ? 0 : 1);

=== END scripts/v12-repair-and-submit.mjs
=== scripts/v12-screenshot-coverage-report.mjs
/**
 * V1.2 截图覆盖报告：按节点连接真实截图索引、按钮映射与 Word 正文章节。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, cur, i, arr) => {
  if (cur.startsWith('--')) acc.push([cur.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]);
  return acc;
}, []));
for (const k of ['index', 'button-map', 'markdown', 'output']) if (!args[k]) { console.error(`MISSING --${k}`); process.exit(2); }
const readJson = p => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf-8'));
const index = readJson(args.index);
const map = readJson(args['button-map']);
const md = fs.readFileSync(args.markdown, 'utf-8');
const mdLines = md.split('\n');

function wordChapter(node) {
  const start = mdLines.findIndex(line => line.startsWith('### 节点：') && line.includes(`[${node.nodeId}]`));
  if (start < 0) return '未在正文找到节点章节';
  const next = mdLines.slice(start + 1).findIndex(line => line.startsWith('### 节点：'));
  const end = next < 0 ? mdLines.length : start + 1 + next;
  const captionCount = mdLines.slice(start + 1, end).filter(line => line.startsWith('### 图 N-')).length;
  return `${mdLines[start].replace(/^###\s+/, '')}（正文含图，总图注 ${captionCount} 个）`;
}
function status(node) {
  if (node.pageType === 'live-debug') return '实时 Debug 页面已访问';
  if (node.pageType === 'historical-snapshot') return '同一实例历史只读快照';
  return node.visited ? '已访问' : '未进入';
}
function yesNo(images, category) {
  const found = images.filter(i => i.category === category);
  if (!found.length) return '无';
  if (category === 'full-page') {
    const masked = found.filter(i => i.sourceVariant === 'masked');
    return `有（${masked.length} 张脱敏完整图）`;
  }
  return `有（${found.length} 张）`;
}

const buttonById = new Map(map.nodes.map(n => [Number(n.nodeId), n]));
const verifiedByNode = new Map([...buttonById.entries()].map(([id, n]) =>
  [id, (n.buttons || []).filter(b => b.verification === 'actual-verified').map(b => b.label)]));
const rows = index.nodes.map(node => {
  const specials = node.images.filter(i => i.category === 'special-field').map(i => i.fieldName || i.fieldId).filter(Boolean);
  const buttons = node.images.filter(i => i.category === 'action-buttons');
  const missing = [];
  if (!node.images.some(i => i.category === 'full-page' && i.sourceVariant === 'masked')) missing.push('无脱敏完整页面图');
  if (!buttons.length) missing.push(node.buttonDetectionNote || '未采集底部业务按钮图');
  if (!specials.length) missing.push('无特殊字段局部图（当前页面未暴露或规则不适用）');
  return {
    nodeId: node.nodeId, name: node.nodeName, status: status(node),
    fullPage: yesNo(node.images, 'full-page'),
    segments: node.images.filter(i => i.category === 'page-segment').length,
    actionButtons: yesNo(node.images, 'action-buttons'),
    specialFields: specials.length ? specials.join('、') : '无',
    verifiedButtons: (verifiedByNode.get(Number(node.nodeId)) || []).join(' / ') || '无',
    wordChapter: wordChapter(node),
    missing: missing.join('；') || '无',
  };
}).sort((a, b) => rowsOrder(a.nodeId) - rowsOrder(b.nodeId));
function rowsOrder(id) {
  const order = [27, 14, 32, 30, 37, 48, 42, 7, 24];
  const i = order.indexOf(Number(id)); return i < 0 ? 999 : i;
}

const visited = new Set(index.nodes.map(n => Number(n.nodeId)));
const unvisited = map.nodes.filter(n => !visited.has(Number(n.nodeId)))
  .map(n => `${n.name} [${n.nodeId}]`);
const lines = [
  '# Z1775 真实 Debug 截图覆盖报告', '',
  `生成时间：${new Date().toISOString()}`,
  `实例：\`${index.instanceId || '—'}\`；版本：${index.version || '—'}`, '',
  '## 一、按节点覆盖情况', '',
  '| 节点 | 实际访问状态 | 完整页面图 | 分段数 | 底部按钮图 | 特殊字段图 | 已实际验证按钮 | 对应 Word 章节 | 缺失原因 |',
  '|---|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|',
  ...rows.map(r => `| ${r.name} [${r.nodeId}] | ${r.status} | ${r.fullPage} | ${r.segments} | ${r.actionButtons} | ${r.specialFields} | ${r.verifiedButtons} | ${r.wordChapter} | ${r.missing} |`),
  '', '## 二、统计', '',
  `- 实际进入并采集截图的节点：${index.nodes.length} 个。`,
  `- 脱敏完整页面图：${index.statistics.fullPage} 个；底部业务按钮图：${index.statistics.actionButtons} 个；特殊字段图：${index.statistics.specialFields} 张。`,
  `- 质量门禁：${JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(path.dirname(args.index), 'screenshot-quality.json'), 'utf-8')).ok ? '通过' : '未通过'}。`,
  `- 29 个人工按钮 / 17 个自动网关分支中，8 个按钮经实际流转验证；未点击项保持「配置确认、实际未验证」。`,
  `- 未进入节点（仅有 Workflow/XSN 配置证据，无真实 Debug 截图）：${unvisited.join('、') || '无'}。`, '',
  '## 三、限制与来源说明', '',
  '- 历史只读快照只还原页面结构与字段布局，不增加新的提交或审批验证。',
  '- 实时截图与历史快照均来自专用 Chrome CDP；文档图已遮盖字段值与身份信息，原始图保存在各节点 `original/` 子目录。',
  '- node27 当前调试身份非申请人；调试控制台“模拟登录”候选仅返回参数缺失提示，未获得可用切换入口，因此未提交该节点动作。',
  '- 条件切换前后对比图未在本次采集中完整获得；动态必填链以提交响应、补填日志和字段差异证据说明，不伪造截图。',
];
fs.writeFileSync(args.output, lines.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf-8');
fs.writeFileSync(args.output.replace(/\.md$/, '.json'), JSON.stringify({ rows, unvisited, statistics: index.statistics }, null, 2), 'utf-8');
console.log(args.output);

=== END scripts/v12-screenshot-coverage-report.mjs
=== scripts/v12-stability-browser-check.mjs
// Read-only existing tabs plus a disposable local fixture. No workflow requests are sent.
import {chromium} from 'playwright-core';
import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {scanFormState, repairPass, dismissDialogs} from '../src/form-autofill.mjs';
const browser=await chromium.connectOverCDP('http://127.0.0.1:9222',{timeout:15000});
let fixture;
try {
 const context=browser.contexts()[0];
 const observations=[];
 for(const page of context.pages()) {
  if(!page.url().includes('/infoplus/form/')) continue;
  const state=await page.evaluate(()=>{
   const e=window.$$?.entity;
   return e?{name:e.step?.name,step:e.step?.flowStepId,instanceId:e.step?.instanceId,
    status:e.step?.status,executable:e.permission?.executable,
    debugMarker:/正在调试模式|debug mode/i.test(document.querySelector('#FormCommandDebug')?.textContent||''),
    fields:Object.keys(e.fields||{}).length,actions:(e.actions||[]).length}:null;
  }).catch(()=>null);
  if(state) observations.push(state);
 }
 fixture=await context.newPage();
 await fixture.route('**/*',route=>route.abort());
 await fixture.setContent(`<table><tr><td>联系电话</td><td><input id="fieldPhone" name="fieldPhone" value="bad"></td></tr></table>
 <div class="fieldPhoneformError formError">请输入正确的联系方式</div>
 <div class="dialog display" id="validation">请输入正确的联系方式<button onclick="this.parentNode.remove()">确定</button></div>
 <div class="dialog display" id="unknown">未知操作<button onclick="window.unsafe=true">确定</button></div>
 <div class="dialog display" id="danger">删除记录前请填写原因<button onclick="window.unsafe=true">确定</button></div>`);
 const before=await scanFormState(fixture);assert.equal(before.errors[0].satisfied,false);
 const acknowledged=await dismissDialogs(fixture);assert.equal(acknowledged[0].validationPassed,false);
 const repaired=await repairPass(fixture,before,{valueOverrides:{fieldPhone:'13800000000'}});
 assert.equal(repaired.after.errors[0].satisfied,true);
 assert.equal(await fixture.evaluate(()=>Boolean(window.unsafe)),false);
 assert.equal(await fixture.locator('#unknown').count(),1);
 assert.equal(await fixture.locator('#danger').count(),1);
 const report={checkedAt:new Date().toISOString(),liveReadOnly:observations,
  fixture:{passed:true,checks:['invalid nonempty phone','acknowledgement is not success','repair and rescan','unknown and dangerous buttons untouched']},
  endToEnd:'not performed: no live submit, no new instance, existing registered comparison instance not advanced'};
 await writeFile('output/_verification/v12-stability/browser-check.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
 console.log(JSON.stringify({readOnlyPages:observations.length,fixturePassed:true,endToEnd:false}));
} finally {await fixture?.close();await browser.close();}

=== END scripts/v12-stability-browser-check.mjs
=== scripts/v12-walk-flow.mjs
import { bindProgress, reconcileProgress } from '../src/debug-progress.mjs';
/**
 * InfoPlus PRD Skill V1.2 — 通用 Debug 逐节点完整走查循环
 *
 * 固化循环：进入节点 → 识别身份 → 采集全部字段 → 采集全部按钮 → 分析业务条件
 *          → 填写测试数据 → 处理校验 → 提交 → 核对真实待办与流转 → 保存证据 → 进入下一节点
 *
 * 每步真实流转后立即写 flow-progress.json，支持中断后从当前节点继续执行。
 * 不含任何流程硬编码；动作选择依据 Workflow 连线 + 通用正向/负向语义。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { scanFormState, captureNodeBundle } from '../src/form-autofill.mjs';
import { chooseDebugIdentity } from '../src/debug-runtime.mjs';
import { parseWorkflowMermaid, buildButtonMap } from '../src/node-button-map.mjs';

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, cur, i, arr) => {
  if (cur.startsWith('--')) acc.push([cur.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]);
  return acc;
}, []));
for (const k of ['dir', 'instance', 'scope', 'workflow', 'evidence']) {
  if (!args[k]) { console.error(`MISSING --${k}`); process.exit(2); }
}
const toolRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const repairScript = path.join(toolRoot, 'scripts', 'v12-repair-and-submit.mjs');
const maxSteps = Number(args['max-steps'] || 25);
const evidenceDir = args.evidence;
fs.mkdirSync(evidenceDir, { recursive: true });
const write = (name, data) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join(evidenceDir, name), typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf-8');

const parsed = parseWorkflowMermaid(fs.readFileSync(args.workflow, 'utf-8'));
const nodeName = id => parsed.nodes.find(n => n.nodeId === Number(id))?.name || `节点${id}`;

// 正向动作优先（正常办理路径）；负向动作（退回/终止/重选/特殊转办）不在正常路径中自动点击
const NEGATIVE = /退回|重新选择|终止|撤销|否决|不通过|拒绝|return|reject|kill|select again|terminate|cancel/i;
const POSITIVE = [/报销已完成/, /提交并打印/, /申请人提交并打印/, /审核通过/, /^提交\/Submit$/, /^重新提交\/Submit again$/, /^确定$/, /^继续$/];
function chooseAction(actions) {
  const candidates = (actions || []).filter(a => a.visible !== false && !NEGATIVE.test(a.name || ''));
  for (const re of POSITIVE) {
    const hit = candidates.find(a => re.test(a.name || ''));
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  return candidates[0] || null;
}

const progressPath = path.join(evidenceDir, 'flow-progress.json');
let progress = fs.existsSync(progressPath) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(progressPath, 'utf-8')) : { trace: [], visited: [] };
progress = bindProgress(progress, args.instance);

const CDP = process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/';
let browser = null;
const connect = async () => {
  if (!browser) browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(CDP, { timeout: 25000 });
  return browser.contexts()[0];
};
const release = async () => { if (browser) { await browser.close().catch(() => {}); browser = null; } };
const findPage = async ctx => {
  for (const p of ctx.pages()) {
    if (!/one\.zju\.edu\.cn\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render/.test(p.url())) continue;
    const hit = await p.evaluate(iid => window.$$?.entity?.step?.instanceId === iid, args.instance).catch(() => false);
    if (hit) return p;
  }
  return null;
};

for (let step = 1; step <= maxSteps; step++) {
  const ctx = await connect();
  const page = await findPage(ctx);
  if (!page) {
    write('flow-blocked.json', { reason: 'instance-page-not-found', at: step, progress });
    console.log('BLOCKED: 未找到当前实例页面'); break;
  }
  await page.bringToFront().catch(() => {});
  let state = await scanFormState(page);
  reconcileProgress(progress, state.step);

  // V1.2 断点恢复：当前步骤已完成(status=2)时，动作其实已成功；按真实待办链接切到下一节点，绝不重复提交。
  if (state.step?.status === 2) {
    const tasks = await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].map(a => {
      const href = a.getAttribute('href');
      const m = href && href.match(/\/infoplus\/form\/(\d+)\/render/);
      if (!m || !href.includes('entrust=true')) return null;
      return { step: Number(m[1]), name: a.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), url: new URL(href, location.href).href };
    }).filter(Boolean));
    write('pending-tasks.json', tasks);
    if (tasks.length) {
      const target = tasks[0];
      console.log('ADVANCE to pending task', target.name, target.step);
      await page.goto(target.url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT || 30000) });
      await page.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('input[name=chooseEntrustee]') || !!window.$$?.entity?.step,
        undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
      const identity = await chooseDebugIdentity(page, { preferCandidate: true, allowCurrentLoginInterstitial: true });
      await page.waitForFunction(() => !!window.$$?.entity?.step, undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
      progress.identitySwitches ||= [];
      progress.identitySwitches.push({ from: state.step?.name, to: target.name, identity, at: new Date().toISOString() });
      state = await scanFormState(page);
      write('flow-progress.json', progress);
    }
  }
  const nodeId = state.step?.stepId;
  const nodeNameCur = state.step?.name || '';

  // 结束判定：完成节点 / 状态已完成 / 无可办理动作
  if (!nodeId || state.step?.status === 2 || /完成|Finished|Completed/i.test(nodeNameCur)) {
    progress.awaitingVerification = { nodeId, name: nodeNameCur, status: state.step?.status, reason:'步骤完成或缺少待办不证明实例结束', at: new Date().toISOString() };
    write('flow-progress.json', progress);
    console.log('FINISHED', JSON.stringify(progress.awaitingVerification)); break;
  }
  // 断点恢复：若停在上次最后访问的同一节点，回退该未完成记录后继续，不视为死循环
  const lastVisited = progress.visited.at(-1);
  if (nodeId === lastVisited && progress.trace.at(-1)?.nodeId === nodeId) {
    // Preserve prior observations when resuming; never discard the interrupted evidence.
    progress.resumed = { nodeId, name: nodeNameCur, at: new Date().toISOString() };
    console.log('RESUME from', nodeId, nodeNameCur);
  } else if (progress.visited.includes(nodeId)) {
    write('flow-blocked.json', { reason: 'revisited-node', nodeId, name: nodeNameCur, trace: progress.trace });
    console.log('BLOCKED: 重复进入节点，避免死循环', nodeId, nodeNameCur); break;
  }

  const action = chooseAction(state.entityActions);
  if (!action) {
    write('flow-blocked.json', { reason: 'no-positive-action', nodeId, name: nodeNameCur, actions: state.entityActions });
    console.log('BLOCKED: 未找到可执行正向动作', nodeNameCur, state.entityActions); break;
  }

  // 节点级完整采集（进入时状态：字段/按钮/整页截图）
  const slug = `s${String(step).padStart(2, '0')}-node${nodeId}-${nodeNameCur.replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')}`;
  const nodeDir = path.join(evidenceDir, slug);
  const bundle = await captureNodeBundle(page, nodeDir, slug);
  const prev = progress.trace.at(-1);
  const fieldDiff = prev?.fields ? {
    added: state.fields.filter(f => !prev.fields.some(x => x.id === f.id)).map(f => ({ id: f.id, label: f.label, type: f.type })),
    permissionChanged: state.fields.filter(f => prev.fields.some(x => x.id === f.id && x.permission !== f.permission))
      .map(f => ({ id: f.id, label: f.label, from: prev.fields.find(x => x.id === f.id).permission, to: f.permission })),
    valueChanged: state.fields.filter(f => prev.fields.some(x => x.id === f.id && x.value !== f.value))
      .map(f => ({ id: f.id, label: f.label, from: String(prev.fields.find(x => x.id === f.id).value).slice(0, 60), to: String(f.value).slice(0, 60) })),
  } : null;
  write(`${slug}-diff.json`, { from: prev ? { nodeId: prev.nodeId, name: prev.name } : null,
    to: { nodeId, name: nodeNameCur }, fieldDiff,
    buttons: state.commandButtons.map(b => ({ text: b.text, actionId: b.actionId, kill: b.kill, tip: b.tip, visible: b.visible })),
    entityActions: state.entityActions });

  progress.visited.push(nodeId);
  progress.trace.push({ step, nodeId, name: nodeNameCur, flowStepId: state.step?.flowStepId,
    identity: state.identity, commandButtons: state.commandButtons.map(b => ({ text: b.text, actionId: b.actionId, kill: b.kill, tip: b.tip })),
    entityActions: state.entityActions, fields: state.fields, fieldCount: state.fieldCount,
    screenshot: bundle.summary.screenshot, chosenAction: action, at: state.capturedAt });
  write('flow-progress.json', progress);
  console.log(`[step ${step}] node${nodeId} ${nodeNameCur} | actions=${state.entityActions.map(a => a.name).join(' / ')} | fields=${state.fieldCount}`);

  // 释放 CDP 后调用修复+提交脚本（其内部会再次核验 DEBUG、补填、提交、采集新节点）
  await release();
  const subDir = path.join(evidenceDir, `${slug}-transition`);
  const proc = spawnSync(process.execPath, [repairScript,
    '--url', String(state.step.flowStepId || ''), '--dir', args.dir, '--instance', args.instance,
    '--scope', args.scope, '--action', action.name,
    '--attachment', args.attachment || '', '--evidence', subDir, '--max-rounds', args['max-rounds'] || '10'],
    { cwd: toolRoot, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 110000, maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024 });
  const out = (proc.stdout || '').trim();
  write(`${slug}-transition.log`, out + '\n' + (proc.stderr || ''));
  let result = {};
  try { result = JSON.parse(out.split('\n').filter(l => l.startsWith('OUTCOME')).at(-1)?.replace(/^OUTCOME\s*/, '') || '{}'); } catch (_) {}
  if (!result.success) {
    progress.blocked = { nodeId, name: nodeNameCur, reason: result.reason || 'submit-failed',
      detail: path.join(subDir, 'blocked.json'), at: new Date().toISOString() };
    write('flow-progress.json', progress);
    write('flow-blocked.json', progress.blocked);
    console.log('BLOCKED at', nodeNameCur, result.reason || 'submit-failed'); break;
  }
  let transition = {};
  try { transition = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(subDir, 'transition.json'), 'utf-8')); } catch (_) {}
  progress.trace.at(-1).transition = { to: transition.to, nextRender: transition.nextRender,
    nextTasks: transition.nextTasks, actualAction: action.name,
    buttonsAfter: (transition.newButtons || []).filter(b => b.visible).map(b => ({ text: b.text, actionId: b.actionId, kill: b.kill })) };
  write('flow-progress.json', progress);
  console.log(`  -> ${transition.to?.name || '?'} [${transition.to?.stepId || '?'}]`);
}

// 生成按钮-分支映射（叠加本轮实测）
const observedButtons = {};
const verifiedActions = [];
for (const t of progress.trace) {
  if (t.nodeId) observedButtons[t.nodeId] = (t.commandButtons || []).map(b => ({ text: b.text, actionId: b.actionId, kill: b.kill, tip: b.tip }));
  if (t.chosenAction && t.transition?.to) verifiedActions.push({
    nodeId: t.nodeId, label: t.chosenAction.name, instanceId: args.instance,
    actualTargetNodeId: t.transition.to.stepId, actualTargetName: t.transition.to.name,
  });
}
const map = buildButtonMap(parsed, { observedButtons, verifiedActions });
write('button-branch-map.json', map);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(evidenceDir, 'button-branch-map.md'),
  `# 节点按钮与分支映射（实测叠加）\n\n节点数 ${map.nodeCount}，连线数 ${map.transitionCount}\n\n` +
  (await import('../src/node-button-map.mjs')).buttonMapToMarkdown(map) + '\n', 'utf-8');

await release();
console.log('FLOW_DONE', JSON.stringify({ visited: progress.visited, finished: progress.finished || null, blocked: progress.blocked || null }));

=== END scripts/v12-walk-flow.mjs
=== scripts/v121-contact-sheet.ps1
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$InputDirectory,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$OutputDirectory,
  [int]$Columns=3,
  [int]$Rows=4,
  [int]$ThumbnailWidth=300
)
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$source=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $InputDirectory).Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutputDirectory | Out-Null
$files=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $source -Filter 'page-*.png' -File | Sort-Object Name
$perSheet=$Columns*$Rows
for($start=0;$start -lt $files.Count;$start+=$perSheet){
  $group=@($files | Select-Object -Skip $start -First $perSheet)
  $sample=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($group[0].FullName)
  try {
    $ratio=$sample.Height/$sample.Width
    $thumbHeight=[int]($ThumbnailWidth*$ratio)
    $gap=18
    $labelHeight=30
    $canvasWidth=$Columns*($ThumbnailWidth+$gap)+$gap
    $canvasHeight=$Rows*($thumbHeight+$labelHeight+$gap)+$gap
  } finally { $sample.Dispose() }
  $canvas=New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($canvasWidth,$canvasHeight)
  $graphics=[System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($canvas)
  try {
    $graphics.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(235,238,241))
    $font=New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Microsoft YaHei',12)
    $brush=[System.Drawing.Brushes]::Black
    for($index=0;$index -lt $group.Count;$index++){
      $row=[math]::Floor($index/$Columns)
      $column=$index%$Columns
      $x=$gap+$column*($ThumbnailWidth+$gap)
      $y=$gap+$row*($thumbHeight+$labelHeight+$gap)
      $image=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($group[$index].FullName)
      try {
        $graphics.DrawImage($image,$x,$y,$ThumbnailWidth,$thumbHeight)
        $graphics.DrawString($group[$index].BaseName,$font,$brush,$x,$y+$thumbHeight+4)
      } finally { $image.Dispose() }
    }
    $font.Dispose()
    $sheetNumber=[int][math]::Floor($start/$perSheet+1)
    $sheet=Join-Path $OutputDirectory ('sheet-{0:00}.jpg' -f $sheetNumber)
    $canvas.Save($sheet,[System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Jpeg)
    Write-Output $sheet
  } finally {
    $graphics.Dispose()
    $canvas.Dispose()
  }
}

=== END scripts/v121-contact-sheet.ps1
=== scripts/v121-export-word-render.ps1
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$InputDirectory,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$OutputDirectory,
  [string]$Name='*.docx'
)
$renderSource=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $InputDirectory).Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutputDirectory | Out-Null
$renderTarget=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $OutputDirectory).Path
$word=New-Object -ComObject Word.Application
$word.Visible=$false
$word.DisplayAlerts=0
try {
  foreach($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $renderSource -Filter $Name -File) {
    if($file.Name -like '_*' -or $file.Name -like '*.pending.docx') { continue }
    $doc=$null
    try {
      $doc=$word.Documents.Open($file.FullName,$false,$true)
      $pdf=Join-Path $renderTarget ($file.BaseName+'.pdf')
      $doc.ExportAsFixedFormat($pdf,17)
      Write-Output ('EXPORTED '+$pdf+' PAGES '+$doc.ComputeStatistics(2))
    } finally { if($null -ne $doc){ $doc.Close($false) } }
  }
} finally { $word.Quit() }

=== END scripts/v121-export-word-render.ps1
=== scripts/v121-recapture-snapshots.mjs
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { captureFullForm } from '../src/full-form-capture.mjs';

const directory = path.resolve(process.argv[2]);
const root = path.join(directory, 'debug-evidence');
const index = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.json'), 'utf8'));
const urls = {
  14: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15556116/render?snapshot=true',
  27: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15556127/render?entrust=true',
  32: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15556056/render?snapshot=true',
  30: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15556057/render?snapshot=true',
  37: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15555969/render?snapshot=true',
  48: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15555924/render?snapshot=true',
  42: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15555899/render?snapshot=true',
  7: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15555553/render?snapshot=true',
  24: 'https://one.zju.edu.cn/infoplus/form/15555527/render?snapshot=true',
};
const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/', { timeout: 25000 });
const page = await browser.contexts()[0].newPage();
const results = [];
try {
  for (const [position, node] of index.nodes.entries()) {
    try {
      await page.route('**/*', route => /\/interface\/(doAction|start|save)(?:\?|$)/i.test(route.request().url())
        ? route.abort() : route.continue());
      await page.goto(urls[node.nodeId], { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
      await page.waitForFunction(() => !!window.$$?.entity?.step, undefined, { timeout: 20000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
      const meta = {
        index: position + 1, nodeId: node.nodeId, nodeName: node.nodeName,
        flowStepId: node.flowStepId, instanceId: node.instanceId, url: page.url(),
        pageType: node.pageType, capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        source: node.pageType === 'live-debug' ? '当前 Debug 表单只读采集' : '同一实例历史只读表单',
      };
      const shot = await captureFullForm(page, meta, { root });
      Object.assign(node, {
        images: shot.images, folder: path.relative(root, shot.folder),
        pageChecks: shot.pageChecks, metrics: { width: shot.metrics.width, height: shot.metrics.height },
        source: shot.source,
        verificationNote: node.pageType === 'historical-snapshot'
          ? '历史只读页面；证明页面结构，不证明新条件切换或新动作'
          : '当前实时节点；未在本轮重复提交动作',
        buttonDetectionNote: shot.buttonDetectionNote, buttonsDetected: [], error: undefined,
      });
      results.push({ node: node.nodeId, eligible: shot.images.filter(image => image.quality?.eligible).length,
        complete: shot.pageChecks.complete, width: shot.metrics.width, height: shot.metrics.height });
      console.log(JSON.stringify(results.at(-1)));
    } catch (error) {
      Object.assign(node, { images: [], error: String(error.message || error).slice(0, 180) });
      results.push({ node: node.nodeId, error: node.error });
      console.log(JSON.stringify(results.at(-1)));
    }
    await page.unrouteAll().catch(() => {});
  }
} finally {
  await page.close().catch(() => {});
  await browser.close().catch(() => {});
}
await fs.mkdir(path.join(directory, 'reports/v1.2.1'), { recursive: true });
await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.json'), JSON.stringify(index, null, 2) + '\n');
await fs.writeFile(path.join(directory, 'reports/v1.2.1/recapture.json'), JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log('RECAPTURE_DONE', JSON.stringify(results));
