=== scripts/v121-refresh-screenshot-index.mjs
/**
 * Refresh screenshot-index statistics and the Markdown index from the
 * authoritative JSON after an evidence-reclassification pass.
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const indexFile = path.resolve(process.argv[2] || 'debug-evidence/screenshot-index.json');
const root = path.dirname(indexFile);
const index = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(indexFile, 'utf8'));

index.generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
index.statistics = {
  nodes: index.nodes.length,
  fullPage: index.nodes.filter(node => (node.images || [])
    .some(image => image.category === 'full-page' && image.sourceVariant === 'masked')).length,
  actionButtons: index.nodes.filter(node => (node.images || [])
    .some(image => image.category === 'action-buttons')).length,
  specialFields: index.nodes.reduce((count, node) => count + (node.images || [])
    .filter(image => image.category === 'special-field').length, 0),
  images: index.nodes.reduce((count, node) => count + (node.images || []).length, 0),
};

const lines = [
  '# 真实 Debug 截图索引',
  '',
  `实例：\`${index.instanceId || '—'}\`；来源：${index.source || '—'}`,
  '',
  `节点 ${index.statistics.nodes} 个；完整页面 ${index.statistics.fullPage} 个；底部按钮 ${index.statistics.actionButtons} 个；特殊字段 ${index.statistics.specialFields} 个；图片 ${index.statistics.images} 张。`,
  '',
  '| 节点 | 来源 | 完整页面 | 分段 | 底部按钮 | 特殊字段 | 实际按钮 | 文档目录 |',
  '|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|',
];

for (const node of index.nodes) {
  const count = category => (node.images || []).filter(image => image.category === category).length;
  lines.push(`| ${node.nodeName} [${node.nodeId}] | ${node.pageType || '—'} | ${count('full-page') ? '有' : '无'} | ${count('page-segment')} | ${count('action-buttons') ? '有' : '无'} | ${count('special-field')} | ${(node.buttonsDetected || []).join(' / ') || '未暴露'} | ${node.folder || '—'} |`);
}

lines.push('', '完整页面原始图保存在各节点 `original/` 子目录；文档使用脱敏图。历史快照只证明页面结构，不增加新的已验证动作。');
fs.writeFileSync(indexFile, JSON.stringify(index, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.md'), lines.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
console.log(JSON.stringify(index.statistics));

=== END scripts/v121-refresh-screenshot-index.mjs
=== scripts/v121-restore-button-evidence.mjs
/**
 * V1.2.1: restore validated action-button crops from the same DEBUG instance.
 * The recapture pass intentionally replaces all page images; this script adds back only
 * button pictures whose source and labels were already confirmed in the pre-recapture index.
 */
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { cropBottomRegion, pngInfo } from '../src/screenshot-evidence.mjs';
import { screenshotValue } from '../src/screenshot-quality.mjs';

const directory = path.resolve(process.argv[2]);
const root = path.join(directory, 'debug-evidence');
const sourceIndex = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(directory, 'reports/v1.2.1/screenshot-index-before.json'), 'utf8'));
const cropSources = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(directory, 'button-crop-sources.json'), 'utf8'));
const index = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.json'), 'utf8'));
const byNode = new Map(index.nodes.map(node => [Number(node.nodeId), node]));
const browser = await chromium.connectOverCDP(process.env.INFOPLUS_CDP || 'http://127.0.0.1:9222/', { timeout: 25000 });
const results = [];
try {
  for (const old of sourceIndex.nodes) {
    const nodeId = Number(old.nodeId);
    const node = byNode.get(nodeId);
    const oldButton = (old.images || []).find(image => image.category === 'action-buttons');
    const source = cropSources[String(nodeId)];
    if (!node || !oldButton || !source) continue;
    const labels = source.labels || [];
    if (!labels.length) continue;
    const target = path.join(root, node.folder, 'action-buttons.png');
    const info = await cropBottomRegion(browser, source.file, target,
      { height: source.cropHeight || 420, excludeBottom: source.excludeBottom || 55 });
    const bytes = await fs.readFile(target);
    const image = {
      file: target, category: 'action-buttons', sourceVariant: 'masked',
      nodeId, width: info.width, height: info.height, bytes: bytes.length,
      sha256: createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),
      labels, detection: 'live-full-page-bottom-crop',
      title: '底部业务操作按钮', purpose: '从同一 DEBUG 实例实时办理完整截图裁剪的底部业务操作按钮区',
      reviewed: true,
    };
    image.quality = screenshotValue(image, { nodeId });
    node.images = [...node.images.filter(item => item.category !== 'action-buttons'), image];
    node.buttonsDetected = labels;
    node.buttonDetectionNote = `来源：${source.file}（同一 DEBUG 实例实时办理完整截图底部裁剪）；历史只读表单只证明页面结构。`;
    results.push({ nodeId, width: info.width, height: info.height, labels: labels.length });
  }
} finally {
  await browser.close().catch(() => {});
}
for (const node of index.nodes) {
  node.folder = path.relative(path.dirname(root), node.folder).replace(/\\/g, '/');
  node.images = node.images.map(image => ({ ...image,
    file: path.relative(path.dirname(root), image.file).replace(/\\/g, '/') }));
}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, 'screenshot-index.json'), JSON.stringify(index, null, 2) + '\n');
await fs.writeFile(path.join(directory, 'reports/v1.2.1/restore-buttons.json'), JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log('RESTORE_BUTTONS', JSON.stringify(results));

=== END scripts/v121-restore-button-evidence.mjs
=== scripts/v13-docs-update.mjs
import fs from 'node:fs';
const edit=(f,fn)=>fs.writeFileSync(f,fn(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')));

const reviewed = [];
for (const rule of bundle.rules) {
  const text = notes[rule.kind]?.[rule.id];
  if (!text) continue;
  reviewed.push({
    id: rule.id,
    kind: rule.kind,
    interpretation: text,
    sha256: createHash('sha256').update(rule.expression).digest('hex'),
  });
}

const missing = Object.entries(notes).flatMap(([kind, map]) =>
  Object.keys(map).filter(id => !reviewed.some(item => item.id === id && item.kind === kind))
    .map(id => `${kind}/${id}`));
if (missing.length) throw new Error(`未匹配的规则：${missing.join('、')}`);

await writeFile(`${directory}/reviewed-rules.json`, JSON.stringify(reviewed, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(`已写入 ${reviewed.length} 条业务判读`);

=== src/analyze.mjs
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { analyzePathCoverage } from './path-coverage.mjs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { entity, parseWorkflow } from './infoplus.mjs';
import { enrichField, fieldAnalysisVersion, readStaticPanels, readTemplateDefaults } from './field-options.mjs';
import { readFieldIndex, readOptionEvidence } from './option-evidence.mjs';
import { buildStagePages, stageAnalysisVersion, stageProfile } from './stage-pages.mjs';
import { debugProbeFile, readDebugProbe } from './debug-probe.mjs';
import { buildNodeEvidence, nodeEvidenceVersion } from './node-evidence.mjs';
import { readDebugRuns, debugRuntimeFile, runtimeSummary, memberScopeDescription } from './debug-runtime.mjs';
import {analyzeStageFields} from './stage-field-differences.mjs';

export const json = async path => JSON.parse((await readFile(path, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
const optional = async path => {
  try { return await json(path); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
};

const idOf = value => {
  const id = value && typeof value === 'object' ? value.id : value;
  return ['string', 'number'].includes(typeof id) ? String(id) : '';
};
function readPath(data, pointer) {
  if (pointer === '') return data;
  if (typeof pointer !== 'string' || !pointer.startsWith('/')) return;
  return pointer.slice(1).split('/').reduce((value, key) => {
    const part = key.replaceAll('~1', '/').replaceAll('~0', '~');
    return value && Object.hasOwn(value, part) ? value[part] : undefined;
  }, data);
}

export function normalizeWorkflow(raw, mapping, source) {
  const nodes = readPath(raw, mapping.nodes);
  const transitions = readPath(raw, mapping.transitions);
  if (!Array.isArray(nodes) || !Array.isArray(transitions)) throw new Error('流程映射未指向节点和连线数组');
  const nodeFields = {
    id: '/id', name: '/name', type: '/type', view: '/viewId', actor: '/actor',
    x: '/x', y: '/y', permissions: '/permissions', actions: '/actions', ...mapping.node,
  };
  const edgeFields = {
    source: '/source', target: '/target', name: '/name', condition: '/condition', type: '/type', ...mapping.edge,
  };
  const project = (items, fields, collection) => items.map((item, index) => ({
    ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(fields).map(([key, path]) => [key, readPath(item, path)])),
    evidence: `${source}#${collection}/${index}`,
  }));
  return {
    nodes: project(nodes, nodeFields, mapping.nodes).map(item => ({ ...item, id: idOf(item.id), view: idOf(item.view) })),
    transitions: project(transitions, edgeFields, mapping.transitions)
      .map(item => ({ ...item, source: idOf(item.source), target: idOf(item.target) })),
  };
}

export function topology(workflow) {
  const incoming = new Map(workflow.nodes.map(node => [node.id, []]));
  const outgoing = new Map(workflow.nodes.map(node => [node.id, []]));
  for (const edge of workflow.transitions) {
    if (!outgoing.has(edge.source) || !incoming.has(edge.target)) continue;
    outgoing.get(edge.source).push(edge);
    incoming.get(edge.target).push(edge);
  }
  const canReach = (start, end) => {
    const seen = new Set();
    const queue = [start];
    while (queue.length) {
      const node = queue.pop();
      if (node === end) return true;
      if (seen.has(node)) continue;
      seen.add(node);
      for (const edge of outgoing.get(node) ?? []) queue.push(edge.target);
    }
    return false;
  };
  return {
    entries: workflow.nodes.filter(node => incoming.get(node.id).length === 0).map(node => node.id),
    exits: workflow.nodes.filter(node => outgoing.get(node.id).length === 0).map(node => node.id),
    splits: workflow.nodes.filter(node => outgoing.get(node.id).length > 1).map(node => node.id),
    merges: workflow.nodes.filter(node => incoming.get(node.id).length > 1).map(node => node.id),
    cycleTransitions: workflow.transitions.filter(edge =>
      incoming.has(edge.target) && outgoing.has(edge.source) && canReach(edge.target, edge.source))
      .map(edge => edge.evidence),
  };
}

const xsdTypes = {
  string: '文本', boolean: '布尔值', date: '日期', dateTime: '日期时间',
  time: '时间', decimal: '数字', int: '整数', integer: '整数',
  double: '数字', float: '数字', base64Binary: '二进制（控件类型待确认）',
};
const controls = {
  PlainText: '单行文本', RichText: '富文本', DropDown: '下拉选择',
  OptionButton: '单选', CheckBox: '复选', FileAttachment: '附件',
  DTPicker: '日期', DatePicker: '日期',
};

export async function analyze(directory) {
  const project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
  const network = await optional(join(directory, 'raw', 'network', 'index.json'));
  const fieldIndex = await readFieldIndex(directory, network);
  const optionEvidence = await readOptionEvidence(directory, project);
  const mapping = await optional(join(directory, 'workflow-map.json'));
  const diagramObservation = await optional(join(directory, 'raw', 'editor-observation.json'));
  const evidence = [{ source: project.source, file: 'project.json', kind: 'IDE 页面记录' }];
  if (fieldIndex.source) evidence.push({ file: fieldIndex.source, kind: 'IDE 字段表' });
  for (const file of new Set(optionEvidence.map(item => item.file))) evidence.push({ file, kind: '字段选项证据' });
  const issues = await optional(join(directory, 'scan-issues.json')) ?? [];
  const observed = network?.captured ?? [];
  const latest = (kind, path) => observed.findLast(item => item.kind === kind && item.source.endsWith(path));
  const readItem = async item => {
    if (!item || basename(item.file) !== item.file) throw new Error('无效的采集资源路径');
    const file = `raw/network/${item.file}`;
    evidence.push({ source: item.source, file, kind: item.kind });
    return { file, data: await json(join(directory, file)) };
  };
  let workflow = { nodes: [], transitions: [] };
  const workflowItem = latest('workflow', '/findWorkflowDefinition');
  if (mapping) {
    const item = observed.find(r => r.kind === 'workflow' && r.file === mapping.file);
    if (!item || basename(item.file) !== item.file) throw new Error('流程映射未引用已导入的工作流响应');
    const source = `raw/network/${item.file}`;
    workflow = normalizeWorkflow(await json(join(directory, source)), mapping, source);
    evidence.push({ source: item.source, file: source, kind: '工作流响应' });
  } else if (workflowItem) {
    const { file, data } = await readItem(workflowItem);
    workflow = parseWorkflow(data, project, file) ?? workflow;
    if (!workflow.nodes.length) issues.push('工作流响应未返回有效定义');
    else {
      project.published = workflow.released;
      project.releaseEvidence = `${file}#/entities/0/released`;
    }
  } else {
    issues.push('缺少工作流响应体');
  }
  const formItem = observed.findLast(item => item.kind === 'form' && item.source.endsWith('/findFormTemplate') &&
    (!workflow.form || item.templateId === workflow.form));
  const form = formItem && await readItem(formItem);
  const formEntity = entity(form?.data);
  const formViews = new Map();
  if (Array.isArray(formEntity?.formFields) && formEntity.formTemplateId === formItem.templateId) {
    const record = (template, pointer) => formViews.set(template.formTemplateId, { template, pointer });
    record(formEntity, '#/entities/0');
    (formEntity.templateViews ?? []).forEach((template, index) => record(template, `#/entities/0/templateViews/${index}`));
  } else {
    issues.push('缺少有效的 findFormTemplate 响应，字段清单仅依据静态模板');
  }
  const viewsItem = latest('views', '/views');
  const viewIndex = viewsItem && await readItem(viewsItem);
  const indexedViews = viewIndex?.data.views ?? project.views ?? [];
  if (viewIndex && project.expectedViews && indexedViews.length !== project.expectedViews) {
    issues.push('HAR 视图目录与 IDE 索引数量不一致');
  }
  const fields = [];
  const views = [];
  for (const meta of indexedViews) {
    if (!/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(meta.id)) throw new Error('视图 ID 格式错误');
    const path = `views/${meta.id}/xsn.json`;
    const xsn = await optional(join(directory, path));
    const view = { ...meta, source: viewIndex?.file ?? 'project.json', packageViews: [], rules: xsn?.rules ?? [] };
    if (!xsn) {
      view.templateMissing = true;
    } else {
      evidence.push({ source: meta.xsn, file: path, kind: 'XSN 静态解析' });
      view.packageViews = xsn.views.map(v => ({
        ...v, screenshot: v.screenshot && `views/${meta.id}/${v.screenshot}`,
      }));
      view.screenshot = view.packageViews.find(v => v.screenshot)?.screenshot;
      for (const child of view.packageViews.filter(v => v.issue || !v.screenshot)) {
        issues.push(`「${meta.name} / ${child.name}」静态预览失败`);
      }
    }
    const apiView = formViews.get(meta.id);
    const [panels, template] = await Promise.all([readStaticPanels(directory, view), readTemplateDefaults(directory, meta.id)]);
    for (const panel of panels) evidence.push({ file: panel.source, kind: 'XSN 控件配置' });
    if (template.source) evidence.push({ file: template.source, kind: 'XSN 默认数据' });
    const configs = new Map(fieldIndex.fields.filter(item => item.viewId === meta.id).map(item => [item.id, item]));
    const observations = new Map();
    for (const item of optionEvidence) {
      if ((item.viewId || workflow.form) !== meta.id) continue;
      if (!observations.has(item.fieldId)) observations.set(item.fieldId, []);
      observations.get(item.fieldId).push(item);
    }
    const addField = (field, definition) => fields.push(enrichField({ ...field, viewId: meta.id }, {
      config: configs.get(field.id), definition, panels, runtime: observations.get(field.id) ?? [], schemaSource: path, template,
    }));
    const usagesFor = id => view.packageViews.flatMap(v => v.controls
      .filter(control => control.binding.split('/').at(-1).split(':').at(-1) === id)
      .map(control => ({ ...control, view: v.name })));
    const apiIds = new Set();
    const getType = (type, usages) => controls[usages.find(u => Object.hasOwn(controls, u.kind))?.kind] ??
      xsdTypes[type] ?? (type || '结构或未知');
    for (const [index, field] of (apiView?.template.formFields ?? []).entries()) {
      const id = field.fieldName;
      apiIds.add(id);
      const usages = usagesFor(id);
      const schema = xsn?.fields.find(item => item.name === id);
      addField({
        id, name: field.label || field.description || usages.find(control => control.title)?.title || id,
        type: getType(field.fieldType, usages), apiType: field.fieldType,
        groupName: field.groupName, repeatDepth: field.repeatDepth,
        required: null, defaultValue: schema?.defaultValue, enumeration: schema?.enumeration,
        usages, view: meta.name, evidence: `${form.file}${apiView.pointer}/formFields/${index}`,
      }, field);
    }
    if (!apiView && formViews.size) issues.push(`「${meta.name}」未匹配接口字段`);
    view.apiFieldCount = apiView?.template.formFields?.length;
    for (const [index, field] of (xsn?.fields ?? []).entries()) {
      if (!field.name || apiIds.has(field.name)) continue;
      const references = xsn.fields.filter(item => item.ref.split(':').at(-1) === field.name);
      const type = (field.type || field.restriction[0] || '').split(':').at(-1);
      const usages = usagesFor(field.name);
      addField({
        id: field.name, name: usages.find(control => control.title)?.title || field.name,
        type: getType(type, usages),
        required: null, defaultValue: field.defaultValue, enumeration: field.enumeration,
        schemaReferences: references, usages, view: meta.name,
        evidence: `${path}#/fields/${index}`,
      });
    }
    views.push(view);
  }
  if (diagramObservation) evidence.push({
    source: project.editor, file: 'raw/editor-observation.json', kind: '编辑器图中文字',
  });
  const viewIds = new Set(views.map(view => view.id));
  for (const node of workflow.nodes) {
    if (node.view && !viewIds.has(node.view)) issues.push(`节点「${node.name ?? node.id}」视图关联未解析`);
  }
  const rules = [
    ...workflow.nodes.filter(node => node.script).map(node => ({
      kind: node.type, id: node.id, name: node.name, expression: node.script, evidence: node.evidence + '/script',
    })),
    ...workflow.transitions.flatMap(edge => [
      edge.script && { kind: '动作脚本', expression: edge.script, evidence: edge.evidence + '/script' },
      edge.restrictScript && { kind: '动作限制', expression: edge.restrictScript, evidence: edge.evidence + '/restrictScript' },
    ].filter(Boolean).map(rule => ({ ...rule, id: edge.id, name: edge.name }))),
  ];
  const reviewed = await optional(join(directory, 'reviewed-rules.json')) ?? [];
  for (const rule of rules) {
    const sha256 = createHash('sha256').update(rule.expression).digest('hex');
    const item = reviewed.find(note => note.id === rule.id && note.kind === rule.kind && note.sha256 === sha256);
    if (item) rule.interpretation = item.interpretation;
  }
  const flowTopology = topology(workflow);
  const stagePages = await buildStagePages(directory, project, workflow, flowTopology, views, await stageProfile(project));
  let debug = await readDebugProbe(directory, project);
  const debugRuns = await readDebugRuns(directory, project);
  const history = await optional(join(directory, 'raw/debug-history-evidence.json'));
  const debugHistory = history?.version === project.version && history?.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId &&
    debugRuns?.runs.some(run => run.instanceId === history.instanceId) ? history : undefined;
  const manualReference = await optional(join(directory, 'raw/manual-debug-reference.json'));
  const manualEvidence = manualReference?.code === project.code && manualReference?.version === project.version &&
    manualReference?.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId ? manualReference : undefined;
  if (manualEvidence) evidence.push({ file: 'raw/manual-debug-reference.json', kind: '用户手动 Debug 截图说明，非自动验证' });
  const debugObserved = runtimeSummary(debugRuns);
  if (debugRuns) {
    evidence.push({ file: debugRuntimeFile, kind: '按实例区分的后台 Debug 实际观察' });
    for (const field of fields) {
      const observations = debugObserved.stages.filter(s => s.state.viewId === field.viewId)
        .flatMap(s => s.fields.filter(f => f.id === field.id).map(f => ({ ...f, flowStepId: s.state.flowStepId, node: s.state.name })));
      if (!observations.length) continue;
      const latest = observations.at(-1);
      if (latest.name && latest.name !== field.id) field.name = latest.name;
      field.apiType = latest.type || field.apiType;
      field.debugObservations = observations;
      field.memberScopes = debugObserved.stages.filter(s => s.state.viewId === field.viewId)
        .flatMap(s => s.memberScopes.filter(f => f.fieldId === field.id).map(f => ({ ...f, description:memberScopeDescription(f.settings), node: s.state.name, source: debugRuntimeFile })));
    }
    debug = { ...debug, selectedMode: 'debug', reason: '已在用户授权范围内执行 Debug，覆盖仅以实际实例记录为准',
      entry: debug?.entry ?? { state: 'identity-ready' }, simulatedRoles: debugObserved.roles,
      visitedNodes: debugObserved.observedNodes, verifiedPaths: debugObserved.verifiedPaths, runtime: debugObserved };
  }
  const nodeEvidence = buildNodeEvidence(workflow, stagePages, fields, optionEvidence, debugObserved);
  if (debug) evidence.push({ file: debugProbeFile, kind: 'IDE Debug 入口与隔离检查' });
  for (const stage of stagePages) {
    if (stage.manifest) evidence.push({ source: stage.source, file: stage.manifest, kind: '前台阶段页面' });
    else if (stage.source) evidence.push({ file: stage.source, kind: 'XSN 说明页文字' });
  }
  const linkedEvidencePath = 'raw/cross-flow-evidence.json';
  const linkedEvidence = await optional(join(directory, linkedEvidencePath));
  const crossFlow = linkedEvidence?.version === project.version &&
    linkedEvidence.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId ? linkedEvidence : undefined;
  if (crossFlow) evidence.push({file: linkedEvidencePath, kind: '跨流程关系和字段核验证据'});
  const bundle = {
    fieldAnalysisVersion, stageAnalysisVersion, stagePages, nodeEvidenceVersion, nodeEvidence, debug, debugRuns, manualEvidence,
    stageFieldAnalysis: analyzeStageFields(debugRuns), debugHistory,
    project, workflow, fields, views, crossFlow, expectedViews: project.expectedViews ?? indexedViews.length,
    topology: flowTopology, rules, evidence, issues, diagramObservation,
  };
  await mkdir(join(directory, 'normalized'), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json'), JSON.stringify(bundle, null, 2));
  bundle.pathCoverage=analyzePathCoverage(bundle);
  await mkdir(join(directory,'reports'),{recursive:true});
  await writeFile(join(directory,'reports/path-coverage.json'),JSON.stringify(bundle.pathCoverage,null,2));
  await writeFile(join(directory,'normalized/bundle.json'),JSON.stringify(bundle,null,2));
  return bundle;
}


=== END src/analyze.mjs
=== src/business-content.mjs
import { memberScopeDescription } from './debug-runtime.mjs';
import { businessControl } from './workflow-order.mjs';
import { atomicFieldRows } from './field-atomic.mjs';
const clean = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
const viewLabel = name => clean(name).replace(/^\d+\s*/, '');
const hiddenName = /^(?:辅助|内部变量|系统变量|隐藏字段|点击查询)|(?:辅助字段|控件提示|隐藏标志|短信通知)$/u;
const displayControl = new Map([
  ['User', '成员选择'], ['Organize', '部门选择'], ['Code', '下拉选择'],
  ['date', '日期选择'], ['dateTime', '日期时间'], ['boolean', '复选框'],
  ['int', '数字'], ['integer', '数字'], ['decimal', '数字'], ['double', '数字'],
  ['CheckBox', '复选框'], ['OptionButton', '单选'], ['DropDown', '下拉选择'],
  ['RichText', '多行文本'], ['FileAttachment', '附件上传'], ['DatePicker', '日期选择'],
  ['DTPicker', '日期选择'],
]);

export function businessOrder(bundle, profile) {
  if (bundle.stagePages?.length) {
    const views = new Map(bundle.views.map(view => [view.id, view]));
    return bundle.stagePages.map(stage => views.get(stage.viewId)).filter(Boolean);
  }
  const nodes = new Map(bundle.workflow.nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
  const adjacent = new Map();
  for (const edge of bundle.workflow.transitions) {
    if (!adjacent.has(edge.source)) adjacent.set(edge.source, []);
    if (!/退回|重新|刷新|否决/.test(edge.name)) adjacent.get(edge.source).push(edge.target);
  }
  const starts = profile?.startNode ? [profile.startNode] : bundle.topology?.entries ?? [];
  const queue = starts.slice();
  const visited = new Set();
  const ordered = new Set([bundle.workflow.startView, ...profile?.viewOrder ?? []].filter(Boolean));
  for (let index = 0; index < queue.length; index++) {
    const id = queue[index];
    if (visited.has(id) || !nodes.has(id)) continue;
    visited.add(id);
    const node = nodes.get(id);
    if (node.view) ordered.add(node.view);
    if (node.printView) ordered.add(node.printView);
    queue.push(...(adjacent.get(id) ?? []));
  }
  for (const view of bundle.views) ordered.add(view.id);
  const views = new Map(bundle.views.map(view => [view.id, view]));
  return [...ordered].map(id => views.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
}

function reviewText(rule, overrides) {
  const override = overrides?.[rule.id];
  return override && override.review === rule.interpretation ? override.text : rule.interpretation;
}

export function buildBusinessContent(bundle, profile) {
  const title = clean(bundle.project.name || bundle.project.code);
  const views = businessOrder(bundle, profile);
  const nodes = new Map(bundle.workflow.nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
  const decisionRules = new Map((bundle.rules ?? []).filter(r => r.kind === '判断').map(r => [r.id, r]));
  const groups = new Map();
  for (const edge of bundle.workflow.transitions) {
    if (edge.condition || edge.restrictScript || nodes.get(edge.source)?.type === '判断') {
      if (!groups.has(edge.source)) groups.set(edge.source, []);
      groups.get(edge.source).push(edge);
    }
  }
  for (const [id] of groups) {
    if (!decisionRules.has(id)) decisionRules.set(id, { id, name: nodes.get(id)?.name ?? '条件分流' });
  }
  const labels = new Set();
  const approvals = [];
  const questions = [...profile?.questions ?? []];
  if (bundle.debug?.boundary?.status === 'shared-callback' && !bundle.debugRuns?.runs?.length) {
    questions.push('调试和正式流程共用外部回调；核对事件的实际副作用、审批人和通知，并依据运行证据验收未验证路径。');
  }
  for (const [id, rule] of decisionRules) {
    const condition = profile?.approvalLabels?.[id] || clean(rule.name);
    const edges = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(edge => edge.source === id);
    const reviewed = reviewText(rule, profile?.ruleWording) || simpleDecision(rule.expression, edges, nodes, bundle.fields);
    const branches = edges
      .map(edge => `${edge.name} → ${nodes.get(edge.target)?.name ?? '待核对的环节'}`);
    const outcome = reviewed || (branches.length ? `已配置路径为${branches.join('、')}。触发条件待确认。` : '触发条件及后续处理待确认。');
    const key = condition + outcome;
    if (labels.has(key)) continue;
    labels.add(key);
    approvals.push([condition, outcome]);
    if (!reviewed) questions.push(`确认「${condition}」的触发条件和边界取值。`);
  }
  const requirements = (bundle.rules ?? []).filter(rule => rule.kind === '动作脚本' && rule.interpretation)
    .map(rule => reviewText(rule, profile?.ruleWording))
    .filter(text => text && !/^静态动作脚本：/.test(text));
  // Historical blockers are evidence only while the later DEBUG record has not resolved them.
  const runtimeEvidence = JSON.stringify({
    stages: bundle.debug?.runtime?.stages ?? [],
    completedNodes: bundle.debug?.runtime?.completedNodes ?? [],
    debugRuns: bundle.debugRuns?.runs ?? [],
    pathCoverage: bundle.pathCoverage ?? {},
  });
  const laterDebugReachedForm = runtimeEvidence.includes('申请人填写');
  const resolvedBlocker = /22001|护照状态查询失败|团组编号不存在/;
  for (const requirement of profile?.requirements ?? []) {
    if (laterDebugReachedForm && resolvedBlocker.test(requirement)) continue;
    // Cross-flow evidence records the later successful association; keep it there only.
    if (/申请人选择节点填入团组编号并提交/.test(requirement)) continue;
    requirements.push(requirement);
  }
  requirements.push(...(bundle.manualEvidence?.issues ?? []).map(issue => issue.requirement).filter(Boolean));
  for (const issue of bundle.manualEvidence?.issues ?? []) questions.push(`旧系统问题（用户手动观察）：${issue.description}`);
  const runtime = bundle.debug?.runtime;
  const actions=bundle.pathCoverage?.obligations ?? [];
  for(const path of actions.filter(path=>path.kind==='退回或重提' && path.evidence.length)) {
    requirements.push(`Debug 已确认「${path.name.replace(' → ','」后转入「')}」。其他返回路径按各自证据确认。`);
  }
  for(const run of bundle.pathCoverage?.instances ?? []) if(run.identityBlock && run.pendingNode) {
    questions.push(`已产生「${run.pendingNode}」待办。请验收发起人收到待办、修改和重新提交后的流转。`);
  }
  for(const run of bundle.pathCoverage?.instances ?? []) {
    if(run.status.startsWith('主要审批')) requirements.push('已观察路径进入最终材料办理阶段，尚未完成流程。材料就绪后仍须执行完成操作；外部生成服务状态待核实。');
  }
  const runtimeErrors = (bundle.debugRuns?.runs ?? []).flatMap(run => run.events)
    .flatMap(event => event.responses ?? []).filter(response => response.http===200 && response.errno && response.error &&
      !/EVENT_MESSENGER_TIMEOUT|Read timed out|connection|网络|服务器异常/i.test(response.error));
  for (const error of [...new Set(runtimeErrors.map(e => e.error))]) {
    requirements.push(`实际办理校验：${error}`);
  }
  if (runtime?.stages?.length) {
    const missing = bundle.workflow.nodes.filter(n => n.type === '办理' && !runtime.completedNodes.map(String).includes(String(n.id)));
    if (missing.length) questions.push(`仍未完成自动运行验收的办理节点有 ${missing.length} 个；其路径与权限以配置为依据，不能视为已实测通过。`);
  }
  if (laterDebugReachedForm) {
    for (const question of [...questions]) {
      if (/护照状态查询失败的服务日志|成功关联后哪些字段会自动带出尚未实测/.test(question))
        questions.splice(questions.indexOf(question), 1);
    }
  }
  if (laterDebugReachedForm) {
    for (const requirement of [...requirements]) {
      if (/申请人填写节点提交被本地校验阻断|查询护照状态失败/.test(requirement))
        requirements.splice(requirements.indexOf(requirement), 1);
    }
  }
  const manualNodes = bundle.workflow.nodes.filter(node => node.type === '办理');
  const returnTargets = [...new Set(bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(e => /退回/.test(e.name))
    .map(e => nodes.get(e.target)?.name).filter(Boolean))];
  const resubmits = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(e => /重新提交/.test(e.name)).length;
  const rejects = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(e => /否决|不通过/.test(e.name));
  const entry = bundle.stagePages?.find(stage => stage.binding === '入口');
  const begin = entry?.actions?.find(action => action.purpose === '进入流程的首个办理步骤');
  const acknowledge = entry?.actions?.find(action => action.purpose === '确认已阅读办理说明');
  const next = entry?.nextStages?.length ? `进入「${entry.nextStages.join('、')}」` : '进入正式申请';
  const entryFlow = entry && `申请人先阅读办理说明${acknowledge ? `，勾选「${acknowledge.label}」` : ''}，再${begin ? `点击「${begin.label}」` : ''}${next}。`;
  const flow = profile?.flow ?? [
    !entry && bundle.workflow.startView && views.length ? `办事入口显示「${viewLabel(views[0].name)}」。` : '',
    ...views.filter(v => v.id !== bundle.workflow.startView).slice(0, 8).map(v => {
      const stages = [...new Set(manualNodes.filter(n => n.view === v.id).map(n => n.name))];
      return stages.length ? `「${viewLabel(v.name)}」用于${stages.join('、')}。` : '';
    }),
    bundle.workflow.nodes.length ? '各路径及结束关系见附录 A。' : '办理路径需补齐流程定义后确认。',
  ].filter(Boolean);
  const returnNotes = profile?.returns ?? [
    returnTargets.length ? `定义包含退回动作，目标包括${returnTargets.join('、')}。${resubmits ? '退回后可按配置重新提交。' : ''}` : '',
    rejects.length ? '配置包含审批否决或不通过动作。其结束行为以验收结果为准。' : '',
  ].filter(Boolean);
  if (!profile) {
    if (manualNodes.some(n => /executors=|departments=/.test(n.actor))) questions.push('确认按表单或组织解析审批人员时的候选范围、多人及空结果处理。');
    if (bundle.workflow.nodes.some(n => n.type === '分流')) questions.push('确认并行审批的汇合、退回及未完成待办处理。');
    if (rejects.length) questions.push('确认否决后是否结束、能否修改重提及如何告知申请人。');
    if (bundle.workflow.externalEvents?.some(e => e.enabled)) questions.push('确认外部业务服务的输入、结果回写和失败处理。');
  }
  return {
    title, scope: [...(profile?.scope ?? [
      `本流程办理「${title}」。`,
      ...(!manualNodes.length ? ['申请与办理角色需补齐节点配置后确认。'] : []),
      ...roleSummary(manualNodes),
    ]), ...(entry ? ['办理范围包括申请前的说明页面。申请人先阅读办理说明，再进入申请。'] : [])],
    flow: [entryFlow, ...flow].filter(Boolean), approvals, approvers: profile?.approvers ?? [], returnNotes, requirements: [...new Set(requirements)],
    fields: businessFields(bundle, views, profile), questions: [...new Set(questions)], views,
  };
}

function simpleDecision(expression, edges, nodes, fields) {
  if (!expression || edges.length !== 2 || edges.some(edge => edge.restrictScript)) return;
  // Parse an exact, side-effect-free Java-shaped comparison. Never evaluate a script.
  const match = expression.trim().match(/^String\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*\$\{\s*"([\w]+)"\s*\}\s*;\s*if\s*\(\s*"([^"\\]+)"\.equals\(\1\)\s*\)\s*\{?\s*return\s*"([\w]+)"\s*;\s*\}?\s*return\s*"([\w]+)"\s*;$/u);
  if (!match) return;
  const [, , fieldId, literal, whenTrue, whenFalse] = match;
  const label = fields.find(field => field.id === fieldId && field.name !== fieldId)?.name;
  const target = code => nodes.get(edges.find(edge => edge.code === code)?.target)?.name;
  const yes = target(whenTrue);
  const no = target(whenFalse);
  if (label && yes && no && whenTrue !== whenFalse) return `「${label}」为「${literal}」时进入${yes}，其余进入${no}。`;
}

function roleSummary(nodes) {
  const groups = [...new Set(nodes.flatMap(node => clean(node.actor).split(/[；/]/))
    .map(role => role.replace(/^.+?_/u, ''))
    .filter(role => role && !role.includes('=') && !/^VAR_/.test(role)))];
  const sourceActors = nodes.filter(node => /_VAR_OWNER_ACCOUNT/.test(node.actor ?? ''))
    .flatMap(node => clean(node.actor).split('；')[0].split(' / ')).filter(Boolean);
  const applicant = [...new Set(sourceActors)];
  return [
    applicant.length ? `发起人办理环节的配置角色包括${applicant.join('、')}。` : '',
    groups.length ? `办理角色包括${groups.slice(0, 10).join('、')}${groups.length > 10 ? '等' : ''}。` : '',
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

function choiceNotes(records, names, optionLabels) {
  const options = new Map();
  const defaults = new Set();
  const linkages = new Set();
  const conditionText = items => {
    if (!items?.length) return '';
    const conditions = items.map(item => {
      const name = names.get(item.fieldId);
      const label = item.label || optionLabels.get(item.fieldId)?.get(String(item.value));
      return name && label ? `「${name}」${item.operator === '!=' ? '不为' : '为'}「${label}」` : null;
    });
    return conditions.every(Boolean) ? conditions.join('且') : null;
  };
  for (const record of records) {
    for (const set of record.optionSets ?? []) {
      const labels = [...new Set(set.options.map(option => option.label).filter(Boolean))];
      if (!labels.length) continue;
      const condition = conditionText(set.when);
      if (condition === null) {
        linkages.add('存在条件选项，适用条件见字段清单。');
        continue;
      }
      const kind = set.kind === 'user-confirmed' ? '固定选项（业务方确认）' :
        set.kind === 'user-reported' ? '已返回选项（业务方提供）' :
        set.completeness === 'complete' ? '可选' : set.versionVerified === false ? '当前页观测到的选项（版本待核对）' : '已观测选项';
      const key = JSON.stringify([condition, kind, labels]);
      if (!options.has(key)) options.set(key, { condition, kind, labels, stages: new Set() });
      if (set.viewScoped !== false) options.get(key).stages.add(viewLabel(record.view));
      if (record.defaultValue != null) {
        const selected = set.options.find(option => String(option.value) === String(record.defaultValue));
        if (selected?.label) defaults.add(`${viewLabel(record.view)}默认「${selected.label}」。`);
      }
    }
    for (const dependency of record.dependencies ?? []) {
      if (dependency.kind === 'template-visibility') {
        const alternatives = dependency.alternatives.map(conditionText);
        if (alternatives.length && alternatives.every(Boolean)) {
          linkages.add(`${viewLabel(record.view)}模板在${alternatives.join('或')}时显示此控件。`);
        }
      } else if (dependency.kind === 'observed-change' && dependency.versionVerified !== false) {
        const condition = conditionText(dependency.when);
        const changes = dependency.changes.filter(change => names.has(change.fieldId)).map(change => {
          const label = `「${names.get(change.fieldId)}」`;
          if (change.before.visible !== change.after.visible) return label + (change.after.visible ? '显示' : '隐藏');
          if (change.before.required !== change.after.required) return label + (change.after.required ? '必填' : '取消必填');
          if (change.before.readOnly !== change.after.readOnly) return label + (change.after.readOnly ? '只读' : '可编辑');
        }).filter(Boolean);
        if (condition && changes.length) linkages.add(`${viewLabel(record.view)}观测到${condition}时，${changes.slice(0, 4).join('、')}。`);
      }
    }
  }
  // An empty template value is not a runtime default; explain this once above the table.
  const sentences = [...options.values()].slice(0, 5).map(({ condition, kind, labels, stages }) => {
    const stage = stages.size === 1 ? [...stages][0] : '';
    const prefix = [stage, condition && `${condition}时`, kind].filter(Boolean).join('，');
    return labels.length <= 8 ? `${prefix}${labels.map(label => `「${label}」`).join('、')}。` :
      `${prefix}共 ${labels.length} 项，见字段清单。`;
  });
  if (!sentences.length && records.some(record => record.optionStatus)) sentences.push('选项待核对。');
  if (options.size > 5) sentences.push('其他阶段或条件的选项见字段清单。');
  const defaultGroups = new Map();
  for (const text of defaults) {
    const match=text.match(/^(.*?)默认(.*)$/);
    if(!match) continue;
    if(!defaultGroups.has(match[2])) defaultGroups.set(match[2],[]);
    defaultGroups.get(match[2]).push(match[1]);
  }
  return [...sentences, ...[...defaultGroups].map(([value,stages])=>`${stages.join('、')}默认${value}`), ...[...linkages].slice(0, 4)];
}

function businessFields(bundle, views, profile) {
  const byField = new Map();
  for (const field of bundle.fields) {
    if (!field.id || /^_VAR_/i.test(field.id) || field.visible === false) continue;
    if (!byField.has(field.id)) byField.set(field.id, []);
    byField.get(field.id).push(field);
  }
  const names = new Map([...byField].flatMap(([id, records]) => {
    const name = profile?.fields?.[id]?.name || records.find(record => record.name && record.name !== id)?.name;
    return name && !profile?.fields?.[id]?.exclude && !hiddenName.test(name) ? [[id, name]] : [];
  }));
  const optionLabels = new Map();
  for (const [id, records] of byField) {
    const labels = new Map();
    for (const option of records.flatMap(record => record.optionSets ?? []).flatMap(set => set.options)) {
      if (option.value == null || !option.label) continue;
      const value = String(option.value);
      labels.set(value, !labels.has(value) || labels.get(value) === option.label ? option.label : null);
    }
    if (labels.size) optionLabels.set(id, labels);
  }
  const groups = new Map();
  const order = new Map(views.map((v, i) => [v.name, i]));
  for (const [id, records] of byField) {
    const note = profile?.fields?.[id];
    if (note?.exclude) continue;
    const bound = records.filter(record => record.usages?.length);
    const name = names.get(id);
    if (!bound.length || !name || hiddenName.test(name)) continue;
    const typeHints = new Set([
      ...records.map(record => record.apiType),
      ...bound.flatMap(record => record.usages.map(usage => usage.kind)),
    ]);
    const type = note?.type ?? businessControl({ name, usages: [...typeHints].map(kind => ({ kind })) });
    const stageNames = [...new Set(bound.map(record => record.view))]
      .sort((a,b) => (order.get(a) ?? Infinity) - (order.get(b) ?? Infinity));
    const businessStages = stageNames.filter(stage => stage !== bundle.views.find(v => /^00主表单/.test(v.name))?.name);
    const stages = businessStages.length ? businessStages : stageNames;
    const stage = viewLabel(stages[0]);
    const matchedGroup = profile?.groupPatterns?.find(item => new RegExp(item.pattern, 'u').test(name))?.group;
    const group = note?.group || matchedGroup || stage || '其他已识别字段';
    const known = [
      ...new Set(records.flatMap(record => [
        typeof record.required === 'boolean' ? `${viewLabel(record.view)}模板标记${record.required ? '必填' : '可选'}（实际阶段规则待核实）` : '',
        record.readOnly === true ? `${viewLabel(record.view)}只读` : '',
        typeof record.visibilityRule === 'string' ? record.visibilityRule : '',
        typeof record.linkageRule === 'string' ? record.linkageRule : '',
      ]).filter(Boolean)),
    ];
    const usage = stages.length > 1 ? `在${stages.slice(0,2).map(viewLabel).join('、')}${stages.length > 2 ? '等阶段' : ''}使用。` : '';
    const choices = choiceNotes(records, names, optionLabels);
    // Group identical range evidence; repeated observations do not add a new rule.
    const hasSpecial = bundle.stageFieldAnalysis?.special?.some(s=>s.fieldId===id);
    const memberScopes = hasSpecial ? [] : [...new Set(records.flatMap(record => record.memberScopes ?? [])
      .filter(s => s.settings?.userFilters).map(s => memberScopeDescription(s.settings)))];
    const description = [note?.rule, ...known, ...choices, ...memberScopes, ...(note?.rule || known.length || choices.length ? [] : [usage])]
      .filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    if (!groups.has(group)) groups.set(group, []);
    groups.get(group).push({
      id,
      name: clean(name),
      type,
      view: stages[0],
      required: records.some(record => record.required === true) ? true : undefined,
      description: description || '见对应阶段表单图。',
      evidence: [],
    });
  }
  const ordered = [...profile?.fieldGroups ?? [], ...groups.keys()];
  const viewOrder = new Map(views.map((view, index) => [view.name, index]));
  return [...new Set(ordered)].filter(key => groups.has(key)).map(group => {
    const fields = atomicFieldRows(groups.get(group), { groupName: group, viewOrder });
    return { title: group, fields, rows: fields.map(field => [
      field.fieldName, field.fieldType, field.rules,
    ]) };
  });
}

// Compatibility wrapper kept for old callers; it no longer merges independent fields.
export function mergeEquivalentFields(rows) {
  return rows.map(row => [row[0], row[1], row[2]]);
}

// Presentation-only transformation: original evidence is never rewritten.
export function businessTextFormatter(bundle) {
  const names = new Map((bundle.fields || []).filter(f => f.name && f.name !== f.id).map(f => [f.id,f.name]));
  const z0095Names = new Map([
    ['fieldTZXXTZBH','团组编号'], ['fieldGRXXZGH','申请人工号'], ['fieldGRXXXM','申请人姓名'],
    ['fieldSJFrom','出访开始日期'], ['fieldSJTo','出访结束日期'], ['fieldGZDW','出访国家地区'],
    ['fieldRS','团组人数'], ['fieldTZMC','团组名称'],
  ]);
  const labelFor = id => names.get(String(id)) || z0095Names.get(String(id)) || null;
  const source = JSON.stringify(bundle.crossFlow || {});
  const identities = new Set();
  for (const match of source.matchAll(/(?:姓名|登录身份|办理人(?:经平台显示为)?|当前 DEBUG 身份)([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,4})(?=[(（，。、；\s])/g)) identities.add(match[1]);
  for (const match of source.matchAll(/([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,4})[（(][A-Za-z]?\d{5,}[)）]/g)) identities.add(match[1]);
  return value => {
    let text = String(value ?? '');
    const version = String(bundle.project?.version || '');
    if (version) text = text.replaceAll(version, 'FLOWVERSIONPLACEHOLDER');
    for (const name of identities) text = text.replaceAll(name, '测试人员');
    text = text.replace(/\b[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b/gi, '（详见受控证据）')
      .replace(/\b[A-Za-z]?\d{5,}\b/g, '（测试值已隐去）')
      .replace(/\bfield[A-Za-z0-9_]+\b/g, id => names.get(id) || '关联字段（名称待核对）')
      .replace(/具体动作和条件见详细版规则证据/g, '具体动作和条件见内部规则证据')
      .replace(/静态动作脚本：/g, '配置规则：')
      .replace(/HTTP\s*200\s*[、/，]?\s*(?:errno\s*0|业务码\s*0)/gi, '办理成功响应');
    if (version) text = text.replaceAll('FLOWVERSIONPLACEHOLDER',version);
    return text;
  };
}

export function businessAssociation(bundle) {
  if (!bundle.crossFlow) return null;
  const {summary=[],fields=[],limits=[]} = bundle.crossFlow;
  const names = new Map((bundle.fields || []).filter(f=>f.name && f.name!==f.id).map(f=>[f.id,f.name]));
  const z0095Names = new Map([
    ['fieldTZXXTZBH','团组编号'], ['fieldGRXXZGH','申请人工号'], ['fieldGRXXXM','申请人姓名'],
    ['fieldSJFrom','出访开始日期'], ['fieldSJTo','出访结束日期'], ['fieldGZDW','出访国家地区'],
    ['fieldRS','团组人数'], ['fieldTZMC','团组名称'],
  ]);
  const labelFor = id => names.get(String(id)) || z0095Names.get(String(id)) || null;
  const overview = summary[0]?.split(/，项目代码|，定义 ID/)[0];
  const paragraphs = overview ? [overview.replace(/。?$/,'。')] : [];
  if (summary.some(s=>/团组编号与流程流水号.*不同字段/.test(s)))
    paragraphs.push('关联时使用前置申请的团组编号；团组编号与流程流水号不同，不得混用。');
  if (summary.some(s=>/验证关联关系成立|关联成功/.test(s)))
    paragraphs.push('已通过 Debug 验证前置数据关联成功；已验证案例中前置申请人与模拟申请人一致。其他匹配边界仍需确认。');
  const carried = summary.find(s=>/自动带出/.test(s));
  if (carried) paragraphs.push('关联后的自动带出字段、来源与可修改状态见下表；历史页面显示不自动证明当前编辑权限。');
  return {
    paragraphs,
    fields: fields.map(row=>{
      let source = String(row[2] || '').split(/，值|=|；当前 DEBUG|详情姓名/)[0];
      const evidence = String(row[3] || '');
      const rules = [];
      if (/只读/.test(evidence)) rules.push('已观测阶段只读');
      if (/可编辑/.test(evidence)) rules.push('已采集页面记录可编辑，当前权限须按节点配置');
      if (/自动带出/.test(evidence)) rules.push('关联成功后自动带出；后续是否允许修改待确认');
      if (!rules.length) rules.push('已取得关联显示结果；具体修改权限按节点核对');
      let label = labelFor(row[0]) || row[0];
      if (/^\d{4,}$/.test(label)) label = '关联字段（名称待核对）';
      const labels = label.split(' / ').map(part => labelFor(part.trim()) || part.trim());
      source = source.replace(/field[A-Za-z0-9_]+/g, id => labelFor(id) || '关联字段（名称待核对）');
      if (/From\/To/.test(label)) label = '出访起止日期';
      return { fieldId: String(row[0]), labels, source, rules: rules.join('；') };
    }),
    limits: limits.filter(s=> !/本地校验阻断|护照状态查询失败|本次仅验证/.test(s)),
  };
}

=== src/capture-stage.mjs
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, rename } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { parseWorkflow } from './infoplus.mjs';
import { permittedProbeRequest } from './live-options.mjs';

const readJson = async path => JSON.parse((await readFile(path, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
const previewApi = '/infoplus/interface/preview';

async function cachedPreview(context, entry, project) {
  const anchor = context.pages().find(page => URL.parse(page.url())?.origin === entry.origin);
  if (!anchor) return;
  return anchor.evaluate(async ({ url, definition, code }) => {
    const response = await fetch(url, { cache: 'only-if-cached', mode: 'same-origin', redirect: 'manual',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3500) }).catch(() => undefined);
    if (!response?.ok) return;
    const html = await response.text();
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
    const scripts = [...doc.scripts].map(script => script.textContent).join('\n');
    const workflowId = scripts.match(/\bworkflowId\s*=\s*["']([\w-]+)["']/)?.[1];
    const pageCode = doc.title.trim().split(/[:：\s]/)[0];
    if (workflowId === definition && pageCode.toLowerCase() === code.toLowerCase() &&
        /\$\$\.PREVIEW\s*=\s*true\b/.test(scripts)) return html;
  }, { url: entry.href, definition: project.workflowDefinitionId, code: project.code });
}

async function capturePreview(context, entry, html, project, viewId, refresh) {
  const page = await context.newPage();
  try {
    const cdp = await context.newCDPSession(page);
    const frame = (await cdp.send('Page.getFrameTree')).frameTree.frame.id;
    await cdp.send('Network.setBypassServiceWorker', { bypass: true });
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 950 });
    await page.addInitScript(() => { window.open = () => null; });
    await page.routeWebSocket('**/*', socket => socket.close());
    let opened = false;
    let previewSent = false;
    cdp.on('Fetch.requestPaused', async ({ requestId, request, resourceType, frameId, networkId }) => {
      try {
        const url = new URL(request.url);
        const type = resourceType.toLowerCase();
        const method = request.method;
        const sameFrame = frameId === frame;
        if (!opened && type === 'document' && method === 'GET' && sameFrame && url.href === entry.href) {
          opened = true;
          if (refresh) return await cdp.send('Fetch.continueRequest', { requestId });
          return await cdp.send('Fetch.fulfillRequest', { requestId, responseCode: 200,
            responseHeaders: [{ name: 'Content-Type', value: 'text/html; charset=utf-8' }],
            body: Buffer.from(html).toString('base64') });
        }
        const preview = !previewSent && method === 'POST' && url.origin === entry.origin && url.pathname === previewApi &&
          !url.search && ['fetch', 'xhr'].includes(type) && sameFrame;
        if (preview) {
          const body = request.postData ?? (await cdp.send('Network.getRequestPostData', { requestId: networkId })).postData;
          const params = new URLSearchParams(body);
          if (body.length <= 32768 && params.getAll('workflowId').length === 1 &&
              params.get('workflowId') === project.workflowDefinitionId && params.has('rand') && params.has('width')) {
            previewSent = true;
            return await cdp.send('Fetch.continueRequest', { requestId });
          }
        }
        const asset = ['stylesheet', 'image', 'font', 'script'].includes(type);
        const alive = method === 'GET' && url.origin === entry.origin && url.pathname === '/infoplus/alive' &&
          ['xhr', 'fetch'].includes(type) && sameFrame;
        if (alive || asset && permittedProbeRequest(url, method, type, entry)) {
          return await cdp.send('Fetch.continueRequest', { requestId });
        }
      } catch {
        // Interception errors fail closed.
      }
      await cdp.send('Fetch.failRequest', { requestId, errorReason: 'BlockedByClient' }).catch(() => {});
    });
    await cdp.send('Fetch.enable', { patterns: [{ urlPattern: '*', requestStage: 'Request' }] });
    const pending = page.waitForResponse(response => {
      const url = new URL(response.url());
      return url.origin === entry.origin && url.pathname === previewApi && response.request().method() === 'POST';
    }, { timeout: 12000 }).catch(() => undefined);
    await page.goto(entry.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 12000 });
    const response = await pending;
    const result = response?.ok() && await response.json();
    if (![0, '0'].includes(result?.errno) || result.entities?.[0]?.viewId !== viewId) {
      throw new Error(`欢迎页预览未返回匹配的视图（${result?.errno ?? response?.status() ?? '未收到响应'}）`);
    }
    const content = page.locator('#div_render_container');
    await content.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 12000 });
    const detail = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const main = document.querySelector('#div_render_container');
      const visible = node => node.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(node).visibility !== 'hidden';
      // The renderer can put long instructions in nested scroll containers.
      const ancestors = [];
      for (let node = main; node; node = node.parentElement) ancestors.push(node);
      for (const node of [...ancestors, ...main.querySelectorAll('div,section,article')]) {
        if (!visible(node) || node.scrollHeight <= node.clientHeight + 2) continue;
        const style = getComputedStyle(node);
        if (!/auto|scroll|hidden|clip/.test(style.overflowY)) continue;
        node.style.setProperty('overflow', 'visible', 'important');
        node.style.setProperty('max-height', 'none', 'important');
        if (node !== document.documentElement) node.style.setProperty('height', 'auto', 'important');
      }
      const text = main.innerText.split('\n').map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean).join('\n');
      const startAction = /^(?:开始办理|立即办理|我要申请|发起申请|开始申请)$/;
      const controls = [...main.querySelectorAll('a[href],button,input[type=button],input[type=submit],input[type=checkbox],[role=button],[role=checkbox]')];
      // This renderer also uses clickable divs for the primary action.
      for (const node of main.querySelectorAll('*')) {
        if (!controls.includes(node) && visible(node) && startAction.test((node.innerText ?? '').trim())) controls.push(node);
      }
      const actions = controls
        .filter(visible).map(node => {
          const checkbox = node.matches('input[type=checkbox],[role=checkbox]');
          const label = (node.innerText || node.getAttribute('aria-label') || node.labels?.[0]?.innerText ||
            (checkbox ? node.closest('td')?.innerText : node.value) || node.title || '').trim();
          const href = node.getAttribute('href');
          const url = href && URL.parse(href, location.href);
          const address = url && /^(http|https):$/.test(url.protocol) && !url.username && !url.password
            ? url.origin + url.pathname : undefined;
          const kind = address ? '链接' : checkbox ? '勾选项' : '按钮';
          const purpose = /^(?:开始办理|立即办理|我要申请|发起申请|开始申请|Start|Apply)(?:\s|$)/i.test(label)
            ? '进入流程的首个办理步骤'
            : checkbox && /已.*阅读|同意.*须知/.test(label) ? '确认已阅读办理说明'
              : address && /\/infoplus\/form\/[^/]+\/start\/?$/.test(url.pathname) ? '进入页面所指的另一项办理流程'
                : address ? '打开链接所指资料' : undefined;
          return { label, kind, address, purpose };
        }).filter(action => action.label);
      const distinct = new Map(actions.map(action => [JSON.stringify(action), action]));
      return { title: document.title, text, actions: [...distinct.values()],
        contentHeight: Math.ceil(Math.max(main.scrollHeight, main.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + scrollY)) };
    });
    if (!detail.text) throw new Error('欢迎页未呈现说明文字');
    const image = await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 });
    if (image.readUInt32BE(20) < detail.contentHeight) throw new Error('欢迎页截图未覆盖完整正文');
    return { ...detail, image };
  } finally { await page.close(); }
}

export async function captureStagePages(context, directory, project, supplied) {
  const index = await readJson(join(directory, 'raw', 'network', 'index.json'));
  const item = index.captured.findLast(row => row.kind === 'workflow' && row.source.endsWith('/findWorkflowDefinition'));
  if (!item || basename(item.file) !== item.file) return { captured: 0, reason: '未取得工作流定义' };
  const workflow = parseWorkflow(await readJson(join(directory, 'raw', 'network', item.file)), project, item.file);
  const viewId = workflow?.startView;
  if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(viewId ?? '') || !project.views?.some(view => view.id === viewId)) {
    return { captured: 0, reason: '未配置可核对的入口视图' };
  }
  const ide = new URL(project.source);
  const slug = /^\/infoplus\/ide\/project\/([\w-]+)\/?$/i.exec(ide.pathname)?.[1];
  if (!slug) return { captured: 0, reason: '缺少可核对的前台项目路径' };
  const path = `/infoplus/form/${slug}/start`;
  const sameEntry = url => url?.origin === ide.origin && url.pathname === path && !url.username && !url.password;
  const entries = supplied ? [URL.parse(supplied)] : [
    ...context.pages().map(page => URL.parse(page.url())).filter(sameEntry),
    new URL(`${path}?theme=zju_new`, ide), new URL(path, ide),
  ];
  if (supplied && !sameEntry(entries[0])) throw new Error('欢迎页必须属于指定项目及已授权的 InfoPlus 站点');
  for (const url of new Map(entries.map(entry => [entry.href, entry])).values()) {
    const html = await cachedPreview(context, url, project);
    if (!html) continue;
    const { image, ...detail } = await capturePreview(context, url, html, project, viewId, Boolean(supplied));
    const viewDirectory = join(directory, 'views', viewId);
    const filename = `live-stage-${randomUUID()}.png`;
    await mkdir(viewDirectory, { recursive: true });
    const manifest = join(viewDirectory, 'live-stage.json');
    const previous = await readJson(manifest).catch(error => { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; });
    const screenshot = previous?.screenshot;
    if (screenshot && /^live-stage-[a-f0-9-]+\.png$/i.test(screenshot) && previous.text === detail.text &&
        JSON.stringify(previous.actions) === JSON.stringify(detail.actions) &&
        (await readFile(join(viewDirectory, screenshot)).catch(() => undefined))?.equals(image)) {
      return { captured: 1, changed: false, viewId, screenshot: `views/${viewId}/${screenshot}` };
    }
    await writeFile(join(viewDirectory, filename), image, { flag: 'wx' });
    const next = join(viewDirectory, `${filename}.json.tmp`);
    await writeFile(next, JSON.stringify({ ...detail, code: project.code, version: project.version,
      definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId, viewId, source: url.origin + url.pathname,
      screenshot: filename, width: image.readUInt32BE(16), height: image.readUInt32BE(20) }, null, 2), { flag: 'wx' });
    await rename(next, manifest);
    return { captured: 1, changed: true, viewId, screenshot: `views/${viewId}/${filename}` };
  }
  return { captured: 0, reason: '当前 Chrome 没有匹配版本的前台预览缓存，可使用 XSN 阶段图' };
}
