import {launchDebug} from './debug-launch.mjs';
import {saveWorkflowInput} from './workflow-inputs.mjs';
import {discoverLinkedBusinessValue} from './linked-instances.mjs';
import {discoverDashboardValue, linkedFieldCandidates, linkedTestInput} from './linked-dashboard.mjs';

export function inspect(bundle) {
  const missing=[];
  if (!bundle.project?.version || bundle.project?.published !== true) missing.push('正式版本尚未确认');
  const nodes=bundle.workflow?.nodes ?? [];
  const edges=bundle.workflow?.transitions ?? [];
  const ids=new Set(nodes.map(n=>n.id));
  if (!nodes.length) missing.push('缺少流程节点');
  if (ids.size!==nodes.length || nodes.some(n=>!n.id)) missing.push('节点 ID 缺失或重复');
  if (!edges.length) missing.push('缺少流程连线');
  edges.forEach((e,i)=>{if(!ids.has(e.source)||!ids.has(e.target)) missing.push(`连线 ${i} 存在悬空节点`);});
  if (!bundle.fields?.length) missing.push('缺少字段清单');
  if (!Number.isInteger(bundle.expectedViews) || bundle.expectedViews<1) missing.push('视图总数未验证');
  if ((bundle.views?.length??0)!==bundle.expectedViews) missing.push('视图数量不一致');
  const viewIds = new Set();
  for (const v of bundle.views??[]) {
    if (!v.id || viewIds.has(v.id)) missing.push('视图 ID 缺失或重复');
    viewIds.add(v.id);
    if (!v.source) missing.push(`视图 ${v.id} 缺少来源`);
    if (!v.screenshot) missing.push(`视图「${v.name ?? v.id}」缺少阶段图`);
  }
  if(!bundle.evidence?.length) missing.push('缺少来源证据');
  const optionStages = { known: 0, partial: 0, unavailable: 0 };
  const optionIds = new Set();
  for (const field of bundle.fields ?? []) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(optionStages, field.optionStatus)) continue;
    optionStages[field.optionStatus]++;
    optionIds.add(field.id);
  }
  return {
    status: missing.length ? 'unverified' : 'structurally-verified',
    structuralChecksPassed: missing.length === 0, missing,
    limitations: ['已校验静态配置与采集资料。运行时权限、外部服务行为及业务语义需单独验收。'],
    fieldOptions: { choiceFields: optionIds.size, stageRecords: optionStages },
    stagePages: { total: bundle.stagePages?.length ?? 0,
      live: bundle.stagePages?.filter(stage => stage.screenshotSource === '前台完整截图').length ?? 0 },
    runtimeCoverage: bundle.debug && { mode: bundle.debug.selectedMode, reason: bundle.debug.reason,
      entry: bundle.debug.entry, deployment: bundle.debug.deployment, boundary: bundle.debug.boundary,
      frontFallback: bundle.debug.front?.attempted === true, simulatedRoles: bundle.debug.simulatedRoles,
      debugNodes: bundle.debug.visitedNodes?.length ?? 0, verifiedPaths: bundle.debug.verifiedPaths,
      frontOptionFields: new Set(bundle.nodeEvidence?.flatMap(node => node.optionFields)).size,
      completedDebugNodes: bundle.debug.runtime?.completedNodes ?? [],
      debugModeEvidence: bundle.debug.runtime?.modeEvidence ?? [],
      debugInstances: bundle.debug.runtime?.instances ?? 0,
      observedActions: bundle.debug.runtime?.actions ?? [] },
    counts: {
      nodes: nodes.length, transitions: edges.length, fields: bundle.fields?.length ?? 0,
      views: bundle.views?.length ?? 0,
      templates: bundle.views?.filter(view => !view.templateMissing && view.packageViews?.length).length ?? 0,
      previews: bundle.views?.flatMap(view => view.packageViews ?? []).filter(view => view.screenshot).length ?? 0,
    },
  };
}

async function statIfPresent(file) {
  try { return await stat(file); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
}

async function readCompleteBundle(directory) {
  const file = join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json');
  const cached = await statIfPresent(file);
  if (!cached?.isFile()) return;
  let bundle;
  try { bundle = await json(file); }
  catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof SyntaxError || error.code === 'ENOENT') return;
    throw error;
  }
  if (!bundle?.project?.code || !Array.isArray(bundle.issues) || bundle.issues.length ||
      ![bundle.workflow?.nodes, bundle.workflow?.transitions, bundle.fields, bundle.views,
        bundle.rules, bundle.evidence].every(Array.isArray)) return;
  if (bundle.fieldAnalysisVersion !== fieldAnalysisVersion && await statIfPresent(join(directory, 'project.json'))) return;
  if (bundle.stageAnalysisVersion !== stageAnalysisVersion && await statIfPresent(join(directory, 'project.json'))) return;
  if (bundle.nodeEvidenceVersion !== nodeEvidenceVersion && await statIfPresent(join(directory, 'project.json'))) return;
  if ((bundle.pathCoverage?.schemaVersion!==2 || bundle.stageFieldAnalysis?.schemaVersion !== 2) && await statIfPresent(join(directory, 'project.json'))) return;
  const report = inspect(bundle);
  if (!report.structuralChecksPassed) return;

  const sources = new Set([
    'project.json', 'raw/network/index.json', 'workflow-map.json', 'raw/editor-observation.json',
    'scan-issues.json', 'reviewed-rules.json', 'raw/manual-debug-reference.json', 'raw/debug-history-evidence.json', 'raw/cross-flow-evidence.json', optionEvidence, reviewedOptionEvidence, debugProbeFile, debugRuntimeFile, ...bundle.evidence.map(item => item.file),
    ...bundle.views.map(view => stageManifest(view.id)),
  ]);
  const sourceStats = await Promise.all([...sources].map(source => {
    if (typeof source !== 'string') return;
    const path = resolve(directory, source);
    if (path.startsWith(directory + sep)) return statIfPresent(path);
  }));
  if (sourceStats.some(source => source?.mtimeMs > cached.mtimeMs)) return;
  if (/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/i.test(bundle.project.code) &&
      (await statIfPresent(stageProfileUrl(bundle.project.code)))?.mtimeMs > cached.mtimeMs) return;

  if (bundle.views.some(view => view.templateMissing || !view.packageViews?.length ||
      view.packageViews.some(panel => !panel.screenshot || panel.issue))) return;
  const previews = new Set(bundle.views.flatMap(view => [view.screenshot, ...view.packageViews.map(panel => panel.screenshot)]));
  for (const stage of bundle.stagePages ?? []) if (stage.screenshot) previews.add(stage.screenshot);
  const viewsDirectory = join(directory, 'views') + sep;
  const previewStats = await Promise.all([...previews].map(preview => {
    const path = resolve(directory, preview);
    if (path.startsWith(viewsDirectory)) return statIfPresent(path);
  }));
  if (!previewStats.every(preview => preview?.isFile() && preview.size > 0)) return;
  return { bundle, report, mtimeMs: cached.mtimeMs };
}

export async function main(args) {
  const outputFlag = args.indexOf('--output-dir');
  let explicitOutput;
  if (outputFlag >= 0) {
    if (!args[outputFlag+1] || args[outputFlag+1].startsWith('--')) throw Error('--output-dir 需要目录');
    explicitOutput = resolve(args[outputFlag+1]);
    args = args.filter((_, i) => i !== outputFlag && i !== outputFlag+1);
    if (explicitOutput.split(sep).includes('_verification')) throw Error('对比正式目录不能位于 _verification');
  }
  let [command,input,output='output']=args;
  if (explicitOutput && !['run','scan','generate','generate-custom','analyze','options','collect-online','debug-session','debug-start','stages','coverage'].includes(command)) throw Error('此命令不支持 --output-dir，请使用其目录参数');
  if (explicitOutput && !['run','scan','coverage'].includes(command)) input = explicitOutput;
  if (command === 'linked-fields' && input) {
    const bundle = await json(join(input, 'normalized', 'bundle.json'));
    console.log(JSON.stringify(linkedFieldCandidates(bundle)));
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'linked-dashboard' && input && args[2] && args[3]) {
    const target = await json(join(input, 'project.json'));
    const predecessor = await json(join(args[2], 'project.json'));
    const criteria = await json(resolve(args[3]));
    if (new URL(target.source).origin !== new URL(predecessor.source).origin)
      throw new Error('关联流程必须属于目标流程所在的已授权站点');
    const connection = await attachChrome();
    try {
      const result = await discoverDashboardValue(connection.context, predecessor, criteria);
      if (result.status !== 'found') { console.log(JSON.stringify(result)); process.exitCode = 2; return; }
      if (args.includes('--save')) {
        await saveWorkflowInput(target, linkedTestInput(criteria, result));
      }
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ status: 'found', evidence: result.evidence, saved: args.includes('--save') }));
    } finally { await connection.close(); }
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'input-set' && input && args[2]) {
    const directory=await prepareOfficial(input);
    const project=await json(join(directory,'project.json'));
    const item=await json(resolve(args[2]));
    await saveWorkflowInput(project,item);
    console.log('已保存流程专属业务测试输入；值不写入业务规则或运行报告。');
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'linked-discover' && input && args[2] && args[3]) {
    const predecessor = await json(join(resolve(input), 'project.json'));
    const criteria = await json(resolve(args[2]));
    const candidate = resolve(args[3]);
    const base = resolve('config/workflow-inputs') + sep;
    if (!candidate.startsWith(base) || !candidate.endsWith('.candidate.json'))
      throw new Error('候选结果必须保存在 config/workflow-inputs 内的 .candidate.json 文件');
    const endpoint = await chromeEndpoint();
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error('专用 Chrome 尚未启动');
    const connection = await attachChrome(endpoint);
    try {
      const result = await discoverLinkedBusinessValue(connection.context, predecessor, criteria);
      if (result.status !== 'found') { console.log(JSON.stringify(result)); process.exitCode=2; return; }
      await mkdir(base, {recursive:true});
      await writeFile(candidate, JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n', {flag:'wx'});
      console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'found', candidateFile:candidate, evidence:result.evidence}));
    } finally { await connection.close(); }
    return;
  }
  if(command==='issues'){
    console.log(await readFile(new URL('../docs/known-issues.md',import.meta.url),'utf8'));
    return;
  }
  if(command==='run'&&input){
    const flags=args.slice(2);
    if(flags.some(flag=>!['--offline','--static','--rescan'].includes(flag)) || flags.includes('--offline')&&flags.includes('--rescan'))throw new Error('用法：run <编号或名称> [--offline | --static] [--rescan]');
    const query=projectQuery(input);
    let cached;
    if (explicitOutput) {
      const metadata = await statIfPresent(join(explicitOutput,'project.json'));
      if (metadata) {
        const project = await json(join(explicitOutput,'project.json'));
        if (![project.code,project.name,project.projectCode].some(v=>String(v??'').toLowerCase()===query.toLowerCase()) || (process.env.INFOPLUS_VERSION && project.version!==process.env.INFOPLUS_VERSION)) throw Error('指定目录流程或版本不匹配');
        if (!flags.includes('--rescan')) cached=explicitOutput;
      }
    } else cached=flags.includes('--rescan')?undefined:await findCachedProject(query);
    if(!cached&&flags.includes('--offline'))throw new Error('未找到匹配的离线项目缓存');
    const directory=await prepareOfficial(cached??await scan(query,resolve(officialDirectory('_'),'..'),{staticOnly:true, outputDirectory:explicitOutput}));
    let online={status:'skipped',reason:'已指定离线或仅静态模式'};
    if(!flags.includes('--offline')&&!flags.includes('--static')){
      try{
        const endpoint=await chromeEndpoint();
        if(!endpoint)throw Error('专用 Chrome 未启动');
        const project=await json(join(directory,'project.json'));
        const connection=await attachChrome(endpoint);
        try{const result=await collectOnlineEvidence(connection.context,directory,project);online={status:'checked',debug:result.debug.entry,front:result.front,auto:result.auto};}
        finally{await connection.close();}
      }catch{online={status:'unavailable',reason:'专用 Chrome 或动态页面采集未完成，继续使用本地证据'};}
    }
    const reports=join(directory,'reports');await mkdir(reports,{recursive:true});
    const reportPath=join(reports,'run-report.json');
    const report={version,query,finishedAt:null,static:cached?'reused':'collected',online,documents:'pending'};
    await writeFile(reportPath,JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
    try{await main(['generate',directory]);report.documents=process.exitCode===2?'partial':'updated';}
    catch(error){report.documents='update-failed';throw error;}
    finally{report.finishedAt=new Date().toISOString();await writeFile(reportPath,JSON.stringify(report,null,2));}
    if(online.status==='unavailable')process.exitCode=2;
    return;
  }
  if(command==='coverage'&&input){
    const cached=explicitOutput || await findCachedProject(projectQuery(input));
    if(!cached)throw Error('未找到匹配的项目缓存');
    const report=await json(join(cached,'reports','path-coverage.json'));
    console.log(JSON.stringify(report.counts));
    console.log(join(cached,'reports','path-coverage.json'));
    return;
  }
  if (input && ['generate','generate-custom','analyze','options','collect-online','debug-session','debug-start','stages'].includes(command)) input=await prepareOfficial(input);
  if(command==='debug-start'&&input&&args[2]&&args[3]){
    const project=await json(join(input,'project.json'));
    const connection=await attachChrome();
    try{console.log(JSON.stringify(await launchDebug(connection.context,input,project,args[2],args[3])));}
    finally{await connection.close();}
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'debug-session' && input && args[2]) {
    const directory = resolve(input), project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
    const instanceId = args[2], operation = args[3] ?? 'observe';
    const registered = await readDebugRuns(directory, project);
    if (operation === 'adopt' && args[4] !== `${project.code}@${project.version}`)
      throw new Error('登记现有实例需要明确流程编号和版本');
    if (operation !== 'adopt' && !registered?.runs.some(run => run.origin === 'automatic-debug' && run.instanceId === instanceId))
      throw new Error('仅处理当前流程已登记的调试实例');
    const connection = await attachChrome();
    try {
      const pages = [];
      for (const page of connection.context.pages()) {
        try { const state = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId); pages.push({ page, state }); } catch {}
      }
      const active = pages.filter(p => p.state.status === 1);
      const candidates = active.length ? active : pages;
      if (candidates.length !== 1) throw new Error('需要唯一的同版本同实例页面，不能按最近标签页猜测实例');
      const {page, state} = candidates[0];
      let result;
      if (operation === 'verify' || operation === 'observe' || operation === 'adopt') {
        const modeEvidence = await verifyDebugInstance(page, project, state, { writable: operation === 'adopt' });
        await appendDebugEvent(directory, project, instanceId, { kind: 'debug-mode-verification', state, modeEvidence,
          ...(operation === 'adopt' ? { source: '用户手动推进后登记；此前动作未由工具执行' } : {}) });
        if (operation === 'verify') { console.log(JSON.stringify(modeEvidence)); return; }
        result = { stage: await captureDebugStep(page, directory, project, instanceId),
          tasks: await debugTaskLinks(page, project, instanceId) };
      }
      else if (operation === 'act' || operation === 'confirm') result = await actDebugStep(page, directory, project,
        { instanceId, label: args[4], scope: args[5], resumeConfirmation: operation === 'confirm' });
      else if (operation === 'next') result = await resumeDebugTask(page, directory, project,
        { instanceId, step: args[4], scope: args[5] });
      else throw new Error('Debug 操作仅支持 verify、observe、act、confirm、next');
      console.log(JSON.stringify(operation === 'observe' ? { state: result.stage.state,
        memberScopes: result.stage.memberScopes, screenshot: result.stage.screenshot, tasks: result.tasks } : result));
    } finally { await connection.close(); }
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'generate-custom' && input) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const cached = await readCompleteBundle(directory);
    const bundle = cached?.bundle ?? (await statIfPresent(join(directory, 'project.json'))
      ? await analyze(directory) : await json(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json')));
    await writeBusinessVersion(bundle, directory, args[2]);
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'workflow-original' && input) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const bundle = await json(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json'));
    const svg = args[2] ? await readFile(resolve(args[2]), 'utf8') : await originalWorkflowSource(directory);
    if (!svg) throw new Error('缺少 IDE Workflow 画布 SVG');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(await prepareOriginalWorkflow(svg, bundle, directory)));
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'capture' && input && args[2] && args[3]) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
    const network = await importHar(output, directory, project);
    const templates = await importTemplates(resolve(args[3]), directory);
    const options = await importOptionHar(output, directory, project);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ resources: network.captured.length, ...templates, formOptions: options }));
    await main(['generate', directory, '--refresh']);
    if (templates.failed.length) process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'scan' && input) {
    const directory = await scan(projectQuery(input), resolve(output),{staticOnly:args.includes('--static'),outputDirectory:explicitOutput});
    return main(['generate', directory, '--refresh']);
  }
  if (command === 'import-har' && input && args[2]) {
    const project = await json(join(output, 'project.json'));
    const result = await importHar(input, output, project);
    const options = await importOptionHar(input, output, project);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ resources: result.captured.length, missingBodies: result.missingBodies, formOptions: options }));
    if (!result.captured.length && !options.matched) process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'import-templates' && input && args[2]) {
    const result = await importTemplates(resolve(input), resolve(output));
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
    if (result.unmatched.length || result.failed.length) process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'import-options' && input && args[2]) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
    const bundle = await statIfPresent(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json')) &&
      await json(join(directory, 'normalized', 'bundle.json'));
    const result = await importOptionHar(resolve(output), directory, project, bundle);
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
    if (!result.matched) process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'options' && input) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
    const endpoint = await chromeEndpoint();
    if (!endpoint) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ formOptions: { added: 0, reason: '专用 Chrome 尚未启动，请运行 start-infoplus-chrome.ps1' } }));
      process.exitCode = 2;
      return;
    }
    const { context, close } = await attachChrome(endpoint);
    try {
      const result = await collectLiveOptions(context, directory, project, args[2] || process.env.INFOPLUS_FORM_URL);
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ formOptions: result }));
      if (!result.captured) process.exitCode = 2;
    } finally { await close(); }
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'collect-online' && input) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
    const endpoint = await chromeEndpoint();
    if (!endpoint) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ reason: '专用 Chrome 尚未启动，文档可继续使用本地证据' }));
      process.exitCode = 2;
      return;
    }
    const { context, close } = await attachChrome(endpoint);
    try {
      const result = await collectOnlineEvidence(context, directory, project);
      console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
      if (!result.front.stages.captured && !result.front.options.captured) process.exitCode = 2;
    } finally { await close(); }
    return;
  }
  if (command === 'stages' && input) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const project = await json(join(directory, 'project.json'));
    const endpoint = await chromeEndpoint();
    if (!endpoint) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ stagePages: { captured: 0, reason: '专用 Chrome 未启动，可使用 XSN 阶段图' } }));
      process.exitCode = 2;
      return;
    }
    const { context, close } = await attachChrome(endpoint);
    try {
      const result = await captureStagePages(context, directory, project, args[2]);
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ stagePages: result }));
      if (!result.captured) process.exitCode = 2;
    } finally { await close(); }
    return;
  }
  if (['analyze', 'generate'].includes(command) && input) {
    const directory = resolve(input);
    const cached = command === 'generate' && output !== '--refresh' ? await readCompleteBundle(directory) : undefined;
    const bundle = cached?.bundle ?? await analyze(directory);
    const report = cached?.report ?? inspect(bundle);
    report.missing = [...new Set([...report.missing, ...bundle.issues])];
    report.structuralChecksPassed = !report.missing.length;
    report.status = report.missing.length ? 'unverified' : 'structurally-verified';
    let documents;
    if (command === 'generate') {
      await generate(bundle, report, directory, cached?.mtimeMs);
      const business = await writeBusinessVersion(bundle, directory);
      documents = { business };
    } else await writeFile(join(directory, 'analysis-report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
    console.log(JSON.stringify({
      counts: report.counts, missing: report.missing.length, status: report.status,
      analysisCache: cached ? 'reused' : 'rebuilt', fieldOptions: report.fieldOptions, stagePages: report.stagePages,
      runtimeCoverage: report.runtimeCoverage, documents,
    }));
    if (report.missing.length) process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  if (['xsn', 'template-json'].includes(command) && input) {
    await withRenderer(async render => {
      const importer = command === 'xsn' ? importXsn : importTemplateJson;
      const result = await importer(resolve(input), resolve(output), render);
      console.log(JSON.stringify({
        fields: result.fields.length, views: result.views.length,
        screenshots: result.views.filter(view => view.screenshot).length,
      }));
    });
    return;
  }
  if(command!=='inspect'||!input) throw new Error('命令：scan <编号或名称>、collect-online <版本目录>、capture <版本目录> <HAR> <模板目录>、stages <版本目录> [已核实的前台入口 URL]、options <版本目录> [申请页 URL]、import-options <版本目录> <HAR>、inspect <bundle.json>、xsn <文件> <输出目录>、template-json <文件> <输出目录>、import-har <HAR> <版本目录>、import-templates <模板目录> <版本目录>、analyze <版本目录>、generate <版本目录> [--refresh]、generate-custom <版本目录> [模板 JSON]、workflow-original <版本目录> [IDE 画布 SVG]');
  const bundle=JSON.parse(await readFile(resolve(input),'utf8'));
  const report=inspect(bundle);
  await mkdir(resolve(output),{recursive:true});
  await writeFile(join(resolve(output),'analysis-report.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
  if(report.missing.length) process.exitCode=2;
}

async function writeBusinessVersion(bundle, directory, template) {
  const workflow = join(directory, 'workflow.mmd');
  if (existsSync(workflow)) {
    const evidence = ['debug-evidence-v12', 'debug-evidence'].map(name => join(directory,name)).find(existsSync);
    rebuildButtonMap({workflow,evidence,output:directory});
  }
  if (!await originalWorkflowImage(bundle, directory)) {
    const svg = await originalWorkflowSource(directory);
    if (svg) {
      try { await prepareOriginalWorkflow(svg, bundle, directory); }
      catch (error) { console.warn(`IDE 原图未采用：${error.message}`); }
    }
  }
  const { docxPath, hasOriginalDiagram } = await generateCustom(bundle, directory, template);
  console.log(`已生成 ${docxPath}`);
  if (!hasOriginalDiagram) console.warn('业务版附录 A 尚无可核对的 IDE 原图。请采集完整 Workflow SVG 后再生成。');
  return docxPath;
}
if(process.argv[1] && import.meta.url===pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) main(process.argv.slice(2)).catch(error=>{console.error('执行失败：', error.killed ? '子进程超时' : (process.env.INFOPLUS_DEBUG_STACK ? error.stack : error.message.split('\n')[0]));process.exitCode=1;});

=== src/debug-launch.mjs
import { resolveDebugLaunch, probeDebug } from './debug-probe.mjs';
import { requireDebugAuthorization, readDebugStep } from './debug-session.mjs';
import { appendDebugEvent, captureDebugStep, chooseDebugIdentity, readDebugRuns } from './debug-runtime.mjs';
import { loadDebugPolicy } from './debug-policy.mjs';
import { verifyDebugInstance } from './debug-verification.mjs';
import { mkdir, writeFile, readdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';

export function ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement(text) {
  const value = String(text ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return value.length <= 80 && /^(?:我已|本人已|已)(?:认真|仔细)?阅读(?:并(?:知悉|了解))?(?:以上|上述)?(?:内容|说明|须知|告知|条款)?[。！!]?$/u.test(value);
}

export async function launchDebug(context,directory,project,scope,plan){
  requireDebugAuthorization(project,scope);
  if(!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_-]{1,60}$/u.test(plan??''))throw Error('请指定唯一调试路径名');
  const prior=await readDebugRuns(directory,project);
  if(prior?.runs.some(run=>run.events.some(event=>event.planName===plan)))throw Error('此调试路径已有实例，请使用 debug-session 恢复');
  const policy=loadDebugPolicy();
  if ((prior?.runs?.length ?? 0) >= policy.maxInstancesPerWorkflow) throw Error('已达到此流程 Debug 实例上限');
  const probe=await probeDebug(context,project);
  if (!probe.entry.ideDebugEntry || !['identity-ready', 'delegation-interstitial'].includes(probe.entry.state))
    throw Error('未确认非发布 IDE Debug 启动入口');
  if (!policy.allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks && probe.boundary?.callbacks?.enabled !== 0)
    throw Error('策略禁止现有流程回调，或回调配置未能确认');
  const intent=join(directory,'raw',`debug-launch-intent-${plan}.json`);
  await mkdir(join(directory,'raw'),{recursive:true});
  for (const name of await readdir(join(directory,'raw'))) {
    if (!/^debug-launch-intent-.+\.json$/u.test(name)) continue;
    let record;
    try { record=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory,'raw',name),'utf8')); }
    catch { throw Error('已有启动登记不可读取，须先核查'); }
    if (record.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId && record.status !== 'registered')
      throw Error('已有未完成启动登记；须核对是否创建实例，避免重复启动');
  }
  try { await writeFile(intent,JSON.stringify({code:project.code,version:project.version,definitionId:project.workflowDefinitionId,status:'pending',plan,at:new Date().toISOString()}),{flag:'wx'}); }
  catch(error) { if(error.code==='EEXIST') throw Error('已有启动登记；须核对是否创建实例，避免重复启动'); throw error; }
  const page=await context.newPage();
  const entry=await resolveDebugLaunch(page,project);
  await page.goto(entry.href,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:15000});
  await page.locator('input[name=chooseEntrustee]').first().waitFor({timeout:10000});
  if (page.url() !== entry.href) throw Error('Debug 入口发生未核实跳转');
  const identity = await chooseDebugIdentity(page,{preferCandidate:false,waitForStep:false,allowCurrentLoginInterstitial:true});
  if (!identity.switched) throw Error(identity.reason ?? '未确认 Debug 入口身份窗口');
  const begin=page.locator('#preview_start_button').filter({visible:true});
  await begin.waitFor({timeout:12000});
  const unchecked=page.locator('input[type=checkbox]:not(:checked)').filter({visible:true});
  const acknowledgements = await unchecked.evaluateAll(elements => elements.map(e => {
    const label = e.labels?.length === 1 ? e.labels[0] : e.closest('label');
    return label?.innerText?.trim() || '';
  }));
  if (acknowledgements.length && acknowledgements.every(ordinaryWelcomeAcknowledgement)) {
    for (let i=0; i<acknowledgements.length; i++) await unchecked.first().check();
  }
  if(await unchecked.count()||!await begin.isEnabled()||await begin.getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true'){
    await writeFile(intent,JSON.stringify({code:project.code,version:project.version,definitionId:project.workflowDefinitionId,status:'welcome-review',plan,at:new Date().toISOString()}));
    return {status:'welcome-review',reason:'请阅读欢迎说明并完成适用的确认，随后使用现有实例命令采集'};
  }
  await begin.click({timeout:5000});
  await page.waitForURL(url=>url.origin===entry.origin&&/^\/infoplus\/form\/\d+\/render$/.test(url.pathname),{timeout:12000});
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>Boolean(window.$$?.entity?.step||document.querySelector('input[name=chooseEntrustee]')),undefined,{timeout:12000});
  if(await page.locator('input[name=chooseEntrustee]').count())await chooseDebugIdentity(page,{preferCandidate:false,allowCurrentLoginInterstitial:true});
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>Boolean(window.$$?.entity?.step),undefined,{timeout:12000});
  const instanceId=await page.evaluate(()=>window.$$.entity.step.instanceId);
  const state=await readDebugStep(page,project,instanceId);
  const modeEvidence = await verifyDebugInstance(page, project, state, { writable: state.executable });
  await appendDebugEvent(directory,project,instanceId,{kind:'path-plan',planName:plan,state,modeEvidence,source:'授权 Debug 启动'});
  await captureDebugStep(page,directory,project,instanceId);
  await writeFile(intent,JSON.stringify({code:project.code,version:project.version,definitionId:project.workflowDefinitionId,status:'registered',instanceId,plan,at:new Date().toISOString()}));
  return {status:state.executable?'ready':'permission-denied',instanceId,state};
}

=== END src/debug-launch.mjs
=== src/debug-policy.mjs
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const defaults = Object.freeze({ preferred: true, autoRun: true, allowNormalWorkflowActions: true,
  allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks: true, fallbackToFrontend: true, maxRetries: 2, maxInstancesPerWorkflow: 3 });

// Central policy describes permission for ordinary, non-release Debug only. It never
// overrides actual platform permissions, workflow identity checks or destructive guards.
export function loadDebugPolicy(file = new URL('../config/debug-policy.json', import.meta.url)) {
  let supplied = {};
  try { supplied = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
  const policy = { ...defaults };
  for (const key of ['preferred', 'autoRun', 'allowNormalWorkflowActions', 'allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks', 'fallbackToFrontend']) {
    if (key in supplied) {
      if (typeof supplied[key] !== 'boolean') throw new Error(`Debug 策略 ${key} 必须是布尔值`);
      policy[key] = supplied[key];
    }
  }
  for (const [key, max] of [['maxRetries', 5], ['maxInstancesPerWorkflow', 10]]) {
    if (key in supplied) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(supplied[key]) || supplied[key] < 0 || supplied[key] > max) throw new Error(`Debug 策略 ${key} 超出允许范围`);
      policy[key] = supplied[key];
    }
  }
  return policy;
}

export function debugAvailability(entry, policy = loadDebugPolicy()) {
  if (!policy.preferred) return { selectedMode: 'front', reason: '配置未启用后台 Debug 优先' };
  if (entry?.state === 'identity-ready') return { selectedMode: 'debug', reason: '非发布 Debug 身份入口可达；实际办理以实例证据为准' };
  if (entry?.state === 'delegation-interstitial' && entry.ideDebugEntry === true)
    return { selectedMode: 'debug', reason: 'IDE Debug 入口可达，当前仅显示委托中转页，仍须核对实例和调试身份' };
  if (entry?.state === 'permission-denied' || entry?.state === 'login-required') {
    return { selectedMode: 'unavailable', reason: 'Debug 权限或登录状态不足，不能绕过平台访问控制' };
  }
  return { selectedMode: policy.fallbackToFrontend ? 'front' : 'unavailable', reason: '后台 Debug 技术上未就绪' };
}

export function assertOrdinaryDebugAction(label, policy = loadDebugPolicy()) {
  if (!policy.allowNormalWorkflowActions) throw new Error('Debug 策略未启用常规办理动作');
  const dangerous = /删除|部署|发布|配置|撤销|终止|注销|同步|转账|付款|支付|退款|扣款|销户|清空|delete|deploy|publish|terminate/i;
  const ordinary = /^(?:申请人)?(?:提交(?:并打印|国合处审核|审核|申请)?|重新提交|审核通过|审批通过|通过|同意|批准|退回(?:申请人|申请人修改|修改|出访单位|所在单位流转|国合处|国合处负责人|给国合处修改|给申请人修改)?|重新选择|选择|保存|确认|已确认|已完成|完成|报销已完成|刷新预约结果|刷新查看(?:批件|申请表)|请领导审核|转(?:交|送|至|给|国合处)|否决申请|打印|下载(?:申请表|批件)?)$/;
  const bilingual = /^(提交\/Submit|审核通过\/Approved|审批通过\/Approved|重新提交\/Submit again|重新选择\/Select again|退回(?:申请人|申请人修改|修改|给申请人修改)\/Return for Modification|退回出访单位\/Return to unit|请领导审核\/Review by OGE Leader)$/;
  if (typeof label !== 'string' || dangerous.test(label) || !(ordinary.test(label.trim()) || bilingual.test(label.trim()))) {
    throw new Error('该动作不属于已授权的常规 Debug 办理');
  }
}

export function assertCallbacksAllowed(policy, boundary) {
  if (policy.allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks) return;
  if (!Number.isInteger(boundary?.callbacks?.enabled) || boundary.callbacks.enabled !== 0) {
    throw new Error('Debug 策略禁止现有业务回调，或回调配置尚未核实');
  }
}

=== END src/debug-policy.mjs
=== src/debug-probe.mjs
import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { DOMParser } from '@xmldom/xmldom';
import { entity } from './infoplus.mjs';
import { permittedProbeRequest } from './live-options.mjs';
import { debugAvailability } from './debug-policy.mjs';

export const debugProbeFile = 'raw/debug-probe.json';
export const debugProbeVersion = 1;
const definitionApi = '/infoplus/internal/findWorkflowDefinition';
const identityPrompt = 'DEBUG with arbitrary user identity?';
const idPattern = /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i;

export function debugEntry(href, project) {
  if (!href || !idPattern.test(project.workflowDefinitionId ?? '')) return;
  const source = URL.parse(project.source);
  const url = source && URL.parse(href, source);
  if (!url || source.protocol !== 'https:' || url.origin !== source.origin || url.username || url.password || url.hash ||
      url.pathname !== `/infoplus/form/${project.workflowDefinitionId}/start`) return;
  const query = url.searchParams;
  if (query.getAll('release').length !== 1 || query.get('release') !== 'false' ||
      query.getAll('entrust').length !== 1 || query.get('entrust') !== 'true' || query.getAll('theme').length > 1 ||
      [...query.keys()].some(key => !['release', 'entrust', 'theme'].includes(key)) ||
      query.has('theme') && !/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/i.test(query.get('theme'))) return;
  return url;
}

export function debugBoundary(definition, project) {
  const xml = definition?.guiDefinition;
  if (definition?.success !== true || typeof xml !== 'string' || /<!DOCTYPE|<!ENTITY/i.test(xml)) {
    return { status: 'unverified', reason: '未取得可核对的当前工作流定义' };
  }
  let root;
  try { root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml').documentElement; }
  catch { return { status: 'unverified', reason: '工作流定义无法解析' }; }
  if (root.tagName !== 'workflow' || !project.projectCode || root.getAttribute('code') !== project.projectCode) {
    return { status: 'unverified', reason: '工作流定义与目标项目不匹配' };
  }
  const events = Array.from(root.childNodes).find(node => node.nodeType === 1 && node.tagName === 'events');
  const enabled = Array.from(events?.childNodes ?? []).filter(node => node.nodeType === 1 && node.getAttribute('enabled') === 'true');
  const urls = enabled.map(node => [node.getAttribute('address')?.trim(), node.getAttribute('addressDev')?.trim()]);
  // A difference in URL or a test-like hostname is not evidence of isolated writes or notifications.
  const canonical = value => {
    const url = value && URL.parse(value);
    return url && ['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.origin + url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') : value;
  };
  const sharedEndpoints = urls.filter(([prod, dev]) => prod && dev && canonical(prod) === canonical(dev)).length;
  const missingDebugEndpoints = urls.filter(([, dev]) => !dev).length;
  return {
    status: sharedEndpoints ? 'shared-callback' : 'unverified',
    reason: sharedEndpoints ? '启用的外部事件在测试和正式环境使用同一回调地址' :
      missingDebugEndpoints ? '启用的外部事件缺少测试回调配置' : '未取得数据、通知及外部服务的独立隔离证明',
    released: definition.released === true,
    callbacks: { enabled: enabled.length, sharedEndpoints, missingDebugEndpoints },
  };
}

async function readVersion(page, project) {
  const version = page.getByRole('link', { name: `V-${project.version}`, exact: true });
  await version.first().waitFor({ timeout: 8000 });
  const rows = page.locator('tr').filter({ has: version });
  if (await rows.count() !== 1) return;
  return rows.evaluate((row, { versionName, prompt }) => {
    const editor = [...row.querySelectorAll('a[href$="/editor"]')].find(a => a.textContent.trim() === versionName);
    const entry = [...row.querySelectorAll('a[data-confirm]')].filter(a => a.dataset.confirm === prompt);
    const labels = [...row.cells].map(cell => cell.innerText.trim());
    const status = labels.find(text => /^(?:可用|不可用|禁用)$/.test(text));
    const deployment = labels.includes('未部署') ? 'not-deployed'
      : labels.includes('已部署') ? 'ide-reports-deployed' : 'unverified';
    return { editor: editor?.href, href: entry.length === 1 ? entry[0].getAttribute('href') : undefined, status, deployment };
  }, { versionName: `V-${project.version}`, prompt: identityPrompt });
}

export async function resolveDebugLaunch(page, project) {
  const source=new URL(project.source);
  if(source.protocol!=='https:'||source.username||source.password||!/^\/infoplus\/ide\/project\/[\w-]+\/?$/.test(source.pathname))throw Error('IDE 项目地址不合法');
  await page.goto(source.href,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT||30000)});
  const landed=new URL(page.url());
  if(landed.origin!==source.origin||landed.pathname!==source.pathname)throw Error('未进入目标 IDE 项目');
  const row=await readVersion(page,project);
  const entry=debugEntry(row?.href,project);
  if(!entry||row.editor!==project.editor||row.deployment==='not-deployed')throw Error('未确认同版本非发布 Debug 入口');
  return entry;
}

async function loadDefinition(page, project) {
  const result = await page.evaluate(async ({ path, definitionId }) => {
    const url = new URL(path, location.origin);
    url.searchParams.set('workflowDefinitionId', definitionId);
    const response = await fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error',
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6500) });
    return response.ok ? response.json() : null;
  }, { path: definitionApi, definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId });
  return entity(result);
}

async function probeEntry(context, entry) {
  const page = await context.newPage();
  try {
    const session = await context.newCDPSession(page);
    const top = (await session.send('Page.getFrameTree')).frameTree.frame.id;
    await session.send('Network.setBypassServiceWorker', { bypass: true });
    await page.addInitScript(() => { window.open = () => null; });
    await page.routeWebSocket('**/*', socket => socket.close());
    let opened = false;
    let loginRedirect = false;
    session.on('Fetch.requestPaused', async ({ requestId, request, resourceType, frameId }) => {
      try {
        const url = new URL(request.url);
        const type = resourceType.toLowerCase();
        const document = type === 'document' && frameId === top;
        const initial = document && !opened && url.href === entry.href && request.method === 'GET';
        if (initial) opened = true;
        if (document && url.origin === entry.origin && /\/(?:login|authorize)\/?$/i.test(url.pathname)) loginRedirect = true;
        const asset = ['image', 'font', 'script', 'stylesheet'].includes(type) &&
          permittedProbeRequest(url, request.method, type, entry);
        if (initial || asset) return await session.send('Fetch.continueRequest', { requestId });
      } catch { /* deny when a request cannot be classified */ }
      await session.send('Fetch.failRequest', { requestId, errorReason: 'BlockedByClient' }).catch(() => {});
    });
    await session.send('Fetch.enable', { patterns: [{ urlPattern: '*', requestStage: 'Request' }] });
    const response = await page.goto(entry.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 11000 }).catch(() => undefined);
    if (!response?.ok()) return { state: loginRedirect ? 'login-required' : 'unavailable', http: response?.status(), opened };
    await page.waitForFunction(() => {
      const text = document.body?.innerText ?? '';
      return document.querySelector('input[name="chooseEntrustee"]') ||
        /选择其它身份|选择其他身份|选择.*继续办理|not deployed|未部署|not enough permissions|无权限|服务器异常/i.test(text);
    }, null, { timeout: 6000 }).catch(() => {});
    const state = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const text = document.body?.innerText ?? '';
      if (/not deployed|未部署/i.test(text)) return 'not-deployed';
      if (/not enough permissions|无权限|权限不足/i.test(text)) return 'permission-denied';
      if (/服务器异常|服务不可用|service unavailable/i.test(text)) return 'unavailable';
      if (/Now you are going to debug this form as user|DEBUG with arbitrary user identity|正在调试模式/i.test(text)) return 'identity-ready';
      if (/本步支持委托办理/.test(text) && document.querySelector('input[name="chooseEntrustee"]')) return 'delegation-interstitial';
      return 'unverified';
    });
    return { state, http: response.status(), opened };
  } finally { await page.close(); }
}

export async function probeDebug(context, project, policy) {
  const report = { ...debugAvailability({ state: 'not-checked' }, policy), entry: { state: 'not-checked' }, deployment: 'unverified',
    boundary: { status: 'unverified' }, simulatedRoles: [], visitedNodes: [], verifiedPaths: [] };
  const source = URL.parse(project.source);
  const editor = URL.parse(project.editor);
  if (!source || source.protocol !== 'https:' || source.username || source.password ||
      !/^\/infoplus\/ide\/project\/[\w-]+\/?$/.test(source.pathname) ||
      editor?.origin !== source.origin || editor.pathname !== `/infoplus/ide/project/${project.workflowDefinitionId}/editor`) {
    return { ...report, reason: '缺少可核对的 IDE 项目或版本地址' };
  }
  const page = await context.newPage();
  try {
    await page.goto(source.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_NAV_TIMEOUT || 30000) });
    if (URL.parse(page.url())?.origin !== source.origin || URL.parse(page.url())?.pathname !== source.pathname) {
      if (/\/(?:login|authorize)\/?$/i.test(URL.parse(page.url())?.pathname ?? '')) {
        report.entry = { state: 'login-required' };
        Object.assign(report, debugAvailability(report.entry, policy));
      }
      return { ...report, reason: 'IDE 未返回目标项目' };
    }
    const row = await readVersion(page, project);
    if (row?.editor !== editor.href) return { ...report, reason: 'IDE 未返回与缓存匹配的版本' };
    report.ideVersionStatus = row.status;
    report.deployment = row.deployment;
    const definition = await loadDefinition(page, project).catch(() => undefined);
    report.boundary = debugBoundary(definition, project);
    const entry = debugEntry(row.href, project);
    if (!entry) return { ...report, reason: '未找到与该版本匹配的非发布 Debug 入口' };
    report.entry = await probeEntry(context, entry);
    report.entry.ideDebugEntry = true;
    if (report.entry.state === 'not-deployed') report.deployment = 'not-deployed';
    Object.assign(report, debugAvailability(report.entry, policy));
    report.reason = ['identity-ready', 'delegation-interstitial'].includes(report.entry.state) ? report.reason : ({
      'not-deployed': 'IDE 提示当前版本未部署', 'permission-denied': 'IDE 拒绝当前操作人的调试权限',
      'login-required': 'Debug 入口要求重新认证', 'unavailable': 'Debug 页面未能打开',
    })[report.entry.state] ?? '打开入口后未观察到身份选择窗口';
    return report;
  } catch {
    return { ...report, reason: '专用 Chrome 未能在时限内核对目标版本或 Debug 页面' };
  } finally { await page.close(); }
}

export async function saveDebugProbe(directory, project, result) {
  const path = join(directory, debugProbeFile);
  const tmp = `${path}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;
  await mkdir(join(directory, 'raw'), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(tmp, JSON.stringify({ format: debugProbeVersion, code: project.code, version: project.version,
    definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(), ...result }, null, 2) + '\n', { flag: 'wx' });
  await rename(tmp, path);
}

export async function readDebugProbe(directory, project) {
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, debugProbeFile), 'utf8'));
    if (value.format === debugProbeVersion && value.code === project.code && value.version === project.version &&
        value.definitionId === project.workflowDefinitionId) return value;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== 'ENOENT' && !(error instanceof SyntaxError)) throw error;
  }
}

=== END src/debug-probe.mjs
=== src/debug-progress.mjs
export function bindProgress(progress, instanceId) {
  if (progress.instanceId && progress.instanceId !== instanceId) throw Error('恢复记录属于其他实例');
  // Legacy records must be reconciled with the currently observed task before any action.
  return {...progress, instanceId, needsReconciliation:!progress.instanceId && Boolean(progress.trace?.length),
    trace:progress.trace || [], visited:progress.visited || []};
}
export function reconcileProgress(progress, state) {
  if (state?.instanceId !== progress.instanceId) throw Error('当前页面不属于恢复实例');
  if (progress.needsReconciliation) {
    const last=progress.trace.at(-1);
    if (String(last?.flowStepId) !== String(state.flowStepId)) throw Error('旧检查点与当前待办不一致，需要先核对实例历史');
    progress.needsReconciliation=false;
  }
  return state.status === 2 ? 'completed-step-reconcile-tasks' : 'observe-current-step';
}

=== END src/debug-progress.mjs
=== src/debug-runtime.mjs
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, rename } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { readDebugStep, requireDebugAuthorization, submitDebugAction } from './debug-session.mjs';
import { loadDebugPolicy, assertCallbacksAllowed } from './debug-policy.mjs';
import { readDebugProbe } from './debug-probe.mjs';
import { requireDebugPage, verifyDebugInstance } from './debug-verification.mjs';

export const debugRuntimeFile = 'raw/debug-runs.json';
export const debugRuntimeVersion = 1;
const pause = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const idPattern = /^[a-f\d]{8}(?:-[a-f\d]{4}){3}-[a-f\d]{12}$/i;

export async function readDebugRuns(directory, project) {
  let data;
  try { data = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, debugRuntimeFile), 'utf8')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return; throw error; }
  if (data.version !== project.version || data.definitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId || data.code !== project.code ||
      !Array.isArray(data.runs) || data.runs.some(run => !idPattern.test(run.instanceId))) throw new Error('Debug 运行证据与当前版本不匹配');
  return data;
}

export async function appendDebugEvent(directory, project, instanceId, event) {
  if (!idPattern.test(instanceId)) throw new Error('无效的调试实例编号');
  const data = await readDebugRuns(directory, project) ?? { schemaVersion: debugRuntimeVersion, code: project.code,
    version: project.version, definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId, runs: [] };
  let run = data.runs.find(run => run.instanceId === instanceId);
  if (!run) data.runs.push(run = { instanceId, origin: 'automatic-debug', events: [] });
  if (run.origin !== 'automatic-debug') throw new Error('不能将自动观察写入手动实例');
  run.events.push({ at: new Date().toISOString(), ...event });
  await mkdir(join(directory, 'raw'), { recursive: true });
  const path = join(directory, debugRuntimeFile), temp = `${path}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;
  await writeFile(temp, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
  await rename(temp, path);
  return event;
}

export function memberScopeDescription(settings = {}) {
  const filter = settings.userFilters;
  if (!filter) return '未取得明确的候选范围配置，不能据此认定可选择任意人员。';
  if (filter === '*:FACULTY') return '配置教职工筛选及通配前缀；跨单位候选边界尚未实测，不能据此前缀认定全校可选。';
  if (filter === ':FACULTY') return '配置教职工筛选，组织前缀为空；尚不能确定是否按申请人或当前办理人的单位限制。';
  return '配置了特定角色或组织过滤；具体候选范围及空结果处理需结合当前阶段验证。';
}

export function safeMemberFilters(params) {
  let settings = {};
  try { settings = JSON.parse(params.get('settings') || '{}'); } catch { /* Keep malformed evidence unexpanded. */ }
  return Object.fromEntries(['userFilters','userTraversal'].flatMap(key => {
    const value = params.get(key) ?? settings?.[key];
    return typeof value === 'boolean' || typeof value === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z_*:,. -]{0,150}$/.test(value)
      ? [[key,value]] : [];
  }));
}

export async function captureDebugStep(page, directory, project, instanceId, role) {
  const state = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  requireDebugPage(state);
  const detail = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const f = window.$$?.entity;
    const visible = e => e.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden';
    return Object.values(f.fields ?? {}).filter(field => field.bound).map(field => {
      const controls = [...document.querySelectorAll('[name]')].filter(e =>
        e.name === field.name || e.name === 'radioList-' + field.name || e.name?.startsWith(field.name + '_'));
      const display = controls.map(e => e.closest('.infoplus_labelControlContainer, .infoplus_fileControl') ?? e);
      const active = display.filter(visible);
      const displayOnly = active.length > 0 && active.every(e => e.classList.contains('infoplus_labelControlContainer'));
      const settings = field.settings && Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(field.settings)
        .filter(([k, v]) => ['userFilters', 'userTraversal'].includes(k) && ['string', 'boolean'].includes(typeof v)));
      return { id: field.name, name: field.label || field.description || field.name, type: field.type,
        required: field.notNull === true, permission: field.permission, visible: active.length > 0,
        readOnly: displayOnly || (field.permission ? !field.permission.includes('w') : null),
        displayOnly,
        fieldChanging: field.fieldChanging === true, group: field.groupName, repeatDepth: field.repeatDepth,
        settings, validation: field.regEx, validationMessage: field.prompt,
        // Existing instance values are never interpreted as default values.
        defaultValue: field.type !== 'User' && field.type !== 'Organize' && typeof field.initialValue === 'string' &&
          /^[-\d.]{1,4}$/.test(field.initialValue) ? field.initialValue : undefined };
    });
  });
  const event = { kind: 'stage', state, role: role || state.name.trim(), source: '后台 Debug 实际观察',
    fields: detail, memberScopes: detail.filter(f => f.type === 'User').map(f => ({
      fieldId: f.id, fieldName: f.name, settings: f.settings,
      description: memberScopeDescription(f.settings), source: 'runtime-field-configuration', verifiedCandidates: false,
    })) };
  const imagePath = `views/${state.viewId}/debug-${state.flowStepId}.png`;
  try {
    // Mask personal field values, identity banners, and instance history; preserve labels and layout.
    const masks = page.locator('input, textarea, select, .select2-selection__rendered, .infoplus_labelControlContainer, .infoplus_labelControl, #command_holder, .commandBar_helper, [id*=entrust], [id*=history], [id*=History], [id*=user], [id*=User], .form_remark_title, .color_b2');
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(directory, imagePath), fullPage: true, mask: [masks], maskColor: '#dce3eb', timeout: 12000 });
    event.screenshot = imagePath;
    event.screenshotNote = '后台 Debug 完整页面截图，字段值及身份信息已遮盖';
    event.keyScreenshots = [];
    for (const field of detail.filter(f => f.visible && (f.settings?.userFilters || f.fieldChanging)).slice(0, 6)) {
      if (!/^[\w]+$/.test(field.id)) continue;
      const control = page.locator(`[name="${field.id}"], [name^="${field.id}_"], [name="radioList-${field.id}"]`).filter({ visible: true }).first();
      if (!await control.count()) continue;
      const row = control.locator('xpath=ancestor::tr[1]');
      if (!await row.count()) continue;
      const folder = `debug-evidence/${state.nodeId}`;
      await mkdir(join(directory, folder), { recursive: true });
      const file = `${folder}/${state.flowStepId}-${field.id}.png`;
      try {
        await row.screenshot({ path: join(directory,file), mask:[masks], maskColor:'#dce3eb', timeout:4000 });
        event.keyScreenshots.push({ file, fieldId:field.id, nodeId:state.nodeId, instanceId,
          at:new Date().toISOString(), condition:'本次页面观测条件，未进行独立因果验证', note:'真实字段所在行截图；字段值已遮盖' });
      } catch { /* Full-page evidence remains available when a local capture cannot be obtained. */ }
    }
  } catch { event.screenshotIssue = '完整截图未成功，保留原有 XSN 阶段图，不将静态图标为实测'; }
  await appendDebugEvent(directory, project, instanceId, event);
  return event;
}

export async function debugTaskLinks(page, project, instanceId) {
  await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  return page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].flatMap(a => {
    const raw = a.getAttribute('href');
    if (!raw || raw.startsWith('#')) return [];
    const url = new URL(raw, location.href);
    const match = /^\/infoplus\/form\/(\d+)\/render\/?$/.exec(url.pathname);
    if (!match || url.origin !== location.origin || url.hash || url.searchParams.has('snapshot') ||
        url.searchParams.get('entrust') !== 'true' || !a.innerText.trim()) return [];
    return [{ step: Number(match[1]), name: a.innerText.trim(), url: url.href }];
  }));
}

export async function chooseDebugIdentity(page, { preferCandidate = true, waitForStep = true, allowCurrentLoginInterstitial = false } = {}) {
  // Only call after a same-instance task link has been verified by resumeDebugTask.
  const choice = await page.evaluate(({ prefer, allowCurrentLoginInterstitial }) => {
    const ds = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog')].filter(d => d.getClientRects().length &&
      d.querySelector('input[name="chooseEntrustee"]'));
    if (ds.length !== 1) return null;
    const text = ds[0].innerText;
    // V1.2：兼容平台中文 DEBUG 身份窗口（当前调试人 / 指定账号 / 切换输入 / 继续办理此业务）
    const explicit = /Now you are going to debug this form as user|DEBUG with arbitrary user identity|正在调试模式|您当前正在以.{0,80}身份进行调试办理|指定账号|切换输入|请点击继续办理此业务/i.test(text);
    if (!explicit && !(allowCurrentLoginInterstitial && !prefer && /本步支持委托办理/.test(text))) return null;
    const radios = [...ds[0].querySelectorAll('input[name="chooseEntrustee"]')];
    const candidate = prefer && radios.length > 2 ? radios[2] : radios[0];
    candidate?.click();
    return { dialog: ds[0].id, debugIdentityPrompt: explicit, candidateCount: Math.max(0, radios.length - 2),
      choice: prefer && radios.length > 2 ? 'platform-task-candidate' : 'current-login' };
  }, { prefer: preferCandidate, allowCurrentLoginInterstitial });
  if (!choice) return { switched: false, reason: '未出现平台身份选择窗口' };
  const clicked = await page.evaluate(id => {
    const d = document.getElementById(id);
    const buttons = [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(e => /^(继续|切换|Continue|Switch)$/.test(e.innerText.trim()));
    if (buttons.length !== 1) return false;
    buttons[0].click(); return true;
  }, choice.dialog);
  if (clicked && waitForStep) await page.waitForFunction(() => !!window.$$?.entity?.step, undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 15000 });
  return { ...choice, switched: clicked };
}

export async function resumeDebugTask(page, directory, project, { instanceId, scope, step }) {
  requireDebugAuthorization(project, scope);
  const before = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  await verifyDebugInstance(page, project, before);
  const tasks = await debugTaskLinks(page, project, instanceId);
  const target = tasks.filter(t => t.step === Number(step));
  if (target.length !== 1) throw new Error('目标步骤未出现在当前实例的实际待办链接中');
  await page.goto(target[0].url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 20000 });
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('input[name="chooseEntrustee"]') || !!window.$$?.entity?.step,
    undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 15000 });
  const identity = await chooseDebugIdentity(page);
  const after = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  if (after.flowStepId !== target[0].step) throw new Error('身份切换后步骤与选定待办不一致');
  const modeEvidence = await verifyDebugInstance(page, project, after, { writable: after.executable });
  await appendDebugEvent(directory, project, instanceId, { kind: 'resume', before, after,
    modeEvidence,
    identity: { choice: identity.choice, candidateCount: identity.candidateCount, switched: identity.switched },
    permissionVerified: after.executable, role: target[0].name });
  return { state: after, identity, tasks: await debugTaskLinks(page, project, instanceId) };
}

export async function actDebugStep(page, directory, project, options) {
  const policy = loadDebugPolicy();
  if (!policy.allowExistingWorkflowCallbacks) {
    const probe = await readDebugProbe(directory, project);
    assertCallbacksAllowed(policy, probe?.boundary);
  }
  if (options.resumeConfirmation) {
    const data = await readDebugRuns(directory, project);
    const previous = data?.runs.find(r => r.instanceId === options.instanceId)?.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'action').at(-1);
    const current = await readDebugStep(page, project, options.instanceId);
    if (!previous || previous.submitted || previous.before.flowStepId !== current.flowStepId || previous.action.label !== options.label) {
      throw new Error('没有可恢复的同一步骤未发送办理确认');
    }
  }
  await captureDebugStep(page, directory, project, options.instanceId, options.role);
  const result = await submitDebugAction(page, project, options);
  await appendDebugEvent(directory, project, options.instanceId, { kind: 'action', ...result,
    success: result.submitted && result.http === 200 && result.errno === 0 });
  // Only refresh after the server has acknowledged a successful action, never to discard pending input.
  if (result.submitted && result.http === 200 && result.errno === 0) {
    await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 20000 });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !!document.querySelector('input[name="chooseEntrustee"]') || !!window.$$?.entity?.step,
      undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 15000 });
    await chooseDebugIdentity(page, { preferCandidate: false, allowCurrentLoginInterstitial: true });
    const after = await readDebugStep(page, project, options.instanceId);
    requireDebugPage(after);
    await pause(1200); // The history/progress read completes after the form render.
    const tasks = await debugTaskLinks(page, project, options.instanceId);
    await appendDebugEvent(directory, project, options.instanceId, { kind: 'after-action', before: result.before,
      action: result.action, after, tasks, completed: after.status === 2 });
    return { ...result, after, tasks };
  }
  return result;
}

export async function chooseDebugMember(page, directory, project, { scope, instanceId, fieldId }) {
  requireDebugAuthorization(project, scope);
  const state = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  if (!/^[\w]+$/.test(fieldId)) throw new Error('成员选择需要已识别字段');
  await verifyDebugInstance(page, project, state, { writable: true });
  const requests = [];
  const listen = response => {
    const u = URL.parse(response.url());
    if (u?.origin !== new URL(project.source).origin || !/\/suggest$/.test(u.pathname)) return;
    const request = response.request();
    const params = new URLSearchParams(request.postData() || u.search);
    requests.push({ endpoint: u.pathname, http: response.status(), parameterNames: [...params.keys()],
      filters: safeMemberFilters(params) });
  };
  page.on('response', listen);
  try {
    const opened = await page.evaluate(fieldId => {
      const field = window.$$?.entity?.fields?.[fieldId];
      if (field?.type !== 'User' || !field.permission?.includes('w')) return false;
      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].filter(e => e.getClientRects().length &&
        (e.name === fieldId || e.name.startsWith(fieldId + '_')) && !e.disabled);
      if (candidates.length !== 1) return false;
      window.jQuery(candidates[0]).select2('open');return true;
    }, fieldId);
    if (!opened) throw new Error('未找到唯一可写成员控件');
    await pause(300);
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      const message = document.querySelector('.select2-results')?.innerText ?? '';
      const input = document.querySelector('.select2-container--open input.select2-search__field');
      if (input && /请输入/.test(message)) { input.value = '1'; window.jQuery(input).trigger('input'); }
    });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.select2-results__option')].some(e =>
      e.getAttribute('aria-selected') !== null && e.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true'), undefined, { polling: 100, timeout: 10000 });
    const selected = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.select2-results__option')].filter(e =>
        e.getAttribute('aria-selected') !== null && e.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true');
      if (!items.length) return { count: 0, selected: false };
      window.jQuery(items[0]).trigger('mouseup');
      return { count: items.length, selected: true };
    });
    await pause(500);
    await appendDebugEvent(directory, project, instanceId, { kind: 'member-choice', state, fieldId,
      ...selected, requests, policy: '平台当前候选列表中的首个可选身份，仅用于授权 Debug 角色模拟；不导出人员名单',
      completeness: 'observed-page-only' });
    return { fieldId, ...selected, requests };
  } finally { page.off('response', listen); }
}

export function runtimeSummary(data) {
  const runs = data?.runs?.filter(r => r.origin === 'automatic-debug') ?? [];
  const stages = runs.flatMap(run => run.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'stage').map(e => ({ ...e, instanceId: run.instanceId })));
  const completed = runs.flatMap(run => run.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'after-action' && e.completed));
  return { instances: runs.length, observedNodes: [...new Set(stages.map(e => e.state.nodeId))],
    modeEvidence: runs.flatMap(run => run.events.flatMap(e => e.modeEvidence ? [e.modeEvidence] : [])),
    completedNodes: [...new Set(completed.map(e => e.before.nodeId))],
    roles: [...new Set(stages.filter(e => e.state.executable).map(e => e.role))],
    actions: runs.flatMap(run => run.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'action' && e.success).map(e => ({
      instanceId: run.instanceId, nodeId: e.before.nodeId, name: e.before.name, action: e.action.label }))),
    // No automatic claim of end-to-end coverage from an empty task list or an HTTP success alone.
    verifiedPaths: runs.flatMap(run => run.verifiedPaths ?? []), stages };
}

=== END src/debug-runtime.mjs
=== src/debug-session.mjs
const stepPath = /^\/infoplus\/form\/(\d+)\/render\/?$/;
const instancePattern = /^[a-f\d]{8}(?:-[a-f\d]{4}){3}-[a-f\d]{12}$/i;
const actionPath = '/infoplus/interface/doAction';
import { assertOrdinaryDebugAction } from './debug-policy.mjs';
import { requireDebugPage, verifyDebugInstance } from './debug-verification.mjs';

import { classifyDialog } from './dialog-classification.mjs';
export function ordinaryConfirmation(text, action) {
 return ['information', 'submission-confirmation'].includes(classifyDialog(text, action));
}

export function redactDebugText(text) {
  return String(text ?? '').replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s,]+/g,'（服务地址已脱敏）').replace(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+/g, '（邮箱已脱敏）')
    .replace(/\b\d{5,}\b/g, '（编号已脱敏）');
}

export function requireDebugAuthorization(project, scope) {
  const expected = `${project.code}@${project.version}`;
  if (!scope || scope !== expected) throw new Error('需要本次用户授权的流程编号和版本');
}

export function matchesDebugAction(request, origin, step, action) {
  const url = URL.parse(request.url);
  if (!url || url.origin !== origin || url.pathname !== actionPath || url.search || request.method !== 'POST') return false;
  const body = new URLSearchParams(request.body);
  return body.getAll('stepId').length === 1 && body.get('stepId') === String(step) &&
    body.getAll('actionId').length === 1 && body.get('actionId') === String(action);
}

export async function readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId) {
  const url = URL.parse(page.url());
  const origin = new URL(project.source).origin;
  const path = url && stepPath.exec(url.pathname);
  if (!path || url.origin !== origin || !instancePattern.test(instanceId ?? '')) throw new Error('目标不是已登记的 Debug 页面');
  const state = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const form = window.$$?.entity;
    const step = form?.step;
    const debugCommand = document.querySelector('#FormCommandDebug');
    const debugMarker = Boolean(debugCommand?.getClientRects().length &&
      /正在调试模式|debug mode/i.test(debugCommand.textContent));
    const user = form?.userId;
    const actionAccount = form?.data?._VAR_ACTION_ACCOUNT;
    const executionCodes = form?.data?._VAR_EXECUTE_USERCODES;
    const delegatedMatch = !step?.assignUser && !step?.users?.length &&
      typeof actionAccount === 'string' && actionAccount.length > 0 && executionCodes === actionAccount &&
      form?.permission?.executable === true;
    const identityMatched = typeof user === 'string' && user.length > 0 &&
      (step?.assignUser === user || (!step?.assignUser && Array.isArray(step?.users) && step.users.includes(user)) || delegatedMatch);
    return {
      definitionId: step?.definitionId, instanceId: step?.instanceId, release: step?.entryRelease,
      entryId: step?.entryId, debugMarker, identityMatched,
      flowStepId: step?.flowStepId, nodeId: step?.stepId, name: step?.name, status: step?.status, entryStatus: step?.entryStatus,
      executable: form?.permission?.executable === true, viewId: form?.viewId,
      actions: (form?.actions ?? []).filter(action => action.visible !== false).map(action => ({
        id: action.id, label: action.name, remarkRequired: action.remarkRequired === true,
      })),
    };
  });
  if (state.release !== false || state.definitionId !== project.workflowDefinitionId || state.instanceId !== instanceId ||
      String(state.flowStepId) !== path[1]) throw new Error('页面未证实为授权版本和实例的非发布步骤');
  return state;
}

export async function submitDebugAction(page, project, { scope, instanceId, label, resumeConfirmation = false }) {
  requireDebugAuthorization(project, scope);
  assertOrdinaryDebugAction(label);
  const state = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  const modeEvidence = await verifyDebugInstance(page, project, state, { writable: true });
  const current = await readDebugStep(page, project, instanceId);
  requireDebugPage(current, { writable: true });
  if (current.flowStepId !== state.flowStepId || current.entryId !== state.entryId) throw new Error('核对 DEBUG 后页面步骤已变化');
  const actions = state.actions.filter(action => action.label === label);
  if (!state.executable || state.status !== 1 || actions.length !== 1 || !Number.isSafeInteger(actions[0].id)) {
    throw new Error('当前模拟身份无权限，或办理动作不唯一');
  }
  const action = actions[0];
  const origin = new URL(project.source).origin;
  const responses = [];
  const responseTasks = [];
  const confirmations = [];
  const seenDialogs = new Set();
  const onDialog = async dialog => {
    const accepted = ['alert', 'confirm'].includes(dialog.type()) && ordinaryConfirmation(dialog.message(), label);
    confirmations.push({ type: dialog.type(), trigger: label, text: redactDebugText(dialog.message()), classification: classifyDialog(dialog.message(), label), accepted });
    await (accepted ? dialog.accept() : dialog.dismiss()).catch(() => {});
  };
  let submitted = false;
  let rejected = false;
  const routePath = `**${actionPath}`;
  const guard = async route => {
    const request = route.request();
    if (submitted || !matchesDebugAction({ url: request.url(), method: request.method(), body: request.postData() },
      origin, state.flowStepId, action.id)) {
      rejected = true;
      return route.abort();
    }
    submitted = true;
    return route.continue();
  };
  const listen = response => {
    const url = URL.parse(response.url());
    if (url?.origin !== origin || !['/infoplus/interface/listNextStepsUsers', actionPath].includes(url.pathname)) return;
    const record = { endpoint: url.pathname, http: response.status() };
    responses.push(record);
    responseTasks.push(response.json().then(payload => {
      record.errno = payload.errno;
      if (payload.error) record.error = redactDebugText(payload.error);
      if (url.pathname.endsWith('listNextStepsUsers') && payload.errno === 0) {
        record.nextTasks = (payload.entities ?? []).map(task => ({ nodeId: task.stepId, name: task.name,
          parallel: task.parallel, release: task.entryRelease, candidateCount: task.users?.length,
          instantNotification: task.hasInstantNotification, carbonNotification: task.hasCarbonNotification }));
      }
    }).catch(() => {}));
  };
  await page.route(routePath, guard);
  page.on('response', listen);
  page.on('dialog', onDialog);
  try {
    const pending = page.waitForResponse(response => matchesDebugAction({ url: response.url(),
      method: response.request().method(), body: response.request().postData() }, origin, state.flowStepId, action.id),
      { timeout: Number(process.env.INFOPLUS_ACTION_WAIT_TIMEOUT || 95000) }).catch(() => undefined);
    const clicked = resumeConfirmation || await page.evaluate(({ id, label }) => {
      const visible = element => element.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(element).visibility === 'visible' &&
        !element.closest('[aria-disabled=true]');
      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[name^="infoplus_action_"]')]
        .filter(element => element.getAttribute('name').endsWith(`_${id}`) && element.innerText.trim() === label && visible(element));
      if (candidates.length !== 1) return false;
      candidates[0].click();
      return true;
    }, action);
    if (!clicked) throw new Error('未找到唯一的可见办理按钮');
    // InfoPlus can open a page-level confirmation before issuing doAction.
    // Keep the exact-step request guard active throughout that confirmation.
    const deadline = Date.now() + 15000;
    while (!submitted && Date.now() < deadline) {
      const dialogs = await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog, [role="dialog"]')]
        .filter(e => e.getClientRects().length).map(e => ({ id: e.id, text: e.innerText,
          buttons: [...e.querySelectorAll('a,button,input[type=button]')].map(b => b.innerText?.trim() || b.value) }))).catch(() => []);
      let handled = false;
      for (const dialog of dialogs) {
        const key = dialog.id + dialog.text;
        if (seenDialogs.has(key)) continue;
        if (!ordinaryConfirmation(dialog.text, label)) {
 confirmations.push({ type: 'page', trigger: label, text: redactDebugText(dialog.text), classification: classifyDialog(dialog.text, label), accepted: false });
 seenDialogs.add(key); continue;
}
        seenDialogs.add(key);
        const clickedConfirmation = await page.evaluate(({ text }) => {
          const ds = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog, [role="dialog"]')]
            .filter(e => e.getClientRects().length && e.innerText === text);
          if (ds.length !== 1) return false;
          const buttons = [...ds[0].querySelectorAll('a,button,input[type=button]')]
            .filter(e => /^(确定|确认|是|好|OK|Yes|Continue)$/i.test(e.innerText?.trim() || e.value));
          if (buttons.length !== 1) return false;
          buttons[0].click(); return true;
        }, dialog);
        confirmations.push({ type: 'page', trigger: label, text: redactDebugText(dialog.text), accepted: clickedConfirmation });
        handled ||= clickedConfirmation;
      }
      if (dialogs.length && !handled) break;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
    }
    const response = await pending;
    const payload = await response?.json().catch(() => undefined);
    await Promise.allSettled(responseTasks);
    return { before: state, modeEvidence, action, submitted, rejected, http: response?.status(), errno: payload?.errno,
      nextRender: stepPath.exec(URL.parse(page.url())?.pathname ?? '')?.[1], responses, confirmations };
  } finally {
    page.off('response', listen);
    page.off('dialog', onDialog);
    await page.unroute(routePath, guard);
  }
}

=== src/debug-verification.mjs
import { resolveDebugLaunch } from './debug-probe.mjs';

export function requireDebugPage(state, { writable = false } = {}) {
  if (state.release !== false || !state.debugMarker || !/^\d+$/.test(String(state.entryId))) {
    throw new Error('页面缺少非发布实例和平台调试模式标记，不能确认为后台 DEBUG');
  }
  if (writable && (!state.executable || state.status !== 1 || !state.identityMatched)) {
    throw new Error('当前调试身份未与办理人核对一致，或步骤不可办理');
  }
}

export async function verifyDebugInstance(page, project, state, options) {
  requireDebugPage(state, options);
  const evidencePage = await page.context().newPage();
  try {
    const entry = await resolveDebugLaunch(evidencePage, project);
    const list = new URL(`/infoplus/ide/project/${project.workflowDefinitionId}/instances?release=false`, entry.origin);
    for (const keyword of ['', String(state.entryId)]) {
      if (keyword) list.searchParams.set('keyword', keyword);
      const response = await evidencePage.goto(list.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 10000 });
      if (!response?.ok() || evidencePage.url() !== list.href) break;
      const result = await evidencePage.evaluate(({ path, entryId }) => {
        const debugTab = [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(a => {
          const url = new URL(a.href);
          return a.textContent.trim() === 'DEBUG' && a.parentElement.classList.contains('selected') &&
            url.origin === location.origin && url.pathname === path && url.searchParams.get('release') === 'false';
        });
        const detailPath = path.replace(/\/instances$/, '/instance/') + entryId;
        const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('table tr')].filter(row =>
          row.cells[0]?.textContent.trim() === entryId && [...row.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].some(a => {
            const url = new URL(a.href);
            return url.origin === location.origin && url.pathname === detailPath && url.searchParams.get('release') === 'false';
          }));
        return { debugTab: Boolean(debugTab), entries: rows.length, status: rows[0]?.cells[5]?.textContent.trim() };
      }, { path: list.pathname, entryId: String(state.entryId) });
      if (!result.debugTab) break;
      if (result.entries === 1) {
        if (options?.writable && result.status !== '进行中') throw new Error('IDE DEBUG 实例状态不是进行中');
        return { verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(), version: project.version, definitionId: project.workflowDefinitionId,
          instanceId: state.instanceId, entryId: state.entryId, flowStepId: state.flowStepId,
          ideDebugEntry: true, debugTab: true, listedStatus: result.status, debugMarker: true,
          identityMatched: state.identityMatched };
      }
    }
    throw new Error('未能在目标版本的 IDE Instances → DEBUG 核对当前实例');
  } finally {
    await evidencePage.close();
  }
}

=== src/dialog-classification.mjs
// Ordered by consequences, never by the presence of an OK button.
export function classifyDialog(text, action = '') {
  const value = String(text || '');
  if (/删除|部署|发布|配置|撤销流程|终止流程|delete|deploy|publish|terminate/i.test(value + action)) return 'unknown';
  if (/超时|timeout|服务异常|服务不可用|连接失败|回调失败|HTTP\s*5\d\d/i.test(value)) return 'external-service';
  if (/至少.{0,12}(填写|选择|上传)|编号不存在|批件制作中|不满足|无权限|没有权限|请确认已完成|业务条件/i.test(value)) return 'business-validation';
  if (/格式|正确的.{0,12}(联系|电话|邮箱|日期|证件)|invalid|无效/i.test(value)) return 'format-validation';
  if (/必填|必须填写|未填写|请填写|请上传|请选择|内容完整|required/i.test(value)) return 'required-validation';
  if (/失败|错误|error|failed/i.test(value)) return 'unknown';
  if (/如有其它相关说明，请点击备注|打印提示|调试说明|仅供调试|操作成功|Done successfully/i.test(value)) return 'information';
  if (value.length < 1500 && /提交|通过|确认|完成|退回|重新办理|转.{1,30}/.test(action) &&
      /(?:确认|确定|是否|继续).{0,30}(?:提交|通过|完成|退回|转交|办理)|(?:sure|confirm).{0,30}(?:submit|approve)/i.test(value)) return 'submission-confirmation';
  return 'unknown';
}

export function submissionOutcome(result) {
  const response = result?.responses?.findLast(r => r.endpoint?.endsWith('doAction'));
  if (result?.http >= 500 || response?.http >= 500) return 'external-service';
  if (result?.submitted && response?.errno === 0 && result.http === 200) return 'accepted';
  if (response?.errno !== undefined && response.errno !== 0) return classifyDialog(response.error);
  if (result?.submitted || !result) return 'unknown';
  return result.confirmations?.map(c => c.classification).find(c => /validation$/.test(c)) || 'unknown';
}

=== src/field-atomic.mjs
const clean = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

// Field identity comes from structured data. Group is only a display attribute.
// Different field IDs are never merged, even when names/types/rules/stages match.
export function atomicFieldRows(records, { groupName, viewOrder = new Map(), fieldsById } = {}) {
  const byId = new Map();
  for (const record of records) {
    const id = record.id ?? record.fieldId;
    if (!id || /^_VAR_/i.test(String(id))) continue;
    if (!byId.has(id)) byId.set(id, []);
    byId.get(id).push(record);
  }
  return [...byId].map(([id, items]) => {
    const canonical = fieldsById?.get(id) ?? items.find(item => item.name && item.name !== id) ?? items[0];
    const stages = [...new Set(items.flatMap(item => item.stages ?? [item.view ?? item.stage]).filter(Boolean))]
      .sort((a, b) => (viewOrder.get(a) ?? Infinity) - (viewOrder.get(b) ?? Infinity));
    const requiredParts = [];
    for (const item of items) {
      const itemStages = item.stages ?? [item.view ?? item.stage];
      if (item.required === true) requiredParts.push(`${itemStages.map(clean).filter(Boolean).join('、') || '未标明阶段'}必填`);
      else if (item.required === false) requiredParts.push(`${itemStages.map(clean).filter(Boolean).join('、') || '未标明阶段'}可选`);
    }
    const rules = [...new Set(items.flatMap(item => item.rules ?? []).filter(Boolean))];
    const source = clean(canonical.source ?? items.find(item => item.source)?.source);
    const rule = [...new Set(items.flatMap(item => [
      clean(item.rule), clean(item.description), ...(item.evidence ?? []),
    ]).filter(Boolean))];
    if (source) rules.unshift(source);
    rules.push(...rule);
    return {
      fieldId: String(id),
      groupName: clean(groupName ?? canonical.groupName ?? '未分组字段'),
      fieldName: clean(canonical.name ?? id),
      fieldType: clean(canonical.type ?? canonical.fieldType ?? canonical.usages?.[0]?.kind ?? '待核对'),
      required: requiredParts.length ? [...new Set(requiredParts)].join('；') : '按阶段配置',
      stages,
      source: source || '待核实',
      rules: rules.length ? [...new Set(rules)].join('；') : '按阶段配置',
      evidence: [...new Set(items.flatMap(item => item.evidence ?? []).filter(Boolean))],
      editableStages: [...new Set(items.filter(item => item.editable === true || item.readOnly === false)
        .map(item => item.view ?? item.stage).filter(Boolean))],
      visibleStages: stages,
    };
  });
}

export function atomicRowsForWord(records) {
  return records.map(field => [
    field.groupName,
    field.fieldName,
    field.fieldType,
    field.required,
    field.stages.join('、') || '待核实',
    field.rules,
  ]);
}

export function nodeFieldsForWord(records) {
  return records.map(field => [
    field.groupName,
    field.fieldName,
    field.fieldType,
    field.required,
    field.stages.join('、') || field.groupName,
    field.rules,
  ]);
}
