import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {screenshotValue} from './screenshot-quality.mjs';

const chromeOnly = '#header_holder,#float_tool,#help_content,.floatTool';
const maskSelector = 'input:not([type=radio]):not([type=checkbox]):not([type=button]):not([type=submit]),textarea,select,.infoplus_labelControl,.infoplus_fileControl_link,.form_remark_title';

// Copy exact pixels from the high resolution source; crop geometry is recorded in its coordinate space.
export async function cropEvidence(page, source, target, box) {
  const bytes=await fs.readFile(source);
  const data=await page.evaluate(async ({data,box})=>{
    const img=new Image();img.src='data:image/png;base64,'+data;await img.decode();
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=box.width;canvas.height=box.height;
    if(box.x<0||box.y<0||box.x+box.width>img.naturalWidth||box.y+box.height>img.naturalHeight)throw Error('Crop exceeds source');
    canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,box.x,box.y,box.width,box.height,0,0,box.width,box.height);
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/png').split(',')[1];
  },{data:bytes.toString('base64'),box});
  await fs.writeFile(target,Buffer.from(data,'base64'));
}

export async function captureFullForm(page, meta, {root}) {
  const folder=path.join(root,`${String(meta.index).padStart(2,'0')}-${meta.nodeId}`);
  await fs.mkdir(path.join(folder,'original'),{recursive:true});
  const originalViewport=page.viewportSize();const scroll=await page.evaluate(()=>({x:scrollX,y:scrollY}));
  const restores=[];
  try {
    await page.setViewportSize({width:1920,height:1080});
    await page.waitForTimeout(400);
    const candidates=[];
    for(const frame of page.frames()) {
      const locator=frame.locator('#form_holder').first();
      if(await locator.count() && await locator.isVisible()) candidates.push({frame,locator});
    }
    if(candidates.length!==1) throw Error('未找到唯一完整表单，不能以当前视口代替');
    const {frame,locator}=candidates[0];
    const layout=await frame.evaluate(()=>{
      const root=document.querySelector('#form_holder');
      const expanded=[];
      for(const e of [root,...root.querySelectorAll('*')]) {
        const c=getComputedStyle(e);
        if(e.getClientRects().length && /(auto|scroll)/.test(c.overflow+c.overflowX+c.overflowY) && (e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+2||e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+2)) {
          expanded.push({e,style:e.getAttribute('style'),scrollTop:e.scrollTop,scrollLeft:e.scrollLeft});
          e.style.setProperty('max-height','none','important');e.style.setProperty('max-width','none','important');
          e.style.setProperty('height',e.scrollHeight+'px','important');e.style.setProperty('width',e.scrollWidth+'px','important');e.style.setProperty('overflow','visible','important');
        }
      }
      window.__prdCaptureRestore=expanded;
      return {expanded:expanded.length,width:root.scrollWidth,height:root.scrollHeight};
    });
    restores.push(async()=>frame.evaluate(()=>{for(const s of window.__prdCaptureRestore||[]){s.style===null?s.e.removeAttribute('style'):s.e.setAttribute('style',s.style);s.e.scrollTop=s.scrollTop;s.e.scrollLeft=s.scrollLeft;}delete window.__prdCaptureRestore;}));
    if(frame!==page.mainFrame()) {
      const iframe=await frame.frameElement();const style=await iframe.getAttribute('style');
      await iframe.evaluate((e,size)=>{e.style.width=size.width+'px';e.style.height=size.height+'px';},layout);
      restores.push(async()=>iframe.evaluate((e,s)=>s===null?e.removeAttribute('style'):e.setAttribute('style',s),style));
    }
    if(layout.width>4000||layout.height>24000)throw Error('表单超出一次可靠采集尺寸；保留缺图，需专门分块拼接核验');
    await page.setViewportSize({width:Math.max(1920,Math.ceil(layout.width+100)),height:1080});
    const metrics=await locator.evaluate(root=>{
      const b=root.getBoundingClientRect();const visible=e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0;
      const rows=[...root.querySelectorAll('tr')].filter(visible).map(e=>{
        const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {text:e.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),y:r.top-b.top,height:r.height,cells:e.cells.length};
      }).filter(r=>r.height<350);
      const modules=rows.filter(r=>/基本信息|团组成员|出访报告|审批意见|审核意见|出访单位|行政负责人|党委负责人|国合处|回访|公示|保险|证照信息|实际出境|本人签名/.test(r.text) && r.text.length<250);
      return {width:Math.ceil(b.width),height:Math.ceil(b.height),scrollWidth:root.scrollWidth,scrollHeight:root.scrollHeight,
        businessContent:root.querySelectorAll('td').length>4,rows,modules,errorText:/Required request parameter/.test(root.innerText)?'Required request parameter':''};
    });
    const options={animations:'disabled',caret:'hide',timeout:30000,style:`${chromeOnly}{visibility:hidden!important}`};
    const original=path.join(folder,'original/full-page.png'),full=path.join(folder,'full-page.png');
    await locator.screenshot({...options,path:original});
    await locator.screenshot({...options,path:full,mask:[frame.locator(maskSelector)],maskColor:'#E2E7EC'});
    const data=await fs.readFile(full);const width=data.readUInt32BE(16),height=data.readUInt32BE(20);
    const scale=width/metrics.width;
    const complete=metrics.scrollWidth<=metrics.width+3 && metrics.scrollHeight<=metrics.height+3 && Math.abs(height-metrics.height*scale)<4;
    const checks={...metrics,rows:undefined,modules:undefined,nodeId:meta.nodeId,complete,obscured:false,expandedContainers:layout.expanded};
    const images=[];
    const add=async item=>{const b=await fs.readFile(item.file);const image={...item,nodeId:meta.nodeId,width:b.readUInt32BE(16),height:b.readUInt32BE(20),bytes:b.length,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex')};image.quality=screenshotValue(image,checks);images.push(image);};
    await add({file:original,category:'full-page',sourceVariant:'original'});
    await add({file:full,category:'full-page',sourceVariant:'masked',title:'完整表单布局',capture:'measured-business-element'});
    // Use actual table rows to align each business module, never arbitrary viewport scroll positions.
    const boundaries=[{y:0,text:'申请信息与基本资料'},...metrics.modules.filter(r=>r.y>60).map(r=>({y:Math.floor(r.y),text:r.text}))];
    const unique=boundaries.filter((r,i)=>i===0||r.y-boundaries[i-1].y>40);
    let number=0;
    for(let i=0;i<unique.length;i++) {
      const start=unique[i].y,end=i+1<unique.length?unique[i+1].y:metrics.height;
      if(end-start<45)continue;
      const label=unique[i].text.split(/[A-Za-z]/)[0].replace(/[\d*：:]/g,'').trim().slice(0,32)||'表单业务信息';
      const box={x:0,y:Math.round(start*scale),width,height:Math.min(height-Math.round(start*scale),Math.round((end-start)*scale))};
      const file=path.join(folder,`module-${String(++number).padStart(2,'0')}.png`);
      await cropEvidence(page,full,file,box);
      await add({file,category:'business-module',sourceVariant:'masked',parentImage:full,crop:box,title:label,purpose:label});
    }
    return {...meta,folder,images,pageChecks:checks,metrics:checks,source:meta.pageType==='historical-snapshot'?'同一 Debug 实例历史只读表单':'当前 Debug 表单只读采集',buttonsDetected:[],buttonDetectionNote:'完整表单图不含平台工具栏；实际办理按钮另按已有同实例证据核对'};
  } finally {
    for(const restore of restores.reverse()) await restore().catch(()=>{});
    await page.setViewportSize(originalViewport).catch(()=>{});
    await page.evaluate(p=>scrollTo(p.x,p.y),scroll).catch(()=>{});
  }
}

=== END src/full-form-capture.mjs
=== src/generate-custom.mjs
import { writeWordAtomic } from './output-management.mjs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, resolve, sep } from 'node:path';
import {
  AlignmentType, BorderStyle, Document, Footer, Header, HeadingLevel, ImageRun,
  Packer, PageNumber, PageOrientation, Paragraph, SectionType, Table, TableCell,
  TableLayoutType, TableRow, TextRun, VerticalAlign, WidthType,
} from 'docx';
import { buildBusinessContent } from './business-content.mjs';
import { originalWorkflowImage, originalPngName, originalSvgName } from './workflow-original.mjs';
import { stageProfile } from './stage-pages.mjs';
import { buildNodeEvidenceSections } from './node-evidence-content.mjs';
import { dedupeSectionImages, dedupeSectionRules, imageCropSegments } from './image-layout.mjs';
import { workflowOrder } from './workflow-order.mjs';
import { businessTextFormatter, businessAssociation } from './business-presentation.mjs';
import { atomicFieldRows, atomicRowsForWord } from './field-atomic.mjs';

const configUrl = name => new URL(`../config/${name}`, import.meta.url);
const readJson = async (path, optional = false) => {
  try { return JSON.parse((await readFile(path, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')); }
  catch (error) { if (!optional || error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
};
const cn = ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十'];
const mdEscape = value => String(value).replaceAll('|', '\\|').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
const mdTable = (headers, rows) => [headers, headers.map(() => '---'), ...rows]
  .map(row => `| ${row.map(mdEscape).join(' | ')} |`).join('\n');
const nodeFieldsForWord = fields => atomicRowsForWord(atomicFieldRows(fields, { groupName: '' }));

const windowsChars = { '<':'＜', '>':'＞', ':':'：', '"':'＂', '/':'／', '\\':'＼', '|':'｜', '?':'？', '*':'＊' };
const filenamePart = value => value.replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]/g, char => windowsChars[char])
  .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/[. ]+$/g, '');

export function customDocxName(project) {
  const code = String(project.code || project.projectCode || '流程').trim();
  const title = String(project.name || code).trim();
  const separator = title.search(/[:：]/);
  const name = separator >= 0 && title.slice(0, separator).trim().toLowerCase() === code.toLowerCase()
    ? title.slice(separator + 1).trim() : title;
  const stem = `${filenamePart(code) || '流程'}：${filenamePart(name) || '未命名流程'}`;
  const safeStem = /^(?:CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|COM[1-9¹²³]|LPT[1-9¹²³])\./i.test(stem) ? '_' + stem : stem;
  // Limit UTF-16 units without cutting a surrogate pair; reserve room for the suffix.
  let shortened = '';
  for (const char of safeStem) {
    if (shortened.length + char.length > 160) break;
    shortened += char;
  }
  return `${shortened.trimEnd()}需求文档.docx`;
}

async function png(path) {
  let data;
  try { data = await readFile(path); } catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return; throw error; }
  return pngImage(data);
}

function pngImage(data) {
  if (!data || data.length < 24 || data.toString('hex', 0, 8) !== '89504e470d0a1a0a') return;
  const width = data.readUInt32BE(16);
  const height = data.readUInt32BE(20);
  if (width && height) return { data, width, height };
}

async function figures(bundle, content, profile, directory, policy, inlineNodeIds = new Set()) {
  const seen = new Map();
  const unavailable = [];
  const nodes = bundle.workflow.nodes;
  const stages = new Map(bundle.stagePages?.map(stage => [stage.viewId, stage]));
  for (const view of content.views) {
    const stage = stages.get(view.id);
    const panels = view.packageViews?.filter(item => item.screenshot) ?? [];
    const preferred = panels.find(item => /默认/.test(item.name)) ??
      panels.find(item => !/手机|mobile|\[360\]/i.test(item.name)) ?? panels[0];
    const debugStages = [...new Map((bundle.debug?.runtime?.stages ?? []).filter(s =>
      s.state.viewId === view.id && s.screenshot && !inlineNodeIds.has(Number(s.state.nodeId)))
      .map(s => [s.state.nodeId, s])).values()];
    const selected = debugStages.length ? debugStages.map(s => {
      const history=bundle.debugHistory?.stages.find(h=>h.state.flowStepId===s.state.flowStepId && h.screenshot);
      return { screenshot: history?.screenshot || s.screenshot, name: s.state.name.trim(), debug: true, history:Boolean(history) };
    }) : stage?.screenshot
      ? [{ screenshot: stage.screenshot, name: '前台完整截图', live: true }, ...(preferred ? [preferred] : [])]
      : policy === 'all' ? panels : preferred ? [preferred] : [];
    let found = false;
    for (const item of selected) {
      const source = resolve(directory, item.screenshot);
      if (!source.startsWith(resolve(directory, 'views') + sep)) continue;
      const image = await png(source);
      if (!image) continue;
      found = true;
      const digest = createHash('sha256').update(image.data).digest('hex');
      let figure = seen.get(digest);
      if (!figure) {
        figure = { ...image, path: item.screenshot, labels: [], uses: new Set() };
        seen.set(digest, figure);
      }
      const label = item.debug ? item.name : stage?.binding === '入口' ? '办事说明页' : view.name;
      figure.labels.push(selected.length > 1 && !stage?.screenshot ? `${label} · ${item.name}` : label);
      const used = [...new Set(nodes.filter(node => [node.view, node.printView].includes(view.id)).map(node => node.name))];
      const note = item.debug ? `「${item.name}」${item.history ? '历史只读页面' : '实际办理页面'}。图为后台 Debug 完整截图，身份和字段值已遮盖；仅证明该节点页面已读取，审批动作是否完成见运行验收记录。` : stage?.binding === '入口'
        ? `申请人在此阅读办理说明后开始申请。${stage.nextStages?.length ? `下一阶段为${stage.nextStages.join('、')}。` : ''}${item.live ? '图为前台完整截图。' : '图为 XSN 静态预览。'}`
        : profile?.formNotes?.[view.id] ??
        (bundle.workflow.startView === view.id ? '办事入口的说明页面。' :
          used.length ? `供${used.join('、')}环节使用。` : '原表单模板，运行时调用环节需核对。');
      figure.uses.add(stage?.binding === '模板' ? `模板参考。 ${note}` : stage?.category && stage.binding !== '入口' ? `${stage.category}。 ${note}` : note);
      if (stage?.screenshot && !item.debug) break;
    }
    if (!found) unavailable.push(view.name);
  }
  return { panels: [...seen.values()], unavailable };
}

function section(children, page, headers, footers) {
  const { width, height, ...margin } = page;
  const landscape = width > height;
  return {
    children, headers, footers,
    properties: {
      type: SectionType.NEXT_PAGE,
      page: { size: { width: Math.min(width, height), height: Math.max(width, height),
        orientation: landscape ? PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE : PageOrientation.PORTRAIT }, margin },
    },
  };
}

function imageParagraph(image, page, reserve, caption) {
  const availableWidth = (page.width - page.left - page.right) / 15 - 4;
  const availableHeight = (page.height - page.top - page.bottom) / 15 - reserve;
  const scale = Math.min(availableWidth / image.width, availableHeight / image.height, 1);
  return new Paragraph({
    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
    children: [new ImageRun({
      data: image.data, type: 'png',
      transformation: { width: Math.floor(image.width * scale), height: Math.floor(image.height * scale) },
      altText: { title: caption, description: caption, name: caption },
    })],
  });
}

function imageParagraphSegments(image, page, reserve, caption) {
  const segments = imageCropSegments(image, page, reserve);
  return segments.flatMap((segment, index) => {
    const children = [];
    if (index > 0) {
      children.push(new Paragraph({
        style: 'BusinessCaption',
        text: `${caption}（续 ${index + 1}/${segments.length}）`,
        keepNext: true,
        pageBreakBefore: true,
      }));
    }
    children.push(new Paragraph({
      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
      children: [new ImageRun({
        data: image.data,
        type: 'png',
        transformation: { width: segment.width, height: segment.height },
        crop: segment.crop,
        altText: {
          title: `${caption}${segments.length > 1 ? `（${index + 1}/${segments.length}）` : ''}`,
          description: caption,
          name: caption,
        },
      })],
    }));
    return children;
  });
}

function templateTable(headers, rows, widths, word) {
  const tableWidth = word.page.width - word.page.left - word.page.right;
  const columnWidths = widths.map(percent => Math.round(tableWidth * percent / 100));
  const rowFont = headers.length === 6 ? Math.min(word.tablePt, 8.5) : word.tablePt;
  const border = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 5, color: word.border };
  return new Table({
    width: { size: tableWidth, type: WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths, layout: TableLayoutType.FIXED,
    borders: { top: border, bottom: border, left: border, right: border, insideHorizontal: border, insideVertical: border },
    margins: { top: 70, bottom: 70, left: headers.length === 6 ? 60 : 105, right: headers.length === 6 ? 60 : 105 },
    rows: [headers, ...rows].map((row, i) => new TableRow({
      tableHeader: i === 0, cantSplit: true,
      children: row.map((value, j) => new TableCell({
        width: { size: columnWidths[j], type: WidthType.DXA }, verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
        ...(i === 0 ? { shading: { fill: word.headerFill } } : {}),
        children: [new Paragraph({
          style: 'BusinessCell',
          alignment: headers.length === 3 && j === 1 ? AlignmentType.CENTER : AlignmentType.LEFT,
          children: [new TextRun({ text: value, bold: i === 0, size: i === 0 ? undefined : Math.round(rowFont * 2) })],
        })],
      })),
    })),
  });
}

function styles(word) {
  const font = { ascii: word.font, eastAsia: word.font, hAnsi: word.font };
  const run = (size, color = '182A3A', bold = false) => ({ font, size: Math.round(size * 2), color, bold });
  return {
    default: {
      document: { run: run(word.bodyPt), paragraph: { spacing: { after: 110, line: 300 } } },
      title: { run: run(word.titlePt, '101820', true), paragraph: { spacing: { after: 160 }, keepNext: true } },
      heading1: { run: run(word.headingPt, word.accent, true), paragraph: { spacing: { before: 235, after: 100 }, keepNext: true } },
      heading2: { run: run(word.subheadingPt, word.accent, true), paragraph: { spacing: { before: 160, after: 85 }, keepNext: true } },
    },
    paragraphStyles: [
      { id: 'BusinessMeta', name: 'Business Metadata', run: run(9, word.muted), paragraph: { spacing: { after: 100 } } },
      { id: 'BusinessCell', name: 'Business Table Text', run: run(word.tablePt), paragraph: { spacing: { before: 0, after: 0, line: 265 } } },
      { id: 'BusinessCaption', name: 'Business Figure Caption', run: run(word.subheadingPt, word.accent, true), paragraph: { spacing: { before: 100, after: 70 }, keepNext: true } },
    ],
  };
}

export async function generateCustom(bundle, directory, templatePath = process.env.INFOPLUS_CUSTOM_TEMPLATE) {
  const template = await readJson(templatePath ? resolve(templatePath) : configUrl('requirements-custom.json'));
  const { word, appendix } = template;
  const code = bundle.project.code;
  const profile = await stageProfile(bundle.project);
  const content = buildBusinessContent(bundle, profile);
  const businessText = businessTextFormatter(bundle);
  const title = `${content.title} ${template.title}`;
  const meta = [code, bundle.project.version && `流程版本 ${bundle.project.version}`].filter(Boolean).join('  /  ');
  const diagram = pngImage(await originalWorkflowImage(bundle, directory));
  const screenshotRoot = process.env.INFOPLUS_SCREENSHOT_DIR
    ? resolve(process.env.INFOPLUS_SCREENSHOT_DIR) : join(directory, 'debug-evidence');
  const nodeSections = buildNodeEvidenceSections(bundle, directory, screenshotRoot);
  for (const sectionData of nodeSections) {
    for (const screenshot of sectionData.screenshots) screenshot.image = await png(resolve(directory, screenshot.file));
    sectionData.screenshots = sectionData.screenshots.filter(s => s.image);
  }
  dedupeSectionImages(nodeSections, data => createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex'));
  dedupeSectionRules(nodeSections);
  const inlineNodeIds = new Set(nodeSections.map(s => s.nodeId));
  const { panels, unavailable } = await figures(bundle, content, profile, directory, word.formPanelPolicy, inlineNodeIds);
  const header = new Header({ children: [new Paragraph({
    style: 'BusinessMeta', alignment: AlignmentType.RIGHT, text: `${template.header}  /  ${content.title}`,
  })] });
  const footer = new Footer({ children: [new Paragraph({
    style: 'BusinessMeta', alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
    children: [new TextRun(`${template.footer}  |  ${code}  |  第 `),
      new TextRun({ children: [PageNumber.CURRENT] }), new TextRun(' 页')],
  })] });
  const headers = { default: header };
  const footers = { default: footer };
  const markdown = [`# ${title}`, meta, template.purpose];
  const body = [new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.TITLE, children: [
    new TextRun(content.title), new TextRun({ text: template.title, break: 1 }),
  ] }),
    new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessMeta', text: meta }), new Paragraph(template.purpose)];
  let children = body;
  let figureNo = 1;
  function heading(text, level = 1) {
    markdown.push(`${'#'.repeat(level + 1)} ${text}`);
    children.push(new Paragraph({ heading: level === 1 ? HeadingLevel.HEADING_1 : HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, text }));
  }
  function paragraphs(values, list = false) {
    for (const raw of values) {
      const value = businessText(raw);
      markdown.push(list ? `- ${value}` : value);
      children.push(list ? new Paragraph({ bullet: { level: 0 }, text: value }) : new Paragraph(value));
    }
  }
  function table(head, rows, columns) {
    if (!rows.length) return;
    rows = rows.map(row => row.map(businessText));
    markdown.push(mdTable(head, rows));
    children.push(templateTable(head, rows, columns, word));
  }
  function screenshotNote(screenshot) {
    const source = ['A', 'B', 'C'].includes(screenshot.source) ? `证据等级 ${screenshot.source}` : '证据等级待核对';
    return `${screenshot.note} ${source}；来源：${screenshot.sourceType || '真实 Debug 页面'}。`;
  }
  const renderSection = {
    scope: () => {
      paragraphs(content.scope.filter(s => !/用户手动推进|当前实际办理节点/.test(s)));
      paragraphs([`本资料收录 ${nodeSections.length} 个已采集页面节点；页面、历史快照与实际动作分别标记，未执行路径仅作配置确认。`]);
      paragraphs(content.requirements.filter(s=> !/已经办理过此任务/.test(s)), true);
    },
    association: () => {
      const association = businessAssociation(bundle);
      if (!association) { paragraphs(['现有证据未确认独立前置流程依赖；关联数据要求以字段及规则表为准。']); return; }
      paragraphs(association.paragraphs);
      const associationRows = association.fields.flatMap(field =>
        field.labels.map(label => ['前置业务关联', label, '按已核验来源', `${field.source}；${field.rules}`]));
      table(['分组', '字段名称', '字段类型', '必填', '出现阶段', '数据来源/规则'], associationRows, word.fieldsColumns);
      paragraphs(association.limits);
    },
    flow: () => {
      paragraphs(content.flow);
      if (diagram) {
        paragraphs(['以下为后台原始完整流程图；可缩放原图及大幅参考图见附录 A。']);
        children.push(imageParagraph(diagram, word.page, 140, '完整业务流程'));
        markdown.push(`![完整业务流程](${originalPngName})`);
      }
    },
    roles: () => {
      const names = new Map(bundle.workflow.nodes.map(n => [String(n.id),n.name]));
      for (const gateway of bundle.workflow.nodes.filter(n => n.type === '分流')) {
        const targets = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(e => String(e.source) === String(gateway.id))
          .map(e => names.get(String(e.target))).filter(Boolean);
        if (targets.length > 1) paragraphs([`并行办理（Workflow 配置）：${targets.join('、')}属于同一分流后的并行环节，以下排列不表示依次审批。`]);
      }
      table(['节点', '办理角色', '进入与后续办理', '验证状态'],
        workflowOrder(bundle.workflow).filter(n => n.type === '办理').map(n => {
          const evidence = nodeSections.find(s => String(s.nodeId) === String(n.id));
          const incoming = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(e => String(e.target) === String(n.id));
          const outgoing = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(e => String(e.source) === String(n.id));
          return [n.name, evidence?.role || bundle.nodeEvidence?.find(e => String(e.id) === String(n.id))?.role || '待确认',
            `进入：${incoming.map(e => `${names.get(String(e.source))}（${e.name}）`).join('；') || '流程入口'}。后续：${outgoing.map(e => `${e.name} → ${names.get(String(e.target))}`).join('；')}`,
            evidence?.verified ? '有实际流转证据' : evidence ? '页面已采集，动作未验证' : 'Workflow 配置确认'];
        }), [18,18,47,17]);
    },
    nodeEvidence: () => {
      if (!nodeSections.length) {
        paragraphs(['尚未采集到可插入正文的真实 Debug 节点截图；相关节点仅保留配置分析与证据缺口说明。']);
        return;
      }
      paragraphs(['本节按实际办理顺序说明关键节点。每个节点均把业务说明、字段要求、真实页面截图和按钮流转放在一起，便于新平台开发时直接对照实现；历史只读快照不表示新的提交动作。']);
      for (const item of nodeSections) {
        markdown.push(`### 节点：${item.name}`);
        children.push(new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, text: `节点：${item.name}` }));
        children.push(new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessMeta', text: `办理角色/身份：${item.role} ｜ 页面来源：${item.sourceNote} ｜ 流转证据：${item.verified ? '实际提交并核对流转' : '页面实测，动作按配置或待确认'}` }));
        children.push(new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessCaption', text: '业务说明' }));
        paragraphs([item.description]);
        children.push(new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessCaption', text: '主要字段' }));
        table(['分组', '字段名称', '字段类型', '必填', '出现阶段', '数据来源/规则'], nodeFieldsForWord(item.fields), word.fieldsColumns);
        if (!item.fields.length) paragraphs(['未取得可单独确认的新增或可编辑字段证据；通用只读资料见字段清单，不能根据历史快照推断当前编辑权限。']);
        for (const screenshot of item.screenshots) {
          const caption = `图 N-${String(figureNo++).padStart(2, '0')}  ${item.name} · ${screenshot.title}`;
          children.push(new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessCaption', text: caption, keepNext: true }));
          children.push(new Paragraph({ text: screenshotNote(screenshot), keepNext: true }));
          children.push(...imageParagraphSegments(screenshot.image, word.formPage, 150, caption));
          markdown.push(`### ${caption}`, screenshotNote(screenshot), `![${caption}](${screenshot.file})`);
        }
        children.push(new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessCaption', text: '操作按钮及流转' }));
        table(['按钮', '执行条件', '目标节点', '验证状态'], item.buttons, [25, 24, 34, 17]);
        if (item.rules.length) {
          children.push(new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessCaption', text: '特殊规则与条件证据' }));
          paragraphs(item.rules, true);
        }
      }
    },
    approvals: () => {
      table(['类别／条件', '后续处理'], content.approvals, word.approvalsColumns);
      paragraphs(content.approvers);
      paragraphs(content.returnNotes);
    },
    requirements: () => {
      if (bundle.crossFlow) {
        const { summary, fields, limits } = bundle.crossFlow;
        heading('前置业务关联与带出字段', 2);
        paragraphs(summary);
        table(['字段', '绑定', '来源及核验', '填写与权限'], fields, [20, 23, 28, 29]);
        // Later Debug records supersede earlier blocked-attempt conclusions.
        paragraphs(limits.filter(limit => !/本地校验阻断|护照状态查询失败/.test(limit)));
      }
      paragraphs(content.requirements, true);
    },
    fields: () => {
      paragraphs(['每个真实业务字段独立列示，分组仅用于分类；同一字段跨阶段出现时汇总阶段状态。空白模板值不代表运行时默认值。人员字段未注明范围时，仍须核对，不能理解为任意人员可选。']);
      for (const [i, group] of content.fields.entries()) {
        heading(`${i + 1}  ${group.title}`, 2);
        table(['分组', '字段名称', '字段类型', '必填', '出现阶段', '数据来源/规则'], atomicRowsForWord(group.fields), word.fieldsColumns);
      }
      const special = bundle.stageFieldAnalysis?.special ?? [];
      if (special.length) {
        heading(template.specialFields?.title ?? '特殊字段的阶段与来源规则', 2);
        paragraphs(['以下为实测状态或人员过滤配置，普通字段见前表。节点间差异的触发原因、条件必填边界、人员目录及组织关系仍须单独验证。阶段图见附录 B，已补采的字段局部图见附录 C。']);
        const candidates = special.filter(s => s.name !== s.fieldId || profile?.fields?.[s.fieldId]?.name)
          .filter(s => s.source.startsWith('人员选择') || /审核|审批|意见|负责人|公示|行前/.test(profile?.fields?.[s.fieldId]?.name || s.name))
          .map(s => [profile?.fields?.[s.fieldId]?.name || s.name, s.stage,
            s.source.replace(' 组织目录来源及上下级关系未单独验证。',''),
            s.rule.replace('，条件必填边界待核对','').replace('跨节点状态存在差异，具体触发原因不能仅凭阶段变化推断。','')]);
        const rows = candidates;
        table(['分组', '字段名称', '字段类型', '必填', '出现阶段', '数据来源/规则'], atomicRowsForWord(atomicFieldRows(candidates, { groupName: '特殊字段' })),
          word.specialFieldsColumns ?? [20,18,30,32]);
      }
    },
    questions: () => {
      const questions = content.questions.filter(q => !/^仍未完成自动运行验收/.test(q));
      const decisions = questions.filter(q=>/^确认「/.test(q));
      paragraphs(questions.filter(q=>!/^确认「/.test(q)), true);
      if (decisions.length) paragraphs([`尚待核对的判断边界：${decisions.map(q=>q.match(/「(.*?)」/)?.[1]).filter(Boolean).join('、')}；配置路径见第七章。`], true);
      const unvisited = bundle.workflow.nodes.filter(n=>n.type==='办理' && !nodeSections.some(s=>String(s.nodeId)===String(n.id)));
      if (unvisited.length) paragraphs([`尚无真实页面取证的办理节点：${unvisited.map(n=>n.name).join('、')}。这些节点仅按 Workflow/XSN 配置描述，不计为 Debug 已验证。`],true);
    },
  };
  const include = {
    approvals: content.approvals.length || content.returnNotes.length,
    requirements: content.requirements.length || bundle.crossFlow,
    questions: content.questions.length,
  };
  let ordinal = 0;
  const sections = [];
  let currentPage = word.page;
  for (const item of template.sections) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(renderSection, item.key)) throw new Error(`未知业务文档章节 ${item.key}`);
    const page = item.key === 'nodeEvidence' ? word.formPage : word.page;
    if (page !== currentPage) {
      sections.push(section(children, currentPage, headers, footers));
      children = [];
      currentPage = page;
    }
    heading(`${cn[ordinal] ?? ordinal + 1}、${item.title}`);
    ordinal++;
    renderSection[item.key]();
  }
  sections.push(section(children, currentPage, headers, footers));
  children = [];
  heading('九、附录');
  heading(appendix.flow);
  paragraphs([diagram ? '下图取自 InfoPlus IDE Workflow 编辑器的完整原始画布。' :
    '本版本尚未取得可核对的 InfoPlus IDE Workflow 原始画布。取得完整原图后，可单独重生成业务版。']);
  if (diagram) {
    paragraphs([appendix.flowNote]);
    markdown.push(`![InfoPlus IDE 原始流程图](${originalPngName})`, `[查看可缩放原图](${originalSvgName})`);
    children.push(imageParagraph(diagram, word.diagramPage, 100, appendix.flow));
    if (diagram.width / diagram.height > 2) {
      paragraphs(['以下按原图从左到右放大，边界保留重叠区域；节点位置及连线均来自同一原始画布。']);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const left = Math.max(0, i / 3 - .025);
        const right = Math.min(1, (i + 1) / 3 + .025);
        const w = (word.diagramPage.width - word.diagramPage.left - word.diagramPage.right) / 15 - 4;
        const h = (word.diagramPage.height - word.diagramPage.top - word.diagramPage.bottom) / 15 - 120;
        const scale = Math.min(w / (diagram.width * (right-left)), h / diagram.height);
        children.push(new Paragraph({style:'BusinessCaption', text:`流程图局部 ${i+1}/3（按原图从左到右）`,pageBreakBefore:true}),
          new Paragraph({children:[new ImageRun({data:diagram.data,type:'png',
            crop:{left:left*100, right:(1-right)*100, top:0, bottom:0},
            transformation:{width:Math.round(diagram.width*(right-left)*scale),height:Math.round(diagram.height*scale)}})]}));
      }
    }
  }
  sections.push(section(children, word.diagramPage, headers, footers));
  children = [];
  heading(appendix.forms);
  paragraphs([appendix.formNote]);
  if (unavailable.length) paragraphs([`以下阶段尚无可用静态图：${unavailable.join('、')}。`]);
  for (const [index, panel] of panels.entries()) {
    const caption = `图 B-${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}  ${panel.labels.join('、')}`;
    const use = [...panel.uses].join(' ');
    markdown.push(`### ${caption}`, use, `![${caption}](${panel.path})`);
    children.push(
      new Paragraph({ style: 'BusinessCaption', text: caption, pageBreakBefore: index > 0 }),
      new Paragraph({ text: use, keepNext: true }),
      ...imageParagraphSegments(panel, word.formPage, index === 0 ? 165 : 130, caption),
    );
  }
  sections.push(section(children, word.formPage, headers, footers));
  const historyImages = [...bundle.debugHistory?.stages ?? []].reverse().flatMap(stage => stage.images.map(item => ({...item,stage})));
  const keyFields = new Set((bundle.stageFieldAnalysis?.special ?? []).filter(item => /审核|审批|意见|负责人|公示|行前|系所/.test(profile?.fields?.[item.fieldId]?.name || item.name)).map(item => item.fieldId));
  const seenFields = new Set();
  const selectedImages = historyImages.filter(item => {
    if (!keyFields.has(item.fieldId) || seenFields.has(item.fieldId)) return false;
    seenFields.add(item.fieldId); return true;
  });
  if (selectedImages.length) {
    children = []; heading(appendix.details ?? '附录 C  特殊字段局部参考');
    paragraphs(['以下为同一 Debug 实例已完成步骤的历史页面局部图，字段值已遮盖。只证明页面展示，不证明条件切换、成员候选范围变化或新的审批操作。']);
    const imageHashes = new Set();
    for (const item of selectedImages) {
      const path=resolve(directory,item.file);
      if (!path.startsWith(resolve(directory,'debug-evidence')+sep)) continue;
      const picture=await png(path); if(!picture) continue;
      const digest=createHash('sha256').update(picture.data).digest('hex');
      if(imageHashes.has(digest)) continue;
      imageHashes.add(digest);
      const name=profile?.fields?.[item.fieldId]?.name || bundle.fields.find(f=>f.id===item.fieldId && f.name!==f.id)?.name;
      if(!name) continue;
      const caption=`${name} · ${item.stage.state.name.trim()}（历史页面）`;
      children.push(new Paragraph({style:'BusinessCaption',text:caption}),imageParagraph(picture,word.page,160,caption));
      markdown.push(`### ${caption}`,`![${caption}](${item.file})`);
    }
    sections.push(section(children,word.page,headers,footers));
  }
  const doc = new Document({ title, styles: styles(word), sections });
  const docxPath = join(directory, customDocxName(bundle.project));
  await writeWordAtomic(docxPath, await Packer.toBuffer(doc));
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'requirements_custom.md'), markdown.join('\n\n') + '\n');
  return { docxPath, hasOriginalDiagram: Boolean(diagram) };
}


=== END src/generate-custom.mjs
=== src/generate.mjs
import { writeWordAtomic } from './output-management.mjs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, resolve, sep } from 'node:path';
import { Document, HeadingLevel, ImageRun, Packer, Paragraph, Table, TableCell, TableRow } from 'docx';
import { instance } from '@viz-js/viz';
import { withRenderer } from './render.mjs';
import { memberScopeDescription } from './debug-runtime.mjs';

const str = value => value == null ? '' : typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
const cell = value => str(value).replaceAll('|', '\\|').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
const csv = value => {
  const text = str(value);
  return '"' + (/^[\s]*[=+@-]|^[\t\r\n]/.test(text) ? "'" : '') + text.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"';
};
const mdTable = (header, rows) => [
  header, header.map(() => '---'), ...rows,
].map(row => '| ' + row.map(cell).join(' | ') + ' |').join('\n');
const dotQuote = value => JSON.stringify(str(value));
const mermaidQuote = value => str(value).replace(/[&"<>#|\r\n]/g, char => `#${char.charCodeAt(0)};`);

export function graphSource(workflow) {
  const ids = new Map(workflow.nodes.map((node, index) => [node.id, `n${index}`]));
  if (!ids.size || ids.size !== workflow.nodes.length || ids.has('') ||
      workflow.transitions.some(e => !ids.has(e.source) || !ids.has(e.target))) return null;
  const nodeRows = workflow.nodes.map(n => [ids.get(n.id), `${n.name || n.id} [${n.id}]`, n.type]);
  const edgeRows = workflow.transitions.map(e => [ids.get(e.source), ids.get(e.target),
    e.id ? `${e.name} [${e.id}]` : [e.name, e.condition].filter(Boolean).map(str).join(' / '),
    /退回|否决|重新/.test(e.name)]);
  return {
    mmd: ['flowchart TD', ...nodeRows.map(([id, name]) => `  ${id}["${mermaidQuote(name)}"]`),
      ...edgeRows.map(([from, to, label]) => label ? `  ${from} -->|"${mermaidQuote(label)}"| ${to}` : `  ${from} --> ${to}`),
    ].join('\n'),
    dot: ['digraph workflow {', 'graph [nodesep=0.55 ranksep=0.65]',
      'node [shape=box fontname="Microsoft YaHei" fontsize=13]', 'edge [fontname="Microsoft YaHei" fontsize=11]',
      ...nodeRows.map(([id, name, type]) => {
        const glyphs = [...name].reduce((width, char) => width + (char.codePointAt(0) > 255 ? 1 : 0.56), 0);
        const diamond = type === '判断';
        const width = ((glyphs * 13 * (diamond ? 1.45 : 1) + 20) / 72).toFixed(2);
        return `${id} [label=${dotQuote(name)}, width=${width}${diamond ? ', shape=diamond' : ''}];`;
      }),
      ...edgeRows.map(([from, to, label, loop]) => `${from} -> ${to} [label=${dotQuote(label)}${loop ? ', color="#a33c37", style=dashed' : ''}];`), '}',
    ].join('\n'),
  };
}

function table(header, rows) {
  return new Table({
    rows: [header, ...rows].map((row, index) => new TableRow({
      tableHeader: index === 0,
      children: row.map(value => new TableCell({ children: [new Paragraph(str(value))] })),
    })),
  });
}

async function cachedWorkflowImage(directory, bundleMtime) {
  if (bundleMtime === undefined) return;
  try {
    const files = ['workflow.mmd', 'workflow.svg', 'workflow.png'].map(name => join(directory, name));
    const stats = await Promise.all(files.map(file => stat(file)));
    if (stats.some(file => !file.isFile() || !file.size || file.mtimeMs < bundleMtime)) return;
    const image = await readFile(files[2]);
    if (image.length >= 24 && image.subarray(0, 8).toString('hex') === '89504e470d0a1a0a' &&
        image.readUInt32BE(16) && image.readUInt32BE(20)) return image;
  } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
}

export async function generate(bundle, report, directory, bundleMtime) {
  const missing = [...new Set([...report.missing, ...(bundle.issues ?? [])])];
  const graph = graphSource(bundle.workflow);
  let graphImage;
  if (graph && bundle.workflow.transitions.length) {
    graphImage = await cachedWorkflowImage(directory, bundleMtime);
    if (!graphImage) {
      const viz = await instance();
      const svg = viz.renderString(graph.dot, { format: 'svg' });
      await writeFile(join(directory, 'workflow.mmd'), graph.mmd);
      await writeFile(join(directory, 'workflow.svg'), svg);
      try {
        await withRenderer(render => render(`<style>body{margin:0}svg{display:block;width:2600px;height:auto}</style>${svg}`, join(directory, 'workflow.png')));
        graphImage = await readFile(join(directory, 'workflow.png'));
      } catch {
        missing.push('流程图 PNG 渲染失败，已有 SVG 与 Mermaid');
      }
    }
  }
  const title = `${bundle.project.name ?? bundle.project.code}｜流程重建需求资料`;
  const overview = `项目 ${bundle.project.code}，IDE 版本 ${bundle.project.version ?? '待确认'}。${bundle.project.published ? '接口标记此定义已发布。' : '发布状态待核实。'}流程包含 ${bundle.workflow.nodes.length} 个节点和 ${bundle.workflow.transitions.length} 条连线。`;
  const names = new Map(bundle.workflow.nodes.map(node => [node.id, `${node.name} [${node.id}]`]));
  const transitions = bundle.workflow.transitions.map(e => [
    names.get(e.source) ?? e.source,
    e.id ? `${e.name} [${e.id}]` : e.name, names.get(e.target) ?? e.target,
    [e.condition, e.script ? '动作脚本见 rules.csv' : ''].filter(Boolean).join('；'), e.evidence,
  ]);
  const viewRows = bundle.views.map(v => [v.name, v.updated || v.created, v.apiFieldCount,
    v.screenshot ? `${v.packageViews.filter(item => item.screenshot).length} 张静态图` : '待采集']);
  const nodeRows = bundle.workflow.nodes.map(node => [
    names.get(node.id), node.type || '待确认', node.actor || (node.type === '办理' ? '待确认' : '—'),
    bundle.views.find(view => view.id === node.view)?.name ?? (node.view || '—'), node.evidence,
  ]);
  const nodeHead = ['节点', '类型', '配置的处理人', '阶段视图', '来源'];
  const fields = bundle.fields.map(f => [
    f.name, f.type, f.required === true ? '是' : f.required === false ? '否' : '待确认',
    f.view, f.id, f.usages?.map(u => `${u.view} / ${u.kind}`).join('；'),
    f.groupName, f.repeatDepth, f.apiType, f.evidence,
    f.readOnly === true ? '是' : f.readOnly === false ? '否' : '待确认',
    f.defaultValue, f.defaultSource, f.optionStatus ?? '', f.optionSets, f.dependencies, f.observedStates, f.fieldConfigSource,
  ]);
  const fieldHead = ['字段名称', '字段类型', '必填', '模板阶段', '字段标识', '控件证据', '分组', '重复层级', '接口类型', '来源',
    '只读', '默认值', '默认值来源', '选项状态', '选项和触发条件', '关联规则', '运行时阶段观测', '字段配置来源'];
  const flowHead = ['起点', '动作', '终点', '路由或脚本', '来源'];
  const viewHead = ['阶段视图', '最后已知时间', '接口字段', '预览'];
  const ruleHead = ['类型', '编号', '名称', '业务说明', '脚本原文', '来源'];
  const ruleRows = (bundle.rules ?? []).map(r => [r.kind, r.id, r.name, r.interpretation, r.expression, r.evidence]);
  const reviewed = ruleRows.filter(r => r[3]).map(r => [r[1], r[2], r[3], r[5]]);
  const rejectActions = bundle.workflow.transitions.filter(edge => /否决/.test(edge.name));
  const reviewedHead = ['编号', '节点或动作', '配置行为', '脚本出处'];
  const flowNote = transitions.length ? '流程图按定义中的节点和连线生成。方括号内为源配置编号，同名节点按编号区分。红色虚线标出名称含退回、否决或重新的动作。'
    : '已记录 IDE 中可见的阶段清单。连线和条件待工作流响应核实。';
  const visibleFlow = !transitions.length && bundle.diagramObservation
    ? [
      `编辑器中可见的节点示例（不表示顺序）　${bundle.diagramObservation.nodeLabels.join('、')}。`,
      `图上可见的操作文字示例　${bundle.diagramObservation.actionLabels.join('、')}。`,
    ]
    : [];
  const formNote = '字段清单以接口字段和 XSD 声明为依据，按阶段记录，并补充控件绑定。运行时必填、显隐和打印效果需验收。';
  const panels = [];
  const hashes = new Map();
  const indexedViews = new Map(bundle.views.map(view => [view.id, view]));
  const orderedViews = bundle.stagePages?.length
    ? bundle.stagePages.map(stage => indexedViews.get(stage.viewId)).filter(Boolean) : bundle.views;
  for (const view of orderedViews) {
    for (const item of view.packageViews) {
      if (!item.screenshot) continue;
      const target = resolve(directory, item.screenshot);
      if (!target.startsWith(resolve(directory, 'views') + sep)) continue;
      const data = await readFile(target);
      const key = createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
      const title = `${view.name} / ${item.name}`;
      const existing = hashes.get(key);
      if (existing) existing.title += `；${title}`;
      else {
        const panel = { title, file: item.screenshot, data };
        panels.push(panel);
        hashes.set(key, panel);
      }
    }
  }
  const sections = [
    ['流程概述', overview],
    ['业务流程', flowNote],
    ['表单需求', formNote],
    ['审批与业务规则', '节点人员、流转条件及退回关系以已采集工作流配置为依据。'],
    ['特殊规则', [
      bundle.workflow.description && `版本说明原文　${bundle.workflow.description}`,
      ...((bundle.workflow.externalEvents ?? []).filter(event => event.enabled).map(event =>
        `定义启用外部事件订阅「${event.name}」，列有 ${new Set(event.steps).size} 个绑定节点。回调内部逻辑待对接验收。`)),
      '原始 XSL 表达式及模板规则随 XSN 保存。节点通知和字段权限配置见标准化资料包。',
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n')],
    ['待确认事项', [
      ...missing.map(item => `- ${item}`),
      bundle.debug && `运行验收：${bundle.debug.runtime?.modeEvidence?.length ? '已核对 IDE Debug 入口、DEBUG 列表、页面调试标记及实际身份。' : ''}${bundle.debug.reason ?? ''}。已验证审批路径 ${bundle.debug.verifiedPaths.length} 条，已模拟身份 ${bundle.debug.simulatedRoles.length} 个。`,
      bundle.debug?.front?.attempted && !bundle.debugRuns && '已执行前台回退。前台字段观测仅对应相关视图，流程流转、退回与重提以配置为依据，需另行验收。',
      ...(bundle.debugRuns?.runs ?? []).flatMap(run => run.events).flatMap(event => event.responses ?? [])
        .filter(response => response.errno && response.error).map(response => `后台实际业务校验：${response.error}`),
      ...(bundle.manualEvidence?.issues ?? []).map(issue => `旧系统问题（用户手动截图）：${issue.description} 地址：${issue.url}。${issue.requirement}`),
      '需在测试环境核对动态人员解析、分流与并行任务退回、外部订阅及通知实际执行。',
      ...rejectActions.map(edge => `动作「${edge.name}」[${edge.id}] 配置目标为「${names.get(edge.target)}」。该动作的运行终止行为需核对。`),
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n')],
  ];
  const markdown = [`# ${title}`];
  const word = [new Paragraph({ text: title, heading: HeadingLevel.TITLE })];
  for (const [index, [heading, paragraph]] of sections.entries()) {
    markdown.push(`## ${heading}`, paragraph);
    word.push(new Paragraph({ text: heading, heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1 }),
      ...paragraph.split('\n').map(text => new Paragraph(text)));
    if (index === 1 && graph && transitions.length) {
      markdown.push('[流程图 SVG](workflow.svg)');
      if (graphImage) word.push(pngParagraph(graphImage));
    }
    if (index === 1 && visibleFlow.length) {
      markdown.push(...visibleFlow, '[图中文字记录](raw/editor-observation.json)');
      word.push(...visibleFlow.map(text => new Paragraph(text)));
    }
    if (index === 2) {
      if(bundle.pathCoverage){
        const coverage=bundle.pathCoverage;
        const head=['验证项','类型','状态'];
        const rows=coverage.obligations.map(p=>[p.name,p.kind,p.status]);
        markdown.push('### 多路径验证覆盖',coverage.counting,mdTable(head,rows));
        word.push(new Paragraph({text:'多路径验证覆盖',heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_2}),new Paragraph(coverage.counting),table(head,rows));
        for(const run of coverage.instances) word.push(new Paragraph(`实例 ${run.instanceId}：${run.status}。当前待办或最后观察节点：${run.pendingNode||run.current?.name||'未知'}。${run.identityBlock||run.businessWaiting||run.businessBlock||''}。${run.unresolved||''}`));
      }
      markdown.push(mdTable(viewHead, viewRows), '[字段清单 CSV](fields.csv)');
      word.push(table(viewHead, viewRows), new Paragraph('完整字段清单见随附 fields.csv。'));
      const visibleFields = fields.filter(row => row[5]).slice(0, 12).map(row => [row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4]]);
      if (visibleFields.length) {
        markdown.push('以下列出已发现控件绑定的部分字段。', mdTable(fieldHead.slice(0, 5), visibleFields));
        word.push(new Paragraph('以下列出已发现控件绑定的部分字段。'), table(fieldHead.slice(0, 5), visibleFields));
      }
    }
    if (index === 3 && transitions.length) {
      const diff = bundle.stageFieldAnalysis;
      if (diff) {
        const head = ['字段','前节点','当前节点','实际差异'];
        const rows = diff.differences.map(d => [d.fieldId,d.from,d.to,d.changes.join('；')]);
        markdown.push('### 实测字段跨节点差异',mdTable(head,rows));
        word.push(new Paragraph({text:'实测字段跨节点差异',heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_2}),
          new Paragraph('未采集到绑定不代表字段不存在；节点变化不能独自证明角色或业务条件导致变化。'),table(head,rows));
        await writeFile(join(directory,'stage-field-analysis.json'),JSON.stringify(diff,null,2));
          const scopes = new Map();
          for (const stage of bundle.debug?.runtime?.stages ?? []) for (const scope of stage.memberScopes ?? []) {
            const row=[scope.fieldId,stage.state.name.trim(),scope.settings?.userFilters || '未取得',memberScopeDescription(scope.settings)];
            scopes.set(JSON.stringify(row),row);
          }
          const scopeHead=['字段绑定','观测节点','原始筛选配置','已确认内容及证据边界'];
          markdown.push('### 成员候选来源与过滤配置',mdTable(scopeHead,[...scopes.values()]));
          word.push(new Paragraph({text:'成员候选来源与过滤配置',heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_2}),
            new Paragraph('来源为运行时成员控件与人员选择服务，组织目录后端未独立核实。一次候选分页不能证明完整名单；历史页面截图不计入新增节点验证。'),table(scopeHead,[...scopes.values()]));
      }
      if (reviewed.length) {
        markdown.push('### 已核对的分流与校验规则', mdTable(reviewedHead, reviewed));
        word.push(new Paragraph({ text: '已核对的分流与校验规则', heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2 }), table(reviewedHead, reviewed));
      }
      markdown.push('[节点与动作脚本原文](rules.csv)');
      word.push(new Paragraph('分流与动作脚本原文见随附 rules.csv，包含源配置路径。'));
      markdown.push(mdTable(nodeHead, nodeRows), mdTable(flowHead, transitions));
      word.push(table(nodeHead, nodeRows), table(flowHead, transitions));
    }
  }
  if (bundle.crossFlow) {
    const { summary, fields, limits } = bundle.crossFlow;
    const head = ['字段', '绑定', '来源及核验', '填写与权限'];
    markdown.push('## 前置业务关联与字段核验', ...summary, mdTable(head, fields), ...limits);
    word.push(new Paragraph({ text: '前置业务关联与字段核验', heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1 }),
      ...summary.map(text => new Paragraph(text)), table(head, fields), ...limits.map(text => new Paragraph(text)));
  }
  if (bundle.stagePages?.length) {
    const stageHead = ['页面', '分类', '绑定', '对应节点'];
    const stageRows = bundle.stagePages.map(stage => [stage.name, stage.category, stage.binding, stage.nodes.join('、')]);
    markdown.push('## 附录　办理阶段页面', mdTable(stageHead, stageRows));
    word.push(new Paragraph({ text: '附录　办理阶段页面', heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1 }), table(stageHead, stageRows));
    for (const stage of bundle.stagePages.filter(stage => stage.category === '办事说明类')) {
      const title = stage.title || stage.name;
      const next = stage.nextStages?.length ? `进入办理后到达「${stage.nextStages.join('、')}」。` : '';
      const actions = (stage.actions ?? []).map(action => [action.label, action.kind, action.purpose, action.address].filter(Boolean).join('　'));
      const details = [next, ...actions, ...stage.text?.split('\n') ?? []].filter(Boolean);
      markdown.push(`### ${title}`, ...details);
      word.push(new Paragraph({ text: title, heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2 }));
      if (stage.screenshot) {
        const target = resolve(directory, stage.screenshot);
        const data = target.startsWith(resolve(directory, 'views') + sep) && await readFile(target).catch(error => {
          if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
        });
        if (data) {
          markdown.push(`![前台完整截图](${stage.screenshot})`);
          word.push(pngParagraph(data));
        }
      }
      word.push(...details.map(text => new Paragraph(text)));
    }
  }
  const materialChecks=(bundle.pathCoverage?.instances??[]).flatMap(run=>
    [...new Map((run.materialChecks??[]).map(check=>[check.state?.flowStepId,check])).values()]);
  if(materialChecks.length){
    const heading='附录　国合处办理与材料收尾实测';
    markdown.push(`## ${heading}`);
    word.push(new Paragraph({text:heading,heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_1}));
    for(const check of materialChecks){
      const result=`申请表链接${check.applicationReady?'已取得':'未取得'}。批件链接${check.approvalReady?'已取得':'未取得'}。${check.message||''}`;
      markdown.push(result);word.push(new Paragraph(result));
      if(check.review){
        const review=check.review;
        const evidence=[review.classification,review.externalDependency,review.candidateScope?.scope].filter(Boolean);
        markdown.push(...evidence);word.push(...evidence.map(line=>new Paragraph(line)));
        const headers=['退回目标','Workflow 配置及后续流转','验证状态'];
        const rows=review.returnActions.map(action=>[action.target,action.config,action.executed?'已实测':'页面入口和配置已核对']);
        markdown.push(mdTable(headers,rows));word.push(table(headers,rows));
      }
      for(const screenshot of check.screenshots??[]){
        const path=resolve(directory,screenshot.file);
        if(!path.startsWith(resolve(directory,'views')+sep))continue;
        const data=await readFile(path).catch(error=>{if(error.code!=='ENOENT')throw error;});
        if(!data)continue;
        markdown.push(`### ${screenshot.label}`,`![实测截图](${screenshot.file})`);
        word.push(new Paragraph({text:screenshot.label,heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_2}),pngParagraph(data));
      }
    }
  }
  if (panels.length) {
    markdown.push('## 附录　XSN 静态预览', '截图由包内 XSL 和默认模板数据生成，运行时显隐、权限、数据和打印效果待复核。');
    word.push(new Paragraph({ text: '附录　XSN 静态预览', heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1 }),
      new Paragraph('截图由包内 XSL 和默认模板数据生成，运行时显隐、权限、数据和打印效果待复核。'));
    for (const panel of panels) {
      markdown.push(`### ${panel.title}`, `![静态预览](${panel.file})`);
      word.push(new Paragraph({ text: panel.title, heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2 }), pngParagraph(panel.data));
    }
  }
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'fields.csv'), '\uFEFF' + [fieldHead, ...fields].map(row => row.map(csv).join(',')).join('\r\n'));
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'rules.csv'), '\uFEFF' + [ruleHead, ...ruleRows].map(row => row.map(csv).join(',')).join('\r\n'));
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'requirements.md'), markdown.join('\n\n') + '\n');
  // V1.3: technical analysis stays internal; only generateCustom publishes Word.
  const docxPath = join(directory, 'requirements.md');
  report.missing = missing;
  report.structuralChecksPassed = missing.length === 0;
  report.status = missing.length ? 'unverified' : 'structurally-verified';
  await writeFile(join(directory, 'analysis-report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  return docxPath;
}

function pngParagraph(data) {
  const width = data.readUInt32BE(16);
  const height = data.readUInt32BE(20);
  const scale = Math.min(1, 570 / width, 680 / height);
  return new Paragraph({ children: [new ImageRun({
    data, type: 'png', transformation: {
      width: Math.max(1, Math.round(width * scale)), height: Math.max(1, Math.round(height * scale)),
    },
  })] });
}


=== END src/generate.mjs
=== src/har.mjs
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { parseFieldIndex, parseViews } from './infoplus.mjs';

const kinds = [
  [/\/findWorkflowDefinition$/i, 'workflow'],
  [/\/findFormTemplate$/i, 'form'],
  [/\/ide\/project\/[^/]+\/fields$/i, 'fields'],
  [/\/views$/i, 'views'],
  [/\/ide\/interface\/template\/[^/]+\/json$/i, 'form'],
  [/\/ide\/interface\/template\/[^/]+\/xsn$/i, 'xsn'],
];
const secretKey = /^(?:cookie|cookies|set-cookie|authorization|authentication|credentials?|secret|client[-_]?secret|password|api[-_]?key|(?:access|refresh|session|csrf|xsrf|auth|id)?[-_]?token|(?:js)?sessionid|samlresponse|headers)$/i;
export const matchKind = path => kinds.find(([pattern]) => pattern.test(path))?.[1];

export function redact(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(redact);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, child]) =>
    [key, secretKey.test(key) ? '[已清除]' : redact(child)]));
}

export async function importHar(input, destination, project) {
  const parsed = JSON.parse((await readFile(input, 'utf8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed.log?.entries)) throw new Error('HAR 缺少 log.entries');
  return importHarEntries(parsed.log.entries, destination, project);
}

export async function importHarEntries(entries, destination, project) {
  const expectedOrigin = new URL(project.source).origin;
  const indexPath = join(destination, 'raw', 'network', 'index.json');
  const captured = await readFile(indexPath, 'utf8')
    .then(text => JSON.parse(text).captured)
    .catch(error => { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; return []; });
  const missingBodies = new Set();
  const forms = new Set((project.views ?? []).map(view => view.id));
  const raw = join(destination, 'raw', 'network');
  await mkdir(raw, { recursive: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const url = new URL(entry.request.url);
    if (url.origin !== expectedOrigin || entry.response.status < 200 || entry.response.status >= 300) continue;
    const kind = matchKind(url.pathname);
    if (!kind) continue;
    const templateId = url.searchParams.get('templateId') ?? url.pathname.match(/\/template\/([^/]+)/i)?.[1];
    const workflowId = url.searchParams.get('workflowDefinitionId') ??
      (['fields', 'views'].includes(kind) ? url.pathname.match(/\/project\/([^/]+)\/(?:fields|views)$/)?.[1] : undefined);
    if (['workflow', 'views', 'fields'].includes(kind) && !workflowId) continue;
    if (workflowId && workflowId !== project.workflowDefinitionId) continue;
    if (templateId && forms.size && !forms.has(templateId)) continue;
    const content = entry.response.content ?? {};
    if (!content.text) {
      missingBodies.add(kind);
      continue;
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.from(content.text, content.encoding === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'utf8');
    if (bytes.length > 32000000) {
      missingBodies.add(kind);
      continue;
    }
    let body;
    let extension;
    if (kind === 'xsn' && bytes.toString('ascii', 0, 4) === 'MSCF') {
      body = bytes;
      extension = 'xsn';
    } else if (kind === 'fields') {
      const fields = parseFieldIndex(bytes.toString('utf8'), expectedOrigin, forms);
      if (!fields.length) { missingBodies.add(kind); continue; }
      body = JSON.stringify({ fields }, null, 2);
      extension = 'json';
    } else if (kind === 'views') {
      const views = parseViews(bytes.toString('utf8'), expectedOrigin, workflowId);
      if (!views.length) {
        missingBodies.add(kind);
        continue;
      }
      body = JSON.stringify({ views }, null, 2);
      extension = 'json';
    } else {
      try {
        body = JSON.stringify(redact(JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8'))), null, 2);
        extension = 'json';
      } catch {
        missingBodies.add(kind);
        continue;
      }
    }
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('hex');
    const file = `${kind}-${hash.slice(0, 20)}.${extension}`;
    const resource = { kind, source: url.origin + url.pathname, method: entry.request.method, workflowId, templateId, hash, file };
    if (captured.some(item => item.file === file && item.source === resource.source &&
        item.templateId === templateId && item.workflowId === workflowId)) continue;
    await writeFile(join(raw, file), body);
    captured.push(resource);
  }
  const manifest = { captured, missingBodies: [...missingBodies] };
  await writeFile(indexPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
  return manifest;
}

=== src/image-layout.mjs
/**
 * Calculate readable vertical slices for a tall image.
 *
 * The image is not modified. Each slice uses Word's percentage crop, so a
 * single PNG can be displayed across several pages at the full text width.
 */
export function imageCropSegments(image, page, reserve = 0) {
  const availableWidth = Math.max(1, (page.width - page.left - page.right) / 15 - 4);
  const availableHeight = Math.max(1, (page.height - page.top - page.bottom) / 15 - reserve);
  if (!image?.width || !image?.height) return [];

  const heightAtFullWidth = image.height * availableWidth / image.width;
  const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((heightAtFullWidth - 0.5) / availableHeight));
  if (count === 1) {
    const scale = Math.min(availableWidth / image.width, availableHeight / image.height, 1);
    return [{
      width: Math.max(1, Math.floor(image.width * scale)),
      height: Math.max(1, Math.floor(image.height * scale)),
    }];
  }

  const segmentHeight = image.height / count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
    width: Math.max(1, Math.floor(availableWidth)),
    height: Math.max(1, Math.min(
      Math.floor(availableHeight),
      Math.floor(segmentHeight * availableWidth / image.width),
    )),
    crop: {
      top: index * 100 / count,
      bottom: (count - index - 1) * 100 / count,
    },
  }));
}

/**
 * Keep only the first document placement for identical image bytes.
 * Node text and tables are retained; only repeated picture placements are removed.
 */
export function dedupeSectionImages(sections, digest) {
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const section of sections) {
    section.screenshots = (section.screenshots || []).filter(screenshot => {
      const key = screenshot.image?.data && digest(screenshot.image.data);
      if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;
      seen.add(key);
      return true;
    });
  }
  return sections;
}

/**
 * Keep the first occurrence of an identical business rule across nodes.
 * Node-specific differences remain as separate strings and are not merged.
 */
export function dedupeSectionRules(sections) {
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const section of sections) {
    section.rules = (section.rules || []).filter(rule => {
      const key = String(rule).trim();
      if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;
      seen.add(key);
      return true;
    });
  }
  return sections;
}
